it.name: Athlytic: Fitness & Recovery
it.d:
Your Apple Watch collects thousands of data points a day. Athlytic turns them into one clear answer: how ready you are, how hard to go, and how to recover.

RECOVERY: Every morning Athlytic reads your overnight HRV and resting heart rate against your own baseline and tells you how recovered you are. On Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, Recovery uses Apple's new Recovery HRV.

EXERTION and TARGET EXERTION: Your cardiovascular load is tracked 24/7 and scored 0 to 10. Each day you get a Target Exertion range that fits your Recovery, so you know when to push and when to hold back.

WORKOUT SUGGESTIONS: Based on your target zone and the workouts you actually do, Athlytic suggests what to do today, for how long, and how hard. Build a structured workout, or import a plan from a screenshot, and send it to your Apple Watch with warm-up, repeats, rests, and cool-down.

ATHLYTIC AGE: One number for your fitness, built from your resting heart rate, VO2 max, sleep, body composition, steps, training minutes, and heart rate recovery. See which lever moves it most, then tap What if to try changes before you make them.

BATTERY and STRESS: Watch your energy fill and drain through the day, and see when your heart rate ran above your baseline so you know what stressed you.

TARGET SLEEP: A nightly sleep goal and target bedtime built from today's Recovery, Exertion, and sleep debt.

SLEEP: Sleep performance, stages, restorative sleep, sleep debt, consistency, latency, efficiency, heart rate dip, and overnight charts of HRV, heart rate, respiratory rate, and blood oxygen.

24/7 HEALTH MONITOR: HRV, resting heart rate, blood oxygen, respiratory rate, wrist temperature, and menstrual cycle, each checked against your normal range, with optional alerts when something is off.

JOURNAL: Log caffeine, alcohol, travel, illness, and dozens more, then see exactly how each one moves your Recovery and Sleep.

WORKOUTS: Live heart rate zones, Effort score, and intensity on your wrist. Afterward, a full breakdown with cardio fitness, heart rate recovery, splits, personal records, best efforts, and how the session compared with your typical one.

TRENDS: Recovery vs. Exertion coaching, training load and training load ratio, weekly activity goals, energy consumed and burned, heart rate recovery, and cardio fitness over time.

ASK ATHLYTIC and SIRI: Ask questions about your Recovery, Sleep, Stress, and workouts in plain language with Ask Athlytic, powered by Apple Intelligence. Or just ask Siri for your Recovery, Sleep, Training Status, planned workouts, and more, without opening the app.

24 IPHONE WIDGETS, 16 WATCH COMPLICATIONS: Recovery, Exertion, Sleep, Battery, Stress, Training Load, Net Energy, Macros, Steps, Cycle, Daily HRV and Heart Rate charts, and Lock Screen widgets for Recovery, Exertion, and Stress.

Notes:
• An Apple Watch is needed for most features, since HRV and resting heart rate come from the watch. Some third-party wearables that write HRV to Apple Health also work.
• Athlytic reads its data from the Health app and will ask permission for each data type it uses.

- Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.

it.name: Gentler Streak Workout Tracker
it.d:
Hey, welcome the Gentler Streak - the app that keeps your active life alive! An award-winning health and fitness tracker offers personalized guidance that adapts to your daily capabilities and not the other way around. For those of us who want to move consistently, not constantly.

Built with care by a small indie team.

• 2024 Apple Design Award - Social Impact | 2022 Apple Watch App of the Year | App of the Day | Editor’s Choice
• Featured in The Verge, Forbes, TechCrunch, and more.

▶ PRIVATE DATA STAYS PRIVATE
Your health and fitness data stays on-device via Apple HealthKit, with no external processing.

▶UNDERSTAND YOUR DAILY READINESS◀
[KEY HEALTH METRICS]
Start your day with a summary of key vitals and sleep, helping you detect changes before you feel them. Receive workout suggestions that respond to your readiness. Set home screen widgets to bring this info closer to you.

[FULL SLEEP ANALYSIS]
See everything from sleep onset to how much restorative sleep you are getting. View trends over 14 nights in sleep duration, consistency, and stages to spot patterns and improve your sleep hygiene.

[DAILY STEPS, DONE DIFFERENTLY]
You can now track daily steps, distance, walking time, flights climbed, and walking heart rate—all with a 14-day trend overview.
Our approach doesn’t push you to chase step goals. Instead, it helps you understand your daily movement patterns—ideal for everyday walkers and those managing chronic conditions.

[SYNC ACTIVITIES WITH YOUR CYCLE]
Know daily stress tolerance of each menstrual cycle phase and receive support for your current state, with workout suggestions like "Flow Workouts" along with allowing you to take a pause when your period starts.

▶STAYING ACTIVE ON YOUR TERMS◀
[STREAK & STATUS]
Keep your streak alive by following your body’s needs, even when it calls for rest days. When life happens—be it illness, injury, or vacation—adjust your status to reflect real life and skip feeling guilty.

[AWARD-WINNING APPLE WATCH WORKOUT TRACKER]
Track real-time training effects and heart rate zones to manage your workout intensity and avoid overtraining. Get a countdown to “overreaching” to know exactly when you're close to pushing too hard for the day.

[PERSONALIZED WORKOUT TRACKING]
Track 140+ activities, from chores to a variety of workouts, with detailed maps and metric charts, and stay within your healthy activity levels.

[TAILORED DAILY WORKOUTS]
Get daily suggestions—ranging from rest to high-intensity exercises—based on your readiness. Go Gentler's on-watch suggestions allow you to scale your exercise duration and/or intensity up or down.

▶ULTIMATE WORKOUT JOURNAL◀
[PERSONALIZED SUMMARIES]
Turn your workout summaries into a personalized fitness journal. Customize them with details that matter to you: rename workouts, add notes, photos, and mark your favorite sessions. Plus, adjust the effort using the RPE chart when needed.

[PROGRESS CHARTS]
Your progress with weekly, monthly and yearly charts, including a weekly, monthly and yearly recap.

[LIVE ACTIVITY & WIDGETS]
Use Live Activity for tracking on iPhone, and interactive widgets on your Home & Lock screens.

[ACCESSIBLE TO ALL]
Full support for accessibility preferences including bold text, dynamic type, reduced transparency, increased contrast, motion adjustments, and voiceover.

Upgrade to Gentler Streak Premium with monthly, yearly, or lifetime plans for advanced features and family sharing.

Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage plans and turn off auto-renewal in Settings > Apple ID >  Subscriptions.

Please note, Gentler Streak is not a medical device and should not replace professional medical advice.

Terms of service: https://gentler.app/terms/
Privacy policy: https://gentler.app/privacy

it.name: Endel: Focus & Sleep Sounds
it.d:
Focus, relax, and sleep through the power of sound. Endel creates AI-powered sounds designed to support your everyday life. Backed by science, and enjoyed by millions worldwide. 

Endel is powered by its patented core AI technology. It takes inputs like location, environment, and heart rate, to create the optimal personalized soundscape. This happens on the fly and allows Endel to reconnect your state with your circadian rhythm.

Get access to the following classic soundscapes at home, work, or on the move to relax, concentrate, and minimize distractions and brain fatigue:


• Focus – boosts your productivity by helping you concentrate for longer

• Sleep – soothes you into a deep sleep with soft, gentle sounds

• Relax – calms your mind to create feelings of comfort and safety

• Move – feel grounded and present while walking, hiking, or running


ENDEL PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION


Alongside the classics, the Premium package contains the following Endel Soundscapes and features:


• Colored Noise – choose one of 9 colors of noise to focus, relax, sleep, and mask outside sound

• Study – improves concentration and keeps you calm while studying or working

• Dynamic Focus – get your perfect productivity support with real-time sound tuning

• Hibernation – nourish your ears with cozy sounds for cold-season slumber

• Nature Elements – nurture the mind with sounds of nature, your way

• Rainy Outside – cozy up to the gentle patter of rain, blended with sleep-aiding sounds

• Recovery – revives your wellbeing with sounds engineered to lower anxiety

• Spatial Orbit – venture into a more peaceful dimension with an immersive Spatial Audio experience

• Focus Timer – the famous interval work method, upgraded with science-backed Focus sounds


On top of the much-loved original Endel soundscapes, Endel works with innovative artists and thinkers to create unique experiences. These collaborative Endel Soundscapes are available for Premium users:


• James Blake: Wind Down – prepare your body for sleep with soothing sounds from an award-winning artist

• Grimes: AI Lullaby – supports sleep for babies and adults with original sounds and vocals from Grimes

• Plastikman: Deeper Focus – a deep focus techno soundscape created with Richie Hawtin

• Alan Watts: Wiggly Wisdom – soothing and motivation spoken word soundscape, infused with the playful wisdom from Alan Watts

• Miguel: Clarity Trip – elevate your every step with original sounds from Miguel


Endel Pacific is the patented technology that powers our apps and integrations. All soundscapes are available offline.

Apart from the Premium sounds and features, Endel Premium users get access to the exclusive Apple Podcast shows.


SUBSCRIPTION TERMS


Skip the payment screen by tapping “X” in the top-right corner of the offer. The Free Edition of Endel will start automatically.

You can get access to Endel Premium by subscribing to a recurrent plan of your choice or with a one-time Lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase.

Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be provided.

Subscriptions may be managed by the user. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.

No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.

Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.


For more information:

Terms of Use - https://endel.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360003558200

Privacy Policy - https://endel.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360003562619

it.name: Bend: Stretching & Flexibility
it.d:
Bend is the simple, affordable way to make stretching & movement a part of your daily routine. With over 15 million users, our quick & convenient routines help improve your flexibility and maintain your natural range of motion as you get older. We offer hundreds of exercises and easy-to-follow routines designed for all ages and experience levels. It's never too early to start stretching everyday!

“It’s like having a personal stretching coach in my pocket.” — The New York Times

“I could never stick to my stretching routine. Then I found this app.” — Wirecutter

STRETCHING IS IMPORTANT

A simple, daily stretching routine can have a huge impact on your quality of life. Every time you stretch, you invest in your long-term health and longevity.

Stretching benefits include:
⊕ Increase flexibility & mobility in your muscles and joints
⊕ Prevent and relieve pain in your lower back, neck, hips, shoulders and more
⊕ Reduce the risk of injury during outdoor activities and sports
⊕ Improve sleep quality and energy throughout the day
⊕ Improve posture and strengthen your core
⊕ Reduce stress & anxiety
⊕ Improve athletic performance
⊕ Improve circulation and blood flow
⊕ Accelerate muscle recovery
⊕ Improve balance & coordination
⊕ And more!

YOUR BODY'S FAVORITE APP

Bend offers dozens of daily stretching & mobility routines for every occasion.

⊕ “Wake Up”
Designed to maintain your body’s natural mobility and range of motion. Simple, quick, convenient, and effective, you can do it anytime, anywhere, everyday.

⊕ “Posture Reset”
Specifically designed to improve your posture with seated stretches that can correct habitual posture problems by increasing flexibility in the shoulders, back, and neck.

⊕ “Full Body”
Focused on improving overall flexibility, with more than 20 stretching exercises and poses that target key muscles and joints throughout your entire body.

⊕ “Sleep”
Gentle, long-hold stretches designed to help you unwind and de-stress after a long day at work through better quality of sleep, which is made possible by relieving muscle tension and relaxing the body.

⊕ “Expert”
Advance group of stretching exercises and yoga poses that cover all major muscle groups and extremities. Flexibility and range of motion can be improved significantly with their more complex movements.

⊕ "Hips"
Open and unlock tight hips with deep, focused stretches designed to improve hip flexibility and undo hours of inactivity from sitting at a desk, in a car, or on the couch.

⊕ "Hamstrings"
Improve hamstring flexibility with subtle stretches designed to reduce hamstring tightness and relieve pressure on the knees, pelvis, and lower back.

⊕ "Lower Back"
Reduce and prevent lower back pain with gentle stretches designed to increase flexibility in the lower back, pelvis, and hip flexors.

⊕ "Isometric"
isometric exercise routines that build muscle, strength, balance, and range of motion in targeted areas through static muscle contraction.

⊕ And more!

CREATE YOUR OWN

Create your own custom stretching routine suited to your specific needs. Choose from hundreds of stretches, yoga poses, and isometric exercises in our library.

EASY-TO-USE

Bend makes stretching simple. We use custom illustrations and a timer to guide you through each routine. Every stretch has detailed instructions, information about its benefits, and specific things to be cautious about! 

STREAKS & ANALYTICS

Our dashboard displays your streaks and analytics to track your progress and you can set reminders to help motivate you to stretch every day. Check your Bendometer as a quick way to see how consistent you’ve been stretching over the last few weeks.

APPLE HEALTH
Bend integrates with the Health app, giving users the option to sync health information and activity with Apple Health.

FEEDBACK & SUPPORT
If you have any questions, feedback, or suggestions, feel free to contact us at hello@bend.com!

LEGAL

Terms of Use: https://bend.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://bend.com/privacy

it.name: Nutrition Coach: Food tracker
it.d:
Effortless calories counter, customized meals plan, and delicious recipes. Loose or gain weight in a sustainable way to achieve your objective.

Nutrition Coach is the result of 3 years of work by a team of passionate nutritionists. Our programs and calorie counter have been tested for months and approved with visible and sustainable results.

Have you ever experienced a very restrictive diet almost impossible to sustain for more than a couple of days?
Have you ever experienced weight loss followed by immediate weight gain ruining your efforts?

If you answered yes to those questions read what follows.
Our approach is different from other nutrition apps: Nutrition Coach focuses on long-term results that will last forever.

Nutrition Coach is based on achieving a daily and weekly calorie objective while eating what you like and even allows cheat meals.

With Nutrition Coach you will be able to:
- Track your calories with the most extensive food database
- Search ingredients, meals, or branded food
- Scan any barcode to automatically track your food
- Track your macros and micro-nutrients in details
- Learn facts about nutrition and food
- Track your weight and see progress along the days
- All your Fitness and Running app sync
- Enjoy more than 1,700 delicious recipes
- Adjust recipes to the number of people eating at your table
- A diary to see your progress and complete the day you have missed
- Clever reminders
- Enjoy unique meal plans to improve your overall health and mental conditions

Nutricoach works with Apple Health app which lets you share your data with other Health connected apps. For instance, you can:
- get your daily steps automatically synchronized in Nutrition Coach
- add your foods and their detailed nutritional information to the Health app
- sync your weight to the Health app
- retrieve Calories burned with your activities (running, fitness, cardio) in Nutrition Coach thanks to Apple Health

SUBSCRIPTIONS
- You can subscribe to this app to get access to premium features
- Subscription options are: 1-week with a 3-day trial, 1-month with a 3-day trial, yearly
- Privacy: http://privacy.appfeedbacks.com/1539625670
- Terms of Use: https://www.iubenda.com/terms-and-conditions/44220384

it.name: Clarity: CBT Self Help Journal
it.d:
Clarity is your all-in-one mental health hub for managing stress, anxiety, and low mood. Learn what affects your mood, develop healthier thought patterns, problem solve with the AI chatbot, practice effective coping skills, build resilience, and foster personal growth.

HOW IT WORKS
Clarity is built on proven methods widely studied and endorsed in the world of mental health. The core principle is simple yet powerful: by understanding and changing your thoughts, you can better manage your emotions and actions.

Clarity integrates approaches from behavioral science, positive psychology, and mindfulness to bring you the best self-care tools offered by modern science.

REFRAME YOUR THOUGHTS
- Use proven techniques to break free from negative thought cycles.
- Identify and confront Cognitive Distortions hindering your mental well-being.
- Challenge and transform your thought processes for the better.

AI-INFUSED JOURNALING & CHAT
- Step into the future of mental health with innovative AI features.
- Journal with AI-driven questions and analysis that adapt to your mental state.
- Feel heard with a thoughtful and compassionate AI Chatbot built for self-reflection.

CHECK IN FOR INSIGHTS & REWARDS
- Seamlessly track your moods, emotions, and activities.
- Derive actionable insights by examining patterns and trends.
- Earn fresh badges each month and track your progress with widgets.

DISCOVER YOURSELF
- Engage with thoughtfully crafted Guided Journals to deepen self-awareness.
- Follow a personalized daily plan designed to build lasting mental health habits.
- Explore your authentic self with science-backed personality tests and more.

CURATED WELLNESS LIBRARY
- Level up your knowledge with educational mental health programs.
- Reduce stress with mindfulness meditation audios, soundscapes, and breathwork.
- Find joy and calm with daily wellness tips and positive affirmations.

TESTIMONIALS
"This app has saved my life."

"The repeated nature of doing these check-ins really does begin to soften hard-worn beliefs. I now find my thought processes shifting to more positive and growth-minded reframes at times when I would have wallowed in negative self-talk."

"Within the first few days of using the app to record how I was feeling and my moods, I started to feel better. It was like my mind was becoming less cloudy."

DESIGNED WITH PURPOSE
We believe in increasing access to mental wellness by sharing knowledge and evidence-based self-help techniques. Clarity was created with care by a team with backgrounds in psychology and mental health research.

PRIVACY AND SECURITY
We do not sell your data. Your journal entries are stored locally on your phone by default. Data backup is optional.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro Mode is an optional subscription that unlocks all Guided Journals, AI Chatbots, Assessments, Programs, Crash Courses, Audios, Breathwork, Tips, Affirmations, and Advanced Insights features.

Pricing may vary depending on the country. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off within your Account Settings after the purchase.

DISCLAIMER
Clarity is a self-help and educational tool, not a therapy app. It does not provide and is not a substitute for licensed psychotherapy, counseling, or psychiatric treatment. It is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any mental health condition. The content and features in this app do not constitute professional medical diagnosis or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider with any questions regarding a medical or mental health condition.

desc: Are you tired of constantly fluctuating weight and struggling to stay on track with your fitness goals? Introducing the Happy Scale IPA

it.name: Happy Scale
it.d:
Dieting is hard enough. But when you work hard, hop on the scale, and see a number that’s higher than yesterday? Well, that’s just not fair!

It’s time to tame the scale!

Happy Scale helps you make sense of the frustrating ups and downs of weigh-ins by using mathematical analysis to make sense of your scale weights.

You’ll:
• understand your true trend,
• take the sting out of plateaus, and
• be able to predict what you’ll weigh for an upcoming event

• SEE YOUR TRUE PROGRESS: Happy Scale uses sophisticated math to learn the true trend of your progress. You can see what you’re really losing each week.

• NO MORE PLATEAUS: Use the moving average progress tracking options to see steady progress every day!

• SLOW AND STEADY WINS THE RACE: Have a lot to lose? Break your weight loss goal into small, incremental milestone goals so you can focus on short-term, achievable goals!

• THE PERFECT SUPPLEMENT: Use this app in conjunction with other popular apps. Weight entries can be automatically imported from apps that support exporting to the Apple Health app, and Happy Scale will export all your weights to Apple Health so other apps can see them.

• IMAGINE YOUR SUCCESS: See predictions about what you’ll weigh in the future if you keep up your current trends, and set commitment goals for yourself!

• KNOW YOUR NUMBERS: Our new BMI calculator shows you exactly where you stand and what weight ranges you need to hit for different health categories. No more guessing if you’re almost there!

• WORKS ON ALL YOUR DEVICES: Seamlessly sync between your iPhone and iPad!

So, have your previous diets failed because you lost motivation? Try Happy Scale today and join thousands of users who use this app to TAME THE SCALE!

------------------

This app optionally integrates with Apple Health. It is an opt-in feature that’s accessible from the Settings menu.

it.name: MacroFactor - Macro Tracker
it.d:
MacroFactor combines innovative coaching algorithms with proven nutrition and behavioral science to help you reach your diet goals and achieve empowering, sustainable results.

MacroFactor uses a dynamic algorithm to adapt to changes in your metabolism and personalize your macro plan to keep you on track.

Download to start your 7-day trial of this premium, ad-free macro tracker app. 

DIET SMARTER

Using a best-in-class expenditure estimate, MacroFactor’s nutrition coach algorithm adapts to changes in your metabolism so you never plateau. 

• The unique energy expenditure calculation detects changes in your metabolism
• Smart algorithms personalize your calorie and macro intake targets, just like a nutrition coach would
• Weekly check-ins keep you on track toward your goals

The result? You better understand your body’s needs and can successfully reach and sustain your goals without stress.

THE BEST MACRO TRACKER TOOLS

• The fastest macro tracker on the market with tools like barcode scan and custom foods
• Verified food database, so you can trust the accuracy of the foods you log 
• Custom macro programs and weekly check-ins based on your goals and preferences
• Detailed breakdowns of micronutrients, macros, and more
• Period tracker, habit tracker, unique data insights and visualization, integrations, dark mode, and more

AN EMPOWERING, SUSTAINABLE APPROACH

MacroFactor’s robust nutrition coach algorithm will make appropriate adjustments to your calorie and macro targets based on what you log, regardless of how close you came to hitting your targets from the previous week. The algorithms don’t function any worse if you deviate from your macro targets. 
 
This means that unlike other nutrition coach apps, you don’t have to eat like a robot or perfectly adhere to your macro targets in order to get your weekly coaching check-in and an appropriate calorie adjustment.
 
You’ll never see warnings, red numbers, or shaming when you go over your calorie or macro targets, unlike in other macro tracker apps.
 
Instead, MacroFactor’s macro tracker and nutrition coach aim to empower you with the guidance and tools you need to reach your goals without stress or rigidity. 

A CLOSER LOOK AT FEATURES & BENEFITS

Nutrition coach
• Get a science-backed macro plan designed for your goals and preferences
• Set a goal to lose, maintain, or gain weight
• Smart nutrition coach AI makes weekly changes to your macro plan to keep you on track
 
Macro tracker
• Large verified food database, so you can trust that calorie and macro information is accurate
• Barcode scanner
• Food tracker for both macros and micronutrients
• Features like copy/paste, custom foods, and smart history make food tracking quick and easy
• Timeline-style food log doesn’t lock you in to a certain number of meals
• Metric and imperial options
• Custom foods and recipes

Health insights tracker
• Best-in-class expenditure estimate
• Unique Weight Trend insight that cuts through the noise of daily fluctuations
• Habit tracker
• Period tracker

NOTICES

Contains information from Open Food Facts, which is made available
here under the Open Database License (ODbL).

Open Food Facts:
https://openfoodfacts.org/

ODbL:
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/

SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS

MacroFactor is a premium app that offers three auto-renewing subscription options:
$11.99 / month
$47.99 / half year
$71.99 / year (equal to $5.99 a month)

MacroFactor has a free trial, but does not offer a free subscription tier.

These prices are for US customers. Pricing in other countries may vary. Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase.

Your subscription to MacroFactor will automatically renew, unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can cancel or manage your subscription from your Apple account settings.

Terms & Conditions:
https://terms.macrofactorapp.com/

Privacy Policy:
https://privacy.macrofactorapp.com/

it.name: Osmosis - Med School Study App
it.d:
Struggling to understand medical concepts or prepare for the USMLE? Osmosis is the medical exam study app designed to help med students learn medicine faster, improve information retention and pass medical board exams with flying colours. 

Trusted by 8,000,000+ medical, nursing, PA, pharmacy and dental students, this medical learning app turns downtime into productive study time with an expansive library of medical videos, flashcards, quizzes, exam-style questions and more.

Instead of memorizing isolated facts, Osmosis helps you learn how medical concepts connect - so that you can retain more information, study smarter and apply what you learn to exams and in clinical practice.

And now, you can ask Osmosis AI for instant, evidence-based answers grounded in Elsevier medical textbooks and linked to Osmosis videos. Generate flashcards, quizzes, summaries and mnemonics on demand with AI so you never have to second-guess your source.

EXAM PREP FOR EVERY US MEDICAL LICENSING EXAM
• USMLE Step 1 & Step 2 
• COMLEX-USA Level 1 & Level 2
• NCLEX-RN & NCLEX-PN 
• PANCE 
• ABFM / ABIM 
• UKMLA (UK)

With Osmosis, everything in your medical studies connects so nothing gets lost. Flashcards, videos and notes work together to make every study session stress free and every exam prep hour more productive.

Ready to learn smarter? DOWNLOAD today to start your FREE 7-DAY TRIAL.  

STUDY ANYWHERE, ANYTIME
Download medical videos and exam questions for offline study on the commute, before rounds or between clinics. Sync across iPhone, iPad and web so you can learn wherever you are.

WHY CHOOSE OSMOSIS?
• 1000s of concise medical videos that simplify complex medical concepts and support visual learning
• Medical flashcards that help you learn and retain key concepts, with concise explanations reviewed by medical experts
• A custom quiz builder that transforms your study time so you can master medical material and ace your exams
• Board-style practice exam questions with detailed explanations
• 450+ high-yield summary notes with key points and diagrams from videos
• Printable clinical decision-making trees to learn on the go
• Spaced repetition guides what medical concepts to study next, focusing you on the areas where you need it the most

YOUR ALL-IN-ONE MEDICAL LEARNING TOOLKIT
From concept mastery to clinical reasoning, Osmosis turns complex medical material into clear, digestible learning experiences so that you can study with confidence and pass exams first time, every time.

LEARN SMARTER
Our videos and High-Yield medical study notes condense everything you need to learn and nothing you don't. Study efficiently and retain the medical knowledge that matters most for board exams and clinical practice.

GET A PERSONALIZED, FLEXIBLE STUDY PLAN IN MINUTES
Choose your learning goals and set your study hours, Osmosis handles the rest. Your daily study checklist shows which videos, exam questions and topics to learn each day. Add custom tasks like homework, practice exams and reminders to keep your medical studies on track.

it.name: Boostcamp: Workout Tracker
it.d:
Trusted by over 1,300,000 lifters. 300M+ workouts logged. 4.8 stars.

Boostcamp is a free workout tracker and gym logger with 11,000+ programs and an AI coach that builds a custom plan from your goal, schedule, and equipment. Log every set. Run nSuns, GZCLP, 5/3/1, Reddit PPL, PHUL, PHAT, or 130+ coach programs. No spreadsheet.

Garage Gym Reviews named Boostcamp the Best Workout App Overall in 2026.

"I primarily train for strength and hypertrophy, and Boostcamp is the best app I’ve ever used. I love all the data it provides, and there are so many great programs to choose from within the workout library." – Matt Dustin, CSCS, PN1-NC, Garage Gym Reviews

Featured in Fortune’s 2026 trainer-approved Boostcamp review.

"Boostcamp has all the features of Strong and Hevy, but what puts Boostcamp decidedly #1 is that it features a library of programs from some of the most recognizable figures in fitness." – Alex Bromley, Professional Strongman

"Boostcamp puts all of Reddit's best free workouts in one slick app...give Boostcamp a try." – Lifehacker

WHAT YOU GET

• Workout Tracker – Log sets, reps, and weight with RPE, RIR, and e1RM. Auto-progression sets your next weights. Rest timer, plate calculator, supersets, drop sets, warmup templates, form videos, and mid-set exercise swaps that keep your numbers. PRs flag in-session. Weekly Sunday reports and year-end Wrapped. Offline. Live Activities put your set and rest timer on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. Syncs bodyweight with Apple Health.

• AI Coach – Short questionnaire, then a customized multi-week program you log in the same tracker. Or pick a named coach program and start today. Fork any program, or build your own with no cap.

• 11,000+ Programs – 130+ coach-designed plans with progressions, periodization, and deloads, plus a huge community library. Filter by goal, level, and days per week. The library is free. No ads.

• Analytics – Volume, muscle-group engagement, PRs, and training history. Pro adds Strength Score (0–100 across the big lifts) and a per-muscle volume heatmap.

POPULAR PROGRAMS

nSuns 5/3/1, GZCLP, 5/3/1 BBB, 5/3/1 for Beginners, Building the Monolith, Candito 6 Week, TSA, Bullmastiff, Greyskull LP, PHUL, PHAT, Reddit PPL, KONG, MASS IMPACT, Jacked and Tan 2.0, Strong Curves, Alberto Nuñez Upper Lower, Eric Helms Intermediate Bodybuilding, Greg Nuckols Beginner, Reddit Bodyweight Fitness RR, and thousands more.

COACHES

Dr. Eric Helms, Alex Bromley, Cody Lefever (GZCL), Geoffrey Verity Schofield, Alberto Nuñez, Bryce Lewis, Greg Nuckols, Jonnie Candito, Bald Omni-Man, Natural Hypertrophy, Basement Bodybuilding, Brandon Campbell (PHUL), Dr. Swole, Matt Vena, Menno Henselmans, Justina Ercole, Tiffany Ma, Rebecca Rouse, and 50+ more. Competitive athletes and researchers, not random influencers.

WHO IT'S FOR

Beginners who want a plan and a gym logger. Intermediate lifters done with spreadsheets. Anyone who wants an AI coach plus a real tracker. Men and women. Full gym, garage gym, or dumbbells at home. 2–6 days per week.

ABOUT

Boostcamp started by putting Reddit’s best programs into a workout tracker that works. 1.3M+ lifters now log training, follow 11,000+ programs, and build custom plans with an AI coach. Free to start. No ads.

Questions? support@boostcamp.app

it.name: Home Workout - No Equipments
it.d:
Want an easy way to stay active, lose weight, and build muscle? Home Workout helps you train with purpose through focused exercise routines designed for everyday life—from bodyweight workouts and light movement to strength training. Whether you prefer training with equipment or no equipment at all, you can work out at home, in the gym, or outdoors with flexible workout plans that adapt to you. With a smart AI coach and professional video guidance, each session delivers clear instructions to help you get fitter and stronger more easily.

Home Workout works like a personal trainer in your pocket. Based on your goals and experience level, it creates a workout plan that you can actually follow. With access to over 500 exercises, Home Workout offers a wide range of workout program options, including bodyweight workout sessions, stretching, quick workouts, and chair exercises. You can follow guided AI workouts or customize routines yourself—choose exercises you enjoy, adjust intensity, and train the way that feels right for you.

Stay consistent with a built-in workout tracker that automatically records key training data like completed exercises, workout duration, and training frequency. This smart workout progress tracker helps you review past sessions and see your progress over time, giving you the motivation to build a lasting fitness habit.

Plus, your workout data stays connected across Apple Health, Apple Watch, and iPad, so everything stays in sync across your devices.

Download Home Workout and see how easy fitness can actually be!

What You Get with Home Workout:

1. START ANYTIME & ANYWHERE
Exercise at home or in the gym with a personal workout plan that fits your schedule and available equipment. From quick sessions to longer workouts, you can train whenever it works for you.

2. EXPERT-TAILORED WORKOUT PLANS
Use our flexible workout planner to build a workout plan based on your fitness goals and level. Whether you want to stay active, get in shape, or build strength, each plan is easy to follow and simple to stick with.

3. 500+ Exercises
Explore 500+ exercises, including bodyweight workouts, stretching, chair workouts, and more. With options for different fitness goals and levels, there's always an exercise that fits you! Each exercise comes with clear video guidance and simple instructions for safe and effective training.

4. TRAIN SMART WITH AI SUPPORT
Enjoy AI workouts that adapt to your needs. Your AI coach adjusts your workout plan over time based on your performance and preferences, keeping training balanced and effective. As you customize routines or save your favorite exercises, the AI learns from your choices and refines future workouts.

Highlight Features:
- An easy-to-use workout planner and smart tracker that organize sessions, automatically log activities, and present clear data, helping you stay on track.
-  A comprehensive exercise library with video guides and expert tips.
- Custom reminders to help stay consistent and never miss a session.

No Hidden Charges, say goodbye to unexpected "surprises". 

Your perfect workout is waiting—join millions already crushing their fitness goals with Home Workout! 

Subscription Terms and Details 
- Get unlimited access to all features. 
- The payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. 
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
- Subscription may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase. 
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. 

Privacy Policy: https://maleworkout.leaphealth.fitness/privacypolicy.html 
Terms of Use: https://maleworkout.leaphealth.fitness/terms.html

*Apple Editor’s Choice Award Winner*


Build muscle, gain strength and lose weight with a customized workout plan just for you. Fitbod is the ultimate fitness platform made to help enhance your strength training and endurance through personalized AI workouts. You won’t just get stronger—you’ll do it on your terms. Get optimized weight lifting routines with a workout planner made to help you reach your fitness goals. No gym? No problem. Fitbod adapts to you with home training with no equipment needed. Each training session is custom-built for your fitness level and equipment so you can make the most of every workout. Make lasting progress with Fitbod – your own AI trainer guiding you to your strongest self


Get everything from recovery and exercise tracking to AI-generated recommendations tailored to your fitness objectives. Need access to a trainer? Shoot a quick email and get all your strength training questions answered easily. Fitbod lets you save and build your own strength training & endurance routines based on your preferences. Change up sessions, choose your favorite exercises, and maximize gains with the help of our AI workouts.


Monitor your progress across multiple devices with integrations that make fitness tracking easy. Build customized workouts that integrate with Apple Health. Hit your next session with Strava, Fitbit, and Apple Watch integration. Fitbod does it all.


Explore over 1000 exercises and let Fitbod create a customized workout plan for you. With easy-to-follow instructions and hi-res video walkthroughs you can hit each exercise the right way. Cardio, mobility, or strength training and endurance – Fitbod was made for you.


Download today and discover a better way to achieve your fitness goals.


Fitbod Features

AI-Generated Workouts
◆ Customized workout plan built around you and your fitness goals
◆ AI workouts maximize fitness gains by varying and balancing exercises
◆ Adaptive AI learns from your edits to its workout recommendations
◆ Non-linear periodization to optimize your workouts for sustained progress
◆ Fitness for everyone with advanced, intermediate, and beginner levels
◆ Wide variety of workout modifiers to change up single sessions
◆ Ability to save, build, or use your favorite strength training workouts
◆ Pro fitness trainers available via email for all strength training questions

1000+ Exercises
◆ Hi-res, multi-angle videos of each exercise
◆ Easy-to-understand, detailed exercise instructions with hi-res, multi-angle videos
◆ Search exercises by muscle group, equipment type or keyword
◆ Cardio, mobility, pregnancy-safe exercises and more are available
◆ Consistent updates made to optimize the exercise library

Integrations
◆ Integrated with Apple Health to build customized workouts
◆ Integrated with Strava and Fitbit
◆ Available for iOS and Apple Watch

After your free trial has ended, this app includes an auto-renewing subscription, which unlocks all premium workouts and features.

it.name: Flo Cycle & Period Tracker
it.d:
Flo Health is a science-backed cycle, ovulation, pregnancy, and period tracker with over 570 million downloads worldwide.*

Track your period (regular or irregular), predict ovulation, learn to spot fertile signs, follow your baby’s growth with Flo Health’s pregnancy tracker, and explore common perimenopause symptoms. Flo Health is here to support your menstrual cycle and female health journey.

Is my data safe with Flo Health?
Flo Health is the first and only period tracking app with two certifications that are internationally recognized as the gold standard in data protection and security. In 2025, Flo Health was recognized as the ISO/Information Security Management System Team of the Year at the PICCASO Privacy and Security Awards for excellence and commitment to privacy-first design.

- Anonymous Mode: Use the Flo Health period tracker without any personal identifiers being linked to your health data.

Why choose Flo Health for period and ovulation tracking?
Flo Health is more than a basic calendar — it's a period tracker and ovulation tracker designed to help you notice patterns over time.

- Over 70 trackable symptoms and moods to receive personalized menstrual cycle insights
- Support for irregular periods, pre-period symptoms, and cycle changes
- Cycle report summaries you can download and share with your doctor

Can Flo Health support my trying-to-conceive (TTC) journey?
Flo Health offers educational features to help you explore conception insights and better understand how to spot fertile signs.

- Fertile window and ovulation predictions based on your logged period data
- Log LH/ovulation test strip results and basal body temperature
- Discharge tracking to help you recognize fertile signs

How does Flo Health support me in pregnancy?
Once you conceive, switch to Pregnancy Mode for checklists and expert guidance.

- Pregnancy tracking with weekly updates on your baby's development
- Daily articles explaining fetal development at each stage

Can Flo Health help me with perimenopause symptoms?
Track changes during perimenopause with tools designed to help you better understand this life stage.

- Perimenopause Score to follow symptom changes
- Menopause Timeline to understand the perimenopause phases
- Tracker to log sleep, energy, mood, and well-being changes

Can I share with my partner?
Flo for Partners lets you invite your partner to support your health journey.

- Help them understand your menstrual cycle, get ovulation predictions, and celebrate pregnancy progress together.

Is Flo Health free?
The Flo Health app is free to download and includes core tools you need to track and understand your cycle.

What do I get with Flo Health Premium?

- Daily, tailored insights and expert-led videos
- In-depth pregnancy features
- Symptom Checker** that provides educational information on polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome, endometriosis, and uterine fibroids symptoms
- Fertility insights to support your TTC journey
- 24/7 virtual Health Assistant: Explore instant, tailored insights about your body and cycle trends
- Secret Chats: Find tips from other members
- Flori: Well-Being Battery that gives you a snapshot of how your sleep, cycle, activity, and symptoms may be impacting you

Note: Flo Health Premium is HSA/FSA eligible.

Medical disclaimer: Flo Health does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and is not a method of birth control or conception aid. Predictions and features are for informational and educational purposes only. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional.

Flo Health period tracker is compatible with Apple Watch.

Download the Flo Health app today and join millions using a trusted period tracker, pregnancy app, and cycle tracker.

*As of July 2026
**Not available in the UK, EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, or Switzerland.

Privacy Policy: https://flo.health/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://flo.health/terms-of-service

it.name: Slopes: Ski & Snowboard
it.d:
Take your snow days to the next level! Uncover detailed stats (and bragging rights) about your days skiing and snowboarding, ride with friends, log your memories, and replay your winter adventures together. Get the best ski tracking experience on iPhone and Apple Watch!

SMART RECORDING
Select your activity, and Slopes will figure out everything in the background (even what resort you're at, assuming you have cell reception). You can choose from ski, snowboard, monoski, sitski, telemark, and more. Slopes will automatically detect uphill, lifts, and runs for you all day long. 

FIND YOUR FRIENDS ON THE MOUNTAIN
With live location on the recording screen, you can easily find each other! Location sharing is privacy-focused; you can always turn it on and off.

INTERACTIVE RESORT MAPS (Premium)—Available for 2000+ resorts in the US, Canada, the European Alps, Australia, New Zealand, and Japan. 
Navigate resorts with ease in 2D or 3D. See which run you or your friends are on and where to go next. Find any trail, lift, the bathroom, and more. On many North American resorts, we now show on-mountain facilities such as bathrooms, food, and, most importantly, ski patrol locations, even in free mode.

TRIP PLANNING & CONDITIONS
Plan upcoming trips and invite your friends to them to share in the hype. Trips let you keep tabs on resort conditions, who's coming or not, and who else was invited, all in one central place. Before you head up the mountain, check what other riders say about a resort's snow quality. While on the mountain, location sharing will automatically work with everyone on the trip - even the participants not on your friend list in Slopes.

DETAILED STATISTICS
Uncover a wealth of information about your performance, speed, vertical, run times, and more. Find out how good you are and how you're getting even better, season-over-season.

FITNESS + APPLE WATCH
See how you're pushing yourself with live heart-rate data, close your activity rings in Apple Health, and with Slopes Premium, you can check vitals and fitness insights for every twist and turn.

PRIVACY-FOCUSED
Slopes never sells your data, and features are designed with privacy and safety in mind. Accounts are optional, and you can Sign-in with Apple.


Questions? Feedback? Use the "Help & Support" section in-app or visit help.getslopes.com.

========================

Slopes free version is ad-free and truly free. You won't waste battery, data, or time on ads. And you get all the core features you expect & love: find your friends, unlimited tracking, key stats & summaries, snow conditions, season & lifetime overviews, and more.

Slopes Premium unlocks powerful features and insights into your performance:
• Interactive Resort Maps in 2D & 3D. 
• Live Lift & Trail Status for +50 resorts in North America. 
• Performance Analytics with real-time stats for every run. 
• Find out where you hit top speeds and which was your best run.
• Fitness Analytics - get insights into your endurance.
• Bring the mountains to life with interactive replays in 3D & AR.

If you purchase an Annual or Family Pass, payment will be charged to your iTunes account. Your account will automatically be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period unless you turn off auto-renew. After purchase, you can turn off auto-renewal anytime by going to your Account Settings on the App Store.

Privacy Policy: https://getslopes.com/privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://getslopes.com/terms.html

========================

Note: GPS is required, so Slopes will not work indoors. iPads and iPods will not be able to record with Slopes. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. Factors like temperature, battery health, and other apps running in the background will affect battery performance.

Thenx: Calisthenics Training

Calisthenics Workouts & Skills. Build Strength. Anytime, Everywhere!

Thenx – Calisthenics & Bodyweight Fitness App
- Transform your body with Thenx, the ultimate calisthenics and bodyweight fitness app! Whether you're training at home, the gym, or outdoors, Thenx offers daily personalized workouts, expert-led training programs, and advanced skill tutorials to help you master moves like muscle-ups, handstands, planche, and more.

Perfect for beginners to elite athletes, Thenx will help you build strength, endurance, and mobility through effective bodyweight exercises that require no equipment.

Why Thenx is the Best Calisthenics App
- Daily Recommended Workouts – Get customized routines based on your fitness level and goals.
- Master Advanced Skills – Learn elite moves like muscle-ups, handstands, planche, and more with expert tutorials.
- Full-Body Strength Training – Build strength with push-ups, pull-ups, squats, dips, and more using just your body.
- Muscle Analytics & Progress Tracking – Track your strength gains, monitor muscle activation, and visualize progress.
- No Equipment Needed – Train anywhere: at home, at the gym, or outdoors in the park.
- Mobility & Flexibility – Improve your range of motion and prevent injuries.

Train Anytime, Anywhere with Thenx
- Home Workouts – No equipment? No problem! Train with bodyweight exercises at home.
- Gym Training – Add resistance for extra muscle growth with gym workouts.
- Outdoor Street Workouts – Use bars, rings, or your body to train in the park or outdoors.

Track Your Progress & Improve Performance
- Daily Workout Recommendations – Tailored based on your progress, goals, and fitness level.
- Real-Time Progress Tracking – Log your reps, sets, and personal bests.
- Muscle Analytics – See which muscles you’re activating to optimize your training.

What You’ll Get with Thenx:
- Beginner to Advanced Calisthenics Programs
- Bodyweight Strength & Muscle-Building Workouts

- Skill Challenges: Muscle-Up, Planche, Handstand & More

Start Your Transformation Today with Thenx!
Join thousands of athletes and fitness enthusiasts using Thenx to improve strength, endurance, and mobility with calisthenics and bodyweight training.

Download Now & Train Like a Pro!

it.name: KeyLifts - 531 Workout Log
it.d:
KeyLifts takes the math out of the 5/3/1 program so you can focus on getting stronger. Everything is planned out for you. Know exactly what you need to do as soon as you step into the gym. KeyLifts automatically calculates all your sets so you can focus on hitting new Personal Records.

Planning and tracking a 5/3/1 program is time-consuming and hard. You have to calculate your training max and then calculate every single set based on your training max. It doesn't have to be like that. You could just walk into the gym every day knowing exactly what you need to lift. KeyLifts takes the math out of the 5/3/1 program so you can focus on getting stronger and hitting new PRs.

Every cycle you have to redo the entire planning process, but not anymore! With one button press, you can create a new cycle with all the weights automatically calculated for you. 

If you haven't hit your ultimate strength goals yet then maybe it's because you have to spend so much time at the gym calculating weights for each set. Stop wasting your precious energy. Just plug in your numbers to KeyLifts and go.

The 5/3/1 program is amazing for strength gains but your energy and time are wasted trying to figure out what plates you need for each set. In the upgraded Pro version you get a Plate Calculator so you focus on the things that matter.

Getting stronger is about putting in the work every week but it's hard to see the progress you are making. The Pro version includes graphs of your one-rep maxes over time. Feel confident knowing you are doing the right things and making progress.

If you are the type of person that likes to track everything the Pro version also includes the ability to add and track Joker sets and assistance exercises.

Free Features:
- Plan an entire 5/3/1 cycle with one button press
- Alerts when you hit a new Personal Record (PR)
- Warm-up sets
- Rest Timer
- 150+ templates from the 5/3/1 Books
- Build your own custom templates
- Track assistance exercises
- Track Joker sets
- Delete or swap exercises during a workout

You can subscribe to the Pro version on either a monthly or yearly basis. Pro Features include: 
- Automatic Training Max progressions
- Cloud backup and sync between devices
- Plate Calculator
- Graphs

Terms of use: https://www.keylifts.com/terms
Privacy Policy:  https://www.keylifts.com/privacy

This app integrates with Apple Health to sync your weight and workout data.

it.name: Boxing Training: Bag Workouts
it.d:
Heavy Bag Pro is an innovative app for punching bag and shadow boxing training, designed to cater to fighters at every level. We understand the challenge: training alone with a punching bag can be tough. Even the most seasoned fighters can run out of ideas and lose motivation. The hurdle for beginners starting to learn boxing techniques and combinations is even greater. Heavy Bag Pro is here to change that, offering a vital boost to your training routine.

Heavy Bag Pro: Your Virtual Coach

* For Home Warriors and Solo Fighters: Perfect for those days you're training solo at home or in the gym. No more dull, aimless sessions.

* The Problem Solved: Say goodbye to the lack of motivation and ideas. Heavy Bag Pro is like having a coach in your pocket, providing the inspiration, ideas, and direction you need.
* Professional Fighter Expertise: Each workout is meticulously crafted by professional fighters, ensuring logical, purposeful, and effective training sessions.
* Focus on Training: With Heavy Bag Pro, you don't have to think about what's next. Just start the app and immerse yourself in practical training.
* Learn and Grow: New to boxing or kickboxing? Heavy Bag Pro offers 1000+ combos and techniques to build your skills from the ground up.
* Boost Advanced Training: Seasoned fighters, boost your workouts with diverse, challenging routines that keep your skills sharp and your mind engaged.
* Diverse Training: There are workouts for learning combos, high-intensity training (HIIT), power punches, bodyweight-integrated sessions, and much more. Just choose what you like. 
* Extremely Efficient Boxing Workouts: Our goal is for you to sweat, enjoy, and learn simultaneously. Each Heavy Bag Pro workout is crafted to deliver these elements, ensuring a fulfilling and efficient training experience.
* For All Combat Sports: Workouts are categorized into boxing, kickboxing, and Muay Thai. But they are also suitable for practitioners of MMA, Jiu-Jitsu, Karate, Taekwondo, or any other type of martial arts.

Crafted by Experts, Trusted by Fighters

Every aspect of Heavy Bag Pro, from the app's design to each workout, has been carefully developed by professionals in boxing and martial arts. This isn't just an app; it's a culmination of expert knowledge and practical experience. Our team comprises seasoned fighters and trainers who understand what it takes to excel in combat sports. They've poured their insights into creating workouts that not only challenge and engage but also ensure that you're training the right way. With Heavy Bag Pro, you're not just following a set of exercises; you're embracing a training methodology that's been honed and validated by professionals. Whether it's refining your technique, building stamina, or learning new combos, you can trust that every element of your training has been crafted with precision and expertise.

Is the app free?

There are two versions: free and premium. The free version gives three full workouts (one in every discipline) and an interval round timer (without ads). If you want to unlock all the workouts and other features and exercises, you'll need to upgrade to premium. A monthly subscription costs less than a one-time visit to most gyms.

Do I Need a Punching Bag?

While a heavy bag is helpful, it's not absolutely necessary to be able to train hard with the app. You can use the app to do shadowboxing at home, then already know the combos you want to master on a boxing bag or during sparring when you hit the gym. Tip: For sweaty, challenging kickboxing training and great cardio, try shadowboxing with weights in your hands!

If you're serious about getting a leg up on your competition, you need this boxing app. Not only does it up your motivation with fun, guided punching bag home workouts, but it also helps you master the combos that will outsmart your competition.

it.name: Calorie Counter - Calory AI
it.d:
SIMPLE, EASY & FAST CALORIE COUNTING

Calory is your ultimate calorie counter and a quick way to count, track & tally your calories during the day.

WHY COUNT CALORIES?

Everyone has a personalized number of calories they should eat every day based on factors including their weight, height, activity levels, and weight loss/maintenance/gain goals. It’s hard to track calorie intake, though, not least because it’s easy to forget everything you eat during a busy day. Recording your calories as you eat gives you a clearer picture of the calories you are consuming. It also enhances your awareness of food values and nutrient levels, all of which helps you make healthier choices when eating.

HOW CALORY WORKS

Based on your weight, height and activity level, Calory will calculate a suggested daily calorie goal for you. The daily goal will also factor in if you want to maintain, lose or gain weight.
After you know your daily energy requirements, your challenge is to eat the right number of calories. Calory, meanwhile, will remind you throughout the day to record your calorie intake. Even better, there is no registration or sign up required! All the information you enter into Calory is stored on your iCloud, protecting your privacy.

GREAT CALORY FEATURES
※ Fasting Tracker
※ Quick Value Add: Instantly add calories you have consumed
※ Create custom plates based on your preferences
※ Daily Calorie Intake Calculator: Advised daily intake tailored to your needs
※ Journal View: Alternative home screen to see all of your data at a glance
※ Today Widget: Quickly log favorite plates
※ Siri Shortcuts: Let Siri log your food
※ Apple Watch app: Quick calorie counting on your wrist
※ Apple Health integration: Read/write dietary data to Apple Health
※ Keep track of your weight: Read/write weight from Apple Health
※ Daily history snapshot where you can review your logged meals
※ Weekly, monthly, and yearly progress charts: A fantastic overview that also helps you make comparisons
※ Custom Reminders / Notifications to keep you on track
※ Dark Mode!
※ Multiple theme colors to choose from so you can customize Calory
※ Ability to change the App Icon
※ NO registration or sign up required! All information is stored and kept on your iCloud
※ AI Food Scanning
※ Macro Tracking: Track macronutrient goals
※ Water Tracker: Track your daily water intake needs
※ Create Custom Foods
※ Recipes
※ Barcode food UPC scanning

REMEMBER:
¤ Stay hydrated
¤ Eat whole foods rich in healthy nutrients
¤ Avoid processed foods
¤ Be more active and move!

-------------------------
Auto-renewing Premium Subscription is available (price varies by territory, includes free trial) located on the Upgrade page. Payments will be charged to your iTunes Account after confirmation. Subscription automatically renewed unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed in your iTunes Account’s Settings after purchasing. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

NOTES:
↬ HealthKit (Apple Health) integration support is for read/write dietary calories and weight. No data is being sent outside of your device. Health app access required.
↬ Calory is not a medical app. Suggested calorie intake goal is just an estimate based on your profile. Please consult your health provider if you want to use it for medical purposes or to obtain specific diet needs.

LEGAL

Terms of Use: https://calory.app/terms.html

Whether you are trying to lose weight, gain muscle mass, rounder buttocks or want to get 6-pack abs – our fitness app offers full body workout plans with many 3D workout exercises for free. Here you will find ready workouts with champions’ diets.
You can choose from a variety of exercise plans for muscle groups, such as chest workout or arm workout, or for a certain goal, such as fat burning workout. You can also choose between workout for women, workout for men and get ready workouts with diet.
This fitness application beats other fitness apps, because you can keep your personal workout diary and find the best personal coach from any city for online fitness workouts and bodybuilding sessions. Share your progress, ask questions about workouts, exercises and diet – you will get competent answers. Together you can keep fit at home!

Main advantages of Fitness Online:
-	Ready workouts with a diet plan created by bodybuilding champions who act as coaches.
-	Workout diary: Record your progress with our workout tracker, diet tracker and fitness tracker!
-	In-App Encyclopaedia: Learn more about exercises and diet.
-	Over 850 exercises with high-quality 3D animations.
-	Diet plan: Over 5000 food products with nutrition facts, calorie counter and food tracker.
-	Sports nutrition: Essential additives to your diet for fast muscle building (gain weight).
-	Personal feed: Share workouts, ask questions, meet other users of our community.
-	Direct message our coaches using the in-app chat. Send tips to your friends on how to lose weight, get perfect abs, workout arms and chest, maintain a healthy diet or get a rounder butt through the best buttock exercises.
How does it work?
As a fitness user you can work out by developing your own weight loss program from the exercise library, use our calorie tracker and nutrition guide to create a diet plan and start working out. You can track results in the workout diary. Or choose a ready training program with a diet for your goal, like lifting weights workout, fat loss workout, etc.
You want more? Hire and work out online with a personal coach. Choose your personal trainer by budget and feedback, contact them and set sports goals. Get an invoice, pay with your bank card and start your exercises. 
Your coach will give you a workout plan with individual diet instructions, create a monthly course with a full set of exercises and meal plan to reach your goal, whether that is to get a bigger butt, lose weight, lose belly fat, build muscles, get six-pack abs, get a shredded body, get big arms or a wide chest or get fit after a pregnancy – all with fitness at home.
With a monthly course, such as a weight loss program, your coach will monitor your results for a monthly fee, give advice on your form or meal plan and adjust the exercise program if needed. 
We only invite the best fitness coaches to Fitness Online with knowledge on all working out goals, like trying to get a rounder butt at home, lose weight fast, get six-pack abs, get big arms, get a wide back, build muscles or just define your body.

Most advanced Water Tracker app - downloaded and used by millions of users worldwide!

Based on your body weight (or your personal goal), WaterMinder® will remind you to drink water to reach your daily goals. By seeing current water fill visually and in percents you will instantly know how well you are hydrated!

"A must have - I love this app!!! It reminds me to drink water all day with such a hectic schedule I forget sometimes and this is just a little reminder of how much water you're supposed to drink my skin looks better I feel better must have app!!!"

"Went beyond my expectations - Usually I download these apps and they hardly ever have long shelf life's, but this app is a keeper. The reminder really helps and motivates me to drink water. I also love how visual the accomplishment is. Definitely worth looking into and happily satisfied."

"PERFECT - I absolutely love this app!!!! It really helps if you have kidney problems. I was having bad kidney pains because I wasn't sure how much water to drink in a day so I was only getting about 1/2 if what I was supposed to be getting until now. To the creators., THANK YOU"

"Amazing App! - This is an amazing app. I'm someone who has trouble remembering to drink fluids during the day, I'm more of a snacker. But I found this really helpful since I'm generally dehydrated. I like that it has reminders & how you can see your progress."

"Awesome  -Great for the breast feeding mom."

"Great app - Clean and simple!"

"Love this - Super simple and easy to use, FANTASTIC way to keep up with your hydration, which is oh so important. Plus cool facts to keep you informed and further motivated. Thanks guys!!!"

The only water tracker app you will need!

Keeping track of your daily water intake needs and making sure your body is well hydrated is not an easy task in todays busy world. Let WaterMinder® help you!

Download the best and most customizable women's health tracker on the App Store!

***We take your privacy very seriously! Unlike many other women's health apps, we don't require your email address to sign up and we don't sell or share your personal health data. All proceeds come from your support. It's your Life and it should stay with you!***

---

REVIEWS 
5/5 "Best period tracker ever!!" 
5/5 "Great features, great design" 
5/5 "Beautiful UI, period tracking is all grown up" 
5/5 "Slick, Sexy, & Accurate" 
5/5 "Finally, a sophisticated adult period app" 
5/5 "All I need in one app :)"

---

INNOVATIVE CALENDAR
We weren't satisfied with the methods other apps used to enter women's cycle dates. We went through hundreds of prototypes before we were satisfied with the result. 

PERIOD TRACKER
We wanted a display that was simple yet beautiful. A page that could be viewed with only a passing glance yet still has its own personality. 

OVULATION PREDICTIONS
Viewing your ovulation predictions is fast and easy with our calculator. Gone are the days of information clutter.

IRREGULAR CYCLE SUPPORT
By default, the app defines cycles as irregular if the cycle has a length of less than 21 days or over 36 days but these values are easily personalized to fit your needs within Settings. 

MENSTRUAL HISTORY
The menstrual history was visually optimized to include thoughtful choices with an easy-to-read vertical orientation. 

CYCLE HISTORY 
The days of difficult-to-create reminders are over. Our cycle reminders are easy to create, modify, and set.

SYMPTOM TRACKER 
One of the best features: each symptom can be kept as a separate entry for later analysis or to share with your physician. 

---

it.name: Nerva: Gut-Brain Program
it.d:
Address the miscommunication between your gut and brain. Designed for people living with IBS, functional dyspepsia (FD), GERD, bloating symptoms, and other gut–brain disorders - as well as those seeking additional support alongside IBD care - Nerva is a personalized gut–brain program that supports symptom management through daily sessions, practical tools, and structured guidance.


Target the root cause

Many people spend years cutting out foods in an effort to calm their gut - a difficult path that can miss what’s really driving symptoms. In disorders of gut–brain interaction (DGBIs), the root cause is gut–brain hypersensitivity.

After a trigger like illness, antibiotics, or prolonged stress, the nerves in the gut can become over-reactive. Even once the gut tissue heals, the nervous system may keep the alarm turned up. Normal digestion, gas, or movement are then misread as danger - leading to pain, bloating, reflux, urgency, constipation, or diarrhea.

Diets and medications can reduce symptoms temporarily, but they don’t retrain this signaling system. That’s why symptoms often return or shift over time.

Lasting relief means calming the nervous system and restoring healthy gut–brain communication - where the symptoms actually start.


How Nerva helps

Nerva is a structured gut–brain program that helps you practice brain-gut techniques shown to support a calmer response to gut sensations. Over the program you'll learn to:

- Respond differently to uncomfortable gut signals
- Practice calming the gut–brain stress response
- Build daily habits that support digestive comfort
 

Tailored to you

No two guts are the same. Nerva adapts your program to your symptoms, triggers, and progress - using AI to adjust the coaching and guidance as you go. The sessions, the tools you receive, and the coaching you follow are all shaped around your experience.


Evidence-based

Unlike most apps, Nerva is built on clinical research. In a randomized controlled trial at Monash University, Nerva helped 81% of people significantly manage their gastrointestinal symptoms. Since then, more than 300,000 people have used Nerva, and over 11,000 healthcare providers recommend it.


Features of Nerva

- Daily 15-minute sessions designed to retrain gut-brain miscommunication
- Flare-up tools for pain, bloating, constipation, reflux and diarrhea
- Long-term maintenance plan to keep symptoms under control after the program
- AI personalization to tailor the program to your selected triggers and progress


Who is the team behind Nerva?

Nerva was built by Dr. Simone Peters, GI psychophysiologist, together with clinicians, dietitians, and researchers. Many of us live with gut conditions ourselves. 


Member stories

“Nerva has really worked for me. I’ve been using the app for several months now, and I’ve noticed that I’m experiencing less negative instances with my stomach. I would highly recommend to anyone - absolutely worth the subscription”

Disclaimer: Nerva is a self-guided program that may help people self-manage and live well with a diagnosed disorder of the gut-brain interaction. It is not a substitute for professional medical care, diagnosis, or treatment, and has not been evaluated by the FDA, TGA, MHRA, or equivalent bodies. Do not change prescribed medication or treatment without professional advice. Some content is personalized or generated by AI for educational and wellness purposes only. It is not therapy or mental health care, is not from a licensed professional, and is not monitored in real time. If you are in distress or thinking of harming yourself or others, call your local emergency number right away.



Subscription and trial

7-day free trial
After the trial, your account is charged according to the plan you choose
Subscriptions renew until cancelled
Cancel anytime in iOS Settings, Apple ID, Subscriptions
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.mindsethealth.com/privacy

it.name: Keto diet app－Low carb manager
it.d:
Join over 1,000,000 users achieving their keto and low-carb goals with the ultimate keto diet app!

This keto diet tracker is like having your own personal keto and low-carb nutritionist in the palm of your hand. Whether you are strictly following a keto diet or just cutting back on carbs, losing weight has never been so simple! Keto.app is designed to be the fastest, easiest-to-use macro tracker on the market, helping you hit your keto and fasting goals without the hassle.

Try our keto diet app for free to get your custom meal plan! Upgrading to PRO is only required if you want to log 5+ foods per day—and we offer both flexible subscriptions, including free trial, and a one-time lifetime purchase for those who hate monthly fees.

MEAL PLANS & PERSONALIZATION
• Curated Meal Plans: Take the guesswork out of your diet. Select and follow perfectly tailored meal plans designed for your specific calorie goals and net carb goals. While all options are fundamentally optimized for a keto diet, our extensive selection accommodates various lifestyles—including vegetarian, vegan, bodybuilding, low carb and no carb, among many others.
• AI Day Analysis: Get smart, personalized feedback on your daily logs! Send your day's data to our AI to find out exactly how you are doing (e.g., "You are right on track today, but most of your carbs came from dairy. Try to focus on adding more healthy fats tomorrow").
• Personalized Plan: Enter your body type, goals, and activity level to generate a custom daily macro plan that fits your exact diet style.
• Targeted Advice: View recommended foods to prioritize, and see which foods to avoid to stay on track.

EFFORTLESS TRACKING & RECIPES
• Voice Search: Log your meals instantly using just your voice!
• Massive Food Database: Search our global database for foods, beverages, restaurant items, and pre-packaged products.
• Barcode & Label Scanner: Simply scan a barcode, or use your camera to scan a nutrition label and automatically fill in the macro fields.
• Net Carbs & Fiber Tracking: We automatically subtract sugar alcohols and dietary fiber for your true net carb count. You can even view dedicated charts for your daily fiber consumption—a feature most other trackers miss!
• Keto & Low-Carb Recipes: Access a large library of delicious keto diet and low-carb recipes, featuring ideas for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks, as well as satisfying soups, salads, and desserts, or create and save your own.
• Smart Adjustments: Only ate half your meal? Easily adjust the portion size of logged recipes for accurate macro tracking.
• Fasting Tracker: Track your fasting windows, including popular 16:8 and 18:6 intermittent fasting schedules. 
• Water Tracker: Log your daily water intake to stay hydrated.

it.name: RunGo - The Best Routes to Run
it.d:
Go for a run with voice navigation along the way, explore like a local when you travel, find a runner-friendly hotel, or take on an audio-guided race.

RunGo is the app that gives directions.

We call it "navigation beyond maps."

Looking to find or create and follow a running route?
Hands down, the easiest way to stay on track and enjoy your run is customized, turn-by-turn voice navigation.

RunGo is the most popular running app featuring turn-by-turn voice navigation, with over a million routes worldwide across 171 countries, including thousands of verified routes, like race courses, hotel tours, audio-guided mindful walks, city tours, unique adventures, and virtual races.

Stay engaged with voice messages about landmarks you pass, local stories, or an encouraging reminder that you're halfway there.

Turn any route in an engaging, voice-guided tour!

You're probably beyond trying to memorize every turn, printing out maps, checking your phone’s map every block, or never doing anything new!

RunGo also tracks your run stats like time, pace, distance, elevation, and estimated finish time.

We proudly include no ads in the app, and a paid premium upgrade is available for additional features.

Featured by Apple to "Run New Routes Wherever You Are,” “Walk to Get Fit,”  “Run Your First 5K,” and "Unleash the Power of Apple Watch."

WHAT PEOPLE LIKE YOU SAY
“Only running app with turn-by-turn directions… 30+ turns on new roads that I wasn’t about to memorize.” -iPhone user review
“RunGo was a great way to get a feel of the areas and feel more secure running by myself.” -Jess

WHEN YOU TRAVEL
Running is the best way to explore a city when you travel! With routes around the world, curated by passionate locals showing off the best of their city and by RunGo’s hotel partners, you can enjoy your run at your own pace with voice navigation to keep you on track. Find your next runner-friendly hotel to visit.

WHY VOICE NAVIGATION?
Voice navigation allows you to follow complex routes effortlessly. Explore routes with clear voice directions as you approach each turn, and get notified when you go off route. RunGo is Accessible and supports VoiceOver for visually impaired users.

BUILD YOUR OWN ROUTES
Map out custom routes right on your iPhone, or import a GPX file to RunGo. Create basic routes on your phone, while the full customization is on our web route creator. Any routes you create on the web route creator will also appear on your iPhone.

LIVE TRACKING
RunGo Live lets friends and family track your runs and races in real time on any web browser.

APPLE WATCH
With RunGo’s Apple Watch app, get turn-by-turn directions and haptic notifications on your wrist, and run complex routes without needing your iPhone.

RunGo uses HealthKit for Heart Rate data with the Apple Watch and to record workout data to the Health app.

You can subscribe and pay through your iTunes account. Payment is charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription, where applicable. More information at rungoapp.com/legal

* Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
