it.name: LEMO FM - relax & sleep sound
it.d:
Choose Apple Music songs, playlists, albums, an artist’s top songs, or stations for your sound buttons. Apple Music access is free in LEMO; catalog playback requires Apple Music eligibility. Mixing with built-in ambient sounds uses LEMO Plus.

Plus Mixing Mode: Enable it in Settings to play multiple ambient sounds together and control each sound independently.

LEMO FM is an ultra-simple, elegant white noise App designed to help users achieve better sleep quality, resolve insomnia and anxiety issues and ultimately lead healthier lives. By playing high-definition natural sounds, it allows you to focus, relax, or fall asleep quickly, and achieve a healthier lifestyle and sleep. Under the philosophy of "Less is more," we designed LEMO FM. Its interface is a simple and elegant radio design. When your finger touches the radio button, natural sounds start playing, and the breathing light also starts to flash in and out. These carefully designed interactions allow you to start a journey of sound in a very ritualistic way.

##What can you do with LEMO FM:
 – Sleep – LEMO FM is your sleep assistant, making sleep easier. Natural sounds (like rain, forest sounds, etc.) can help you enter a deep sleep state quickly; if you are a parent needing to soothe your baby, you can also play LEMO FM sounds.
 – Relax – Calm your mood and enter a comfortable, relaxed, and secure state. During mindfulness and meditation, you can open LEMO FM to play white noise to quickly calm down.
 – Focus – It can help you focus for longer periods and work efficiently. The exquisite timer function can even be used as a pomodoro clock, allowing white noise to stop playing on a schedule.
 – Learn - Block out external distractions and immerse and focus more during learning.
Design Philosophy

"LEMO FM" is a white noise App inspired by radios. Its design is just like a real radio, playing a variety of classic, high-quality white noise, such as rain, bonfires, forests, etc. Under the skeuomorphic interface, clicking the button will provide mechanical sound and vibration feedback, just like pressing a real radio button. Skeuomorphism is the most distinctive visual feature of LEMO FM, but behind skeuomorphism, we pursue simplicity and elegance in operation.

##Simulate the texture and operating experience of a real radio
When the sound button is pressed, it emits a crisp sound like a mechanical shutter, and the white noise slowly begins to play. We hope friends who use this "player" can immerse themselves in a ritualistic experience.
##Breathing light effect on the sound button
The faint light on the sound button, simulating the soothing rhythm of human breathing, though not particularly conspicuous, you will notice it with continued use, and even use it as a meditation breathing light.
##"Lifetime Member" Exclusive Unique Number
To make friends who like LEMO FM feel like they own a physical white noise radio, we have designed a unique member number function for lifetime members!
##Beautiful lock screen cover
Devices above iOS 16 support displaying album covers on the phone's lock screen. We have selected particularly beautiful lock screen covers for each sound, leading you into the realm created by the sound.


##Future Function Planning:
 – More rich, high-quality natural sounds, such as the sound of sea tides, the sound of small rivers, etc.;
 – Support Apple system widgets;
 – Support integration with Apple Watch;
 – Adapt to the display effects on iPad's large screen;

Welcome to contact us:
Everyone is welcome to write to us in various ways, your support and suggestions will bring unlimited possibilities to LEMO FM!

Email thelemoapp@gmail.com
Red book @LEMO APP
Instagram @thelemoapp
Looking forward to your letter!

it.name: Sleep Monitor: Sleep Tracker
it.d:
Ever wondered what really happens while you sleep?

Sleep Monitor is your personal sleep companion that helps you discover what happens during the night through sleep recording, sound detection, and detailed sleep insights.

Record snoring, sleep talking, coughing, and other nighttime sounds while tracking your sleep patterns to gain a clearer picture of your sleep and build healthier sleep habits.

Key Features

【Sleep Recording & Sound Detection】

Hear what happened while you slept.

Sleep Monitor records nighttime sounds—including snoring, sleep talking, coughing, and more—so you can review exactly what happened during the night.

【Snore & Sleep Sound Tracking】

See how your nighttime sounds change over time.

Go beyond recording by reviewing snoring trends, breathing patterns, and other sleep sounds to better understand your sleep quality and nighttime habits.

【Sleep Cycle Tracking】

See how your sleep changes throughout the night.

Track your estimated sleep stages, including light sleep, deep sleep, and REM sleep, to gain a better understanding of your overall sleep.

【Detailed Sleep Reports】

See your sleep at a glance.

Review daily, weekly, and monthly sleep reports to track your sleep duration, sleep patterns, and long-term trends over time.

【Sleep Factors Tracking】

Discover what may be affecting your sleep.

Track daily habits such as caffeine intake, late meals, exercise, and other lifestyle factors to see how they may influence your sleep quality.

【Personalized Sleep Improvement】

Build healthier sleep habits with personalized tips.

Follow simple routines, relaxation exercises, and sleep improvement plans designed to help you sleep better, night after night.

【Relaxing Sleep Sounds & Meditation】

Create a peaceful bedtime routine.

Choose from 130+ sleep sounds, white noise, nature sounds, guided meditations, and relaxing music to help you unwind and prepare for sleep.

【Bedtime Reminder & Smart Alarm】

Fall asleep more easily and wake up feeling refreshed.

Set bedtime reminders and gentle alarms designed to help you maintain a healthier sleep schedule.

【Apple Health Integration】

Keep your health data in sync.

Sync with Apple Health for a more complete view of your wellness and sleep information.

Perfect For

• People who snore or have been told they snore at night
• Light sleepers who often wake up feeling tired
• Anyone curious about what happens while they sleep

Subscription Info

• Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
• You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID account settings after purchase.

Medical Disclaimer

The information provided in this app (including text, graphics, and other content) is intended for general wellness purposes only. Sleep Monitor is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. It is not a substitute for professional medical care from a licensed physician or qualified healthcare provider.

• Always consult your physician or healthcare provider regarding your sleep health, existing conditions, or treatment plans.

• Never ignore or delay seeking professional medical advice because of information provided by this app.

it.name: Zing AI: Home & Gym Workouts

Zing is the ultimate AI Coach, revolutionizing fitness with AI-powered, personalized workouts designed by top health and fitness experts. Whether you're a beginner or an advanced athlete, Zing AI Coach adapts to your needs, offering real-time insights and support for a transformative fitness journey.

Advanced AI Coach

The AI Coach engages proactively, suggesting goals, scheduling workouts, and providing real-time form monitoring and feedback. It checks in daily about your energy levels, mood, and sleep, adjusting your workout plan in real-time to ensure continuous improvement.

Zing Vision

Our advanced Zing Vision technology uses your smartphone's camera to track movements in real-time, providing detailed insights to improve your technique.

AI Body Scan

Zing's AI Body Scan analyzes your body composition using your smartphone's camera. Receive insights into body fat, lean mass, and more, integrated into your fitness plan for a hyper-personalized experience. Photos are promptly deleted for privacy.

Hyper-Personalized Plans

Zing creates customized workout plans based on your unique body data, fitness background, and lifestyle. It dynamically adjusts workout intensity and complexity based on your progress, goals, and activity levels. The Strength Score helps you track and enhance your strength training, setting clear goals through increased workout intensity and repetitions.

Dynamic AI Workout Progression

Zing's AI adjusts your workout intensity and complexity continuously. Centralize all your activity data in Zing for detailed fitness insights. Seamlessly integrate with Apple Watch and Apple Health. Track your daily activity, earn milestones, and share achievements with friends for added encouragement.

World-Class Training

Zing Coach generates intuitive workouts from almost 500 exercises, adapting to your preferences and goals. It tracks muscle fatigue levels, ensuring safe and effective training sessions.

Diverse Workout Types

Zing offers various workout types including strength, HIIT, stretching, and recovery, with Pilates and yoga coming soon. Each type is designed to enhance different aspects of fitness, from muscle development and fat burn to flexibility and mind-body connection.

Fitness and Flexibility Tests

Take the Fitness Test to assess your current fitness level and the Flexibility Test to measure your mobility. Get personalized insights for your plan based on your results, and improve them with targeted exercises.

Community and Support

Join a vibrant community of over a million users. Participate in monthly challenges, invite friends to your Fitness Circle, and connect with others in our Facebook group. Zing Coach fosters a supportive environment that celebrates transformation and progress.

Subscription Plans

We offer a wide range of subscription options so that you can choose the right one for you (3 months access renewal, weekly renewal, etc.). For your convenience, subscriptions are set to Auto-Renew within the 24-hour period prior to the subscription end date. You can cancel your subscription at any moment in your iTunes account settings, but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the terms. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at purchase confirmation. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

MyFitCoach gets to know you better with each workout to determine the optimal reps and weights for you, so you get stronger every week.

it.name: MacroFactor Workouts - Tracker
it.d:
MacroFactor Workouts combines innovative coaching algorithms with science-based workout routines customized to your goals, fitness level, and gym equipment.

Effortlessly track your strength training routines with an intuitive workout planner, and easily monitor your PRs and progress with charts and data insights.

MacroFactor Workouts uses progressive overload to automatically adjust your strength training workouts based on your progress, helping you break through plateaus and reach your fitness goals.

No gym? No problem. Create routines based on the equipment you have available in your home gym.

Download to start your 7-day trial of this premium, ad-free workout tracker app.

WORKOUT TRACKER & PLANNER FEATURES

- Effortlessly track your workouts with an intuitive interface
- Hundreds of strength training exercises with helpful tips and cues, and technique videos by Jeff Nippard
- Customizable rest timers
- Plate calculator based on available plates and bars
- Tracker for supersets, partial reps, and myoreps
- RIR tracker
- Smart warm-up planner
- Track different weights and reps on your right and left sides
- Easily swap exercises with smart suggestions
- Create new exercises
- Notes sections for exercise and workout details
- Create gym profiles for each of the places you workout

CUSTOMIZED WORKOUT PLANS

- Get a personalized workout routine based on your goals, fitness level, the gym equipment you have access to, and more
- Built by fitness experts and based on science
- Easily import and track popular Jeff Nippard routines
- Customize your workouts with smart exercise swaps, custom exercises, and more
- Prefer to create your own workouts? Use the workout planner for manual tracking, building, and saving custom routines and workouts

SMART AUTO-PROGRESSION FOR STRENGTH TRAINING

- Your plan automatically adjusts day-to-day based on your progress
- Simply track your strength workouts, and the app will tell you what to do to keep making progress – just like a coach would
- Reach your fitness goals efficiently – no wasted time, no guesswork, no pseudoscience

REACH YOUR FITNESS GOALS

- See your progress over time with beautiful and functional charts, visuals, and graphs
- Easily access your workout history
- PR tracker
- Volume tracker
- Progress photos and body metrics tracker
- Design your dashboard to feature the insights you value most


SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS

MacroFactor Workouts is a premium strength training and planner app that offers three auto-renewing subscription options:

$11.99 / month
$47.99 / half year
$71.99 / year (equal to $5.99 a month)

MacroFactor Workouts has a free trial, but does not offer a free subscription tier.

These prices are for US customers. Pricing in other countries may vary. Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase.

Your subscription to MacroFactor Workouts will automatically renew, unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can cancel or manage your subscription from your Apple account settings.

it.name: Calisteniapp: Fit & Strong
it.d:
Transform your body with Calisteniapp, the calisthenics app that adapts training to your level and helps you make real progress.

Build strength, gain muscle, and improve your physique with programs created by professionals, routines that evolve with you, and safe progressions for exercises like pull-ups, handstands, and muscle-ups.

Over 700 exercises, workouts at home or outdoors, and an intelligent system that adjusts training load based on your performance so you can keep progressing without plateaus.

Start training with purpose and stop improvising.


WHAT IS CALISTENIAPP?

Calisteniapp is the calisthenics app that guides you step by step so you can progress safely, even if you’re starting from zero.

Train wherever you want, with or without equipment, and move forward with clear progressions and workouts that evolve with you.

When you start, the app recommends a program based on your level and goal (strength, muscle gain, aesthetics, weight loss, or skills).


WHAT WILL YOU FIND?

► 40+ step-by-step guided training programs

► Skills & tricks: achieve your first pull-up, handstand, muscle-up, front lever, push-ups, back lever, planche, or human flag with guided tutorials

► Stats & tracking: access a workout calendar with session logs or check the muscle map to see which muscle groups you train the most

► Workout builder: create custom routines based on your goal, available time, and exercises

► EVO routines: a more flexible training method that adjusts daily load based on your performance, allowing safe progress without rigid plans

► Challenges: join 21-day training challenges to build strong habits

► Achievements to reward your progress


WHO IS IT FOR?

• Beginners: if you’re starting from scratch, you’ll find fully guided workouts to achieve your first progressions

• Intermediate users: access advanced plans and create your own routines to organize your training calendar

• Physical test preparation: Calisteniapp can help you prepare for fitness exams and physical assessments


WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT?

• Complete calisthenics training for any goal:

	• Build strength and muscle
	• Lose weight
	• Improve your physique and body control
	• Learn new skills (handstand, muscle-up, front lever, etc.)
	• Improve mobility and flexibility
	• Boost endurance and cardio

• Measurable results: track sessions and optimize your progress

• Flexibility: train at home, in the park, or at the gym, with or without a pull-up bar

• Safe calisthenics progressions, step by step

• Continuous improvement: we’re a small, dedicated team improving the app every day


FAQ - FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Can I train without equipment?
Yes. You can train at home using only your bodyweight. If you have a pull-up bar or access to calisthenics bars, you’ll unlock more exercise variations and goals.

Is it suitable for beginners?
Absolutely. The system suggests a calisthenics program based on your level, and the adaptive routines adjust training load to your abilities.

How is progress tracked?
You’ll have a training calendar with weekly and monthly stats, plus a muscle map showing which muscle groups you’ve worked the most.


PRO SUBSCRIPTION

• Calisteniapp includes free calisthenics routines to get started: 500+ individual routines available for free, with unlimited workout sessions.

• With the PRO subscription, you unlock all programs, challenges, EVO routines, and advanced metrics.

it.name: Alpha Progression Gym Tracker
it.d:
Stop guessing. Pro builds your plan and recommends weight and reps for every set, adapting to how strong you are today. Free logging, no account. 14-day free trial.

Alpha Progression tells you exactly what to lift. Every set, every workout. Build your plan in a minute, then follow weight and rep recommendations that adapt to how strong you are today.

Most gym apps only record what you did. Alpha Progression plans what you should do next: a science-based training plan built for your goal, your experience and your equipment, and a progression recommendation for every single set.

App of the Day on the App Store, twice. 4.9 stars from 40,000+ lifters. 25 million workouts logged.

YOUR PLAN, GENERATED
Pick your goal, the days you can train, how long you have and which muscles to prioritize. The plan generator builds a complete plan around the equipment in your gym: split, exercises, sets and rep ranges. Beginners and advanced lifters get fundamentally different plans, because they need different things. Every detail stays editable, or build your own plan from scratch. Need just one session? The workout generator creates a one-off workout whenever you want.

A RECOMMENDATION FOR EVERY SET
Before each set, the app shows the weight and reps to go for, based on your previous workouts and what you have already done today. Recommendations shift from set to set because fatigue is real: set 3 is not set 1. Keep hitting them and they keep climbing. Progressive overload without spreadsheets or guesswork.

LOG FAST, STAY IN THE ZONE
Weight, reps and RIR in two taps, with your notes and your last sets in view. Rest timer as a Live Activity, so the countdown and your next set sit on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island. Supersets, dropsets, bodyweight, assisted and timed exercises. Works fully offline.

795 EXERCISES, REAL VIDEOS
Every exercise filmed in a real gym with certified trainers. No stock footage, no animations. Setup, execution and cues for each one, plus an exercise evaluation of how well it builds muscle. Filter by muscle, equipment and compound vs isolation. Missing an exercise? Add your own, with a photo from your library or the camera, or copy an existing one as a starting point.

SEE WHAT IMPROVED
After every workout you see every record you beat: weight, reps, volume, estimated 1RM and 10RM, best per muscle group. Charts for strength, volume, sets per muscle, workouts per week, bodyweight and measurements. Streaks and achievements keep you showing up.

AND MORE
Warm-up calculator: warm-up sets are added automatically, scaled to the exercise, your first working set and the weights you have. Plate calculator: exactly which plates to load, or the closest weight below if your plates don't add up. Multiple gyms, each with its own equipment and weights; switch with one tap and your recommendations adjust. Periodization and deloads: ramp sets and effort (RIR) week by week and schedule deloads. Share plans with friends or coaching clients. Export everything as CSV. kg and lb, even mixed. An optional account syncs all your devices. Syncs with Apple Health.

FREE VS PRO
Free: unlimited workout logging, all 795 exercise videos, your own plans, measurements, rest timer, records, achievements, plan sharing and CSV export. No ads. No account required.
Pro: plan generator and workout generator, progression recommendations, charts, multiple gyms, periodization and deloads, plate calculator, warm-up calculator, exercise evaluations and images for custom exercises. 14-day free trial on the yearly plan.

Built by lifters: certified trainers with bodybuilding experience who train with the app every week. Questions? info@alphaprogression.com

it.name: Yogger: Movement Analysis
it.d:
Yogger measures human movement from video. Record a movement or upload an existing video to calculate joint angles, range of motion, movement quality, and standardized movement assessments using only a mobile device.

Whether you're a physical therapist, chiropractor, athletic trainer, sports medicine professional, strength coach, personal trainer, or performance coach, Yogger helps you objectively measure movement, improve technique, monitor rehabilitation progress, and communicate results with clients.

PROFESSIONAL MOVEMENT ANALYSIS

Record or upload a video and instantly perform markerless 3D motion analysis using your mobile device.

Measure:

- Joint angles
- Range of motion (ROM)
- Joint paths
- Movement symmetry
- Biomechanical performance
- Functional movement quality

Review movement frame-by-frame or in slow motion while tracking body landmarks automatically.

RANGE OF MOTION MEASUREMENT

Instantly calculate objective range of motion from video, including:

- Shoulder Flexion, Extension, Abduction, Adduction, Internal & External Rotation
- Hip Flexion, Extension, Abduction, Adduction, Internal & External Rotation
- Knee Flexion & Extension
- Elbow Flexion & Extension
- Ankle Dorsiflexion & Plantarflexion
- Neck Mobility
- Trunk Rotation & Flexion

Ideal for rehabilitation, return-to-play testing, mobility assessments, and sports performance.

AUTOMATED MOVEMENT ASSESSMENTS

Complete movement screenings in minutes using only your phone.

Assessments include:

- Overhead Squat
- Single Leg Squat
- Lunge
- Posture Assessment
- Neck Mobility
- Shoulder Mobility
- Hip Mobility
- Trunk Mobility

Perfect for establishing baselines, tracking progress, and identifying movement limitations.

VIDEO ANALYSIS TOOLS

Coach movement with powerful analysis features including:

- Automatic joint tracking
- Frame-by-frame playback
- Slow motion review
- Side-by-side video comparison
- Drawing and annotation tools
- Voice-over feedback
- Joint path visualization
- Instant measurement overlays

Whether you're analyzing running, lifting, throwing, jumping, golf, baseball, CrossFit, or rehabilitation exercises, Yogger provides objective data to support better decisions.

TRACK PROGRESS

Monitor changes over time by saving:

- Movement assessments
- Range of motion measurements
- Video analyses
- Progress notes
- Photos
- Historical reports

Visualize improvements and compare sessions to measure recovery and performance gains.

PROFESSIONAL REPORTS

Generate polished PDF reports that include:

- Assessment scores
- Range of motion measurements
- Images
- Movement summaries
- Progress tracking
- Clinical notes

Share reports with athletes, patients, clients, physicians, or other healthcare providers.

BUILT FOR

- Physical Therapists
- Chiropractors
- Athletic Trainers
- Sports Medicine Clinics
- Occupational Therapists
- Strength & Conditioning Coaches
- Personal Trainers
- Performance Coaches
- Running Coaches
- Fitness Professionals
- Athletes

Yogger makes professional-quality movement analysis accessible from any smartphone. Whether you're improving athletic performance, tracking rehabilitation, performing movement screenings, or measuring range of motion, Yogger delivers fast, objective movement analysis wherever you work.

Stepz is a convenient step counter app that leverages the clever Apple Motion Coprocessor which collects your motion data automatically in the background while saving battery life. This simple pedometer app has been specifically developed for the iPhone and Apple Watch.
Do you move enough throughout the day? Learn more about your daily activity and get fit by reaching your step goal! To provide you with a complete overview of your fitness progress, Stepz can import all your past steps from the Apple Health app.
Stepz respects your privacy: all your personal fitness data is stored internally on your device and never shared via a network connection without your explicit consent.
* Featured by Apple on the App Store Home Page under Best New Apps in 22 countries (April 2015) *

- Full Apple Health integration
- Automatically records your steps
- Very accurate and no GPS needed
- Runs in the background with very low battery drain
- Daily, weekly, monthly, yearly and hourly step values
- Distance calculation
- Set your daily step goal

- Connect with your friends

Caliber is a science-based strength training app that combines resistance training, cardio, nutrition, and habit formation to help you build muscle, lose weight, and improve your overall fitness - for good.

TRAIN YOUR WAY

• Free Version. Create and track unlimited workouts, access 800+ exercises, and train solo or with friends.

• Caliber Plus. Maximize your results with coach-designed training plans, personalized progress tracking, nutrition targets and more.

• Premium Coaching. Get 1-on-1 guidance from an elite-level personal trainer with a fully customized training and nutrition plan, in-app chat + video messaging with your coach and weekly progress reviews to keep you on track.

CALIBER FEATURES (FREE VERSION)

• Personalized Workouts. Create and track an unlimited number of workouts tailored to your goals. No gym required.

• Detailed Exercise Tutorials. Learn proper form with step-by-step videos and pro tips from Caliber coaches.

• Workout Circles. Train with friends and family in private workout chats. When you hit a personal best, it's shared with the group.

• Apple Health Integration. Sync your cardio, nutrition, steps and body stats from your wearable or connected device.

• Connect to AI. Sync your training data with ChatGPT and Claude for personalized insights and training analysis.

UNLOCK MORE WITH CALIBER PLUS (OPTIONAL UPGRADE)

• Coach-Designed Training Plans. Choose from 120+ structured plans tailored to your goals, experience level and schedule.

• Strength Score. Measure how strong you are relative to your potential for your age and gender.

• Strength Balance. Improve your posture and mobility by optimizing your training across key muscle groups.

• Caliber Lessons. Gain expert insights on training and nutrition to accelerate your progress.

• Advanced Training Features. Get personalized nutrition targets, create custom exercises and supersets, swap exercises, upload progress photos, and more.

PREMIUM COACHING (OPTIONAL UPGRADE)

• Work with an Elite-Level Coach. Train 1-on-1 with a dedicated coach to achieve your full potential in the gym and beyond. Caliber coaches are highly vetted, accredited personal trainers among the top 1% in their field.

• Fully Personalized Plan. Your coach will design a training and nutrition program just for you based on your goals, experience and lifestyle.

• Daily Motivation & Expert Guidance. Stay on track with in-app messaging, video form reviews, and individualized guidance.

• Weekly Progress Reviews. Get in-depth analysis from your coach to optimize your training.

• Fast Response Times. Your coach is available 24/7, typically replying within a few hours.

• Guaranteed Results. On average, Caliber members improve their body composition by 20% or more within 12 weeks. If you don't see results, we'll refund the cost of the program.

SEE WHAT OUR MEMBERS SAY

• For detailed reviews from real Caliber members, visit our TrustPilot page at https://www.trustpilot.com/review/caliberstrong.com

name: Pedometer
desc: Are you looking for a reliable and feature-rich pedometer app to help you stay on top of your fitness goals? Look no further than Pedome

it.name: Pedometer++
it.d:
Available on the iPhone and Apple Watch, Pedometer++ is the best way to review your step count, walking distance, active calories, and heart rate data. 

Set a custom step count goal and track your progress over time. The built-in graphs make reviewing your data easy and fun. Everyone loves awards, and Pedometer++ includes a range of Badges to motivate and reward your hard work! The app also totals how far you’ve walked each day, and even counts the flights of stairs you encounter each day.

With full-featured widget support, Pedometer++ can display your step count or update you on your daily progress right from your iPhone's lock screen or home screen. You can also share your workouts with others and view trends over time.

The Apple Watch app puts all this data on your wrist. With a wide range of Complications, it’s easy to check your progress with just a glance. Add a single Complication to your daily watch face, or add several to build a comprehensive fitness-focused look! 

DETAILS:
For best results, keep your iPhone on you as you move throughout the day, ideally in a pocket close to your hips. If you have an Apple Watch, you can set Pedometer++ to sync step data across your devices for the most accurate data possible.

The Apple Watch app can also start and track indoor and outdoor walking and running workouts and can serve as your guide while hiking.


ROUTES & MAPPING:
Pedometer++ is your ultimate companion for exploring the great outdoors. It allows you to import GPX files for waypoints and routes set by others. 

You can also use the app to create your own routes. Simply tap on your desired start and end points, and Pedometer++ will find the shortest route between them. You can then tweak the route based on terrain, trail popularity, or personal preference. 

Pedometer++ shows the distance of a route, the elevation changes you will encounter, and the estimated time it will take you to reach your destination. You can also monitor the weather that is expected along your route.

The best part is that custom routing is available on the iPhone and Apple Watch. Of course, being out in nature often means losing cell service, so Pedometer++ allows you to download offline map data for large areas, not just for your specific route. Offline map data is also available on the iPhone and Apple Watch, as long as your Watch is within range of your phone.


NOTES:
Pedometer++ integrates with the Apple Health app to collect and display step data collected by your Apple Watch. 

Pedometer++ includes an optional premium subscription. This is offered on a monthly or annual basis. If you choose to purchase a subscription, your payment will be charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled within 24 hours before the end of the current period. After purchase, you can turn off auto-renewal anytime by going to your Account Settings on the App Store.

Access to iPhone-based workout tracking is only available to Pedometer++ Premium subscribers.


LEARN MORE:

Terms of Use: https://pedometer.app/terms

it.name: Yana: Cozy Self-Care
it.d:
This is the new Yana: the emotional companion you know, renewed to be with you on good days and not-so-good ones. She helps you check in with your feelings, care for yourself at your own pace and grow your inner world.

Every day, Yana asks how you feel, and your world reflects it: clouds, rain, sunshine, a rainbow, under a sky that follows the real time of day. Check in, do small acts of care and build a home that feels like you. And whenever you want to talk about anything, Yana is one tap away.

A few minutes a day

Most of us only make time for ourselves when something already hurts. But emotional wellbeing is built a little at a time, on ordinary days too. Yana turns a few minutes a day into something you look forward to: a check-in, a small routine and a world that grows with you. That way, when a hard day comes, you’re not starting from zero.

Think of it like a gym: the music and the lights aren’t the reason you go, but they make you want to come back. That’s why Yana is a game. The play is there so taking care of yourself feels like something you want to do, not something you have to.

How it works

• Check in: tell Yana how you feel in a few taps, put a name to the feeling and watch your world reflect it. Add a note or a few tags, and your check-ins become a mood journal.
• Small acts of care: get a short routine of everyday activities picked for how you feel today, like stretching, drinking a glass of water or sending a kind message to a loved one.
• Earn acorns: every check-in, affirmation and activity earns acorns.
• Make it home: spend your acorns to decorate with furniture, plants and decor. Mix styles, pick colors and make every corner yours.
• Talk with Yana: tap her armchair and chat about your day, the big things and the small ones. Yana is an AI companion, here whenever you want to talk.
• A kind word: reveal a daily affirmation chosen for how you feel.
• Look back: your mood history keeps every check-in, so you can see how your days and weeks have felt.

Why Yana

• A mood journal, a habit builder and a cozy world to care for, all in one place.
• Every feeling belongs. Rain is as welcome here as sunshine.
• No guilt, no pressure. Miss a day and Yana is simply happy to see you again.
• A check-in takes just a few taps. Some days, that's all it needs to be.
• Every decoration can be earned through daily care. No purchase needed to decorate your home.

Free to use

Your world, your check-ins, your activities and your affirmations are all free. Chatting with Yana is free for your first 50 messages, and Yana Premium (monthly or annual subscription) unlocks unlimited chat. Acorn packs are completely optional, just in case you’d like to decorate faster.

Knew Yana before?

Welcome back. This is a big change, and some of the things you used aren't part of this version for now, like streaks, meditations and the community. Your chats and mood history are safe: log in with your account and you'll find them right where you left them. For the details, visit yana.ai/faq.

Privacy

Your privacy matters to us. Your conversations are kept separate from your identity, and we never sell your personal data.

it.name: 365Scores: Live Sports Scores
it.d:
365Scores is a customizable live sports scores app that lets fans build a personal feed around the teams, leagues, and matches they care about - with instant alerts, in-depth stats, and highlights along the way. Covers the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, UEFA Champions League, Premier League, and 2,000+ competitions across 9 sports.
Join over 150 million sports fans who rely on 365Scores to follow the game their way.

* 365SCORES HELPS YOU FOLLOW SEVERAL GAMES AT ONCE
Build a personalized My Scores list with the exact teams, leagues, and games you want, and get real-time updates for all of them at once. Remove anything you don't need, so your feed stays focused - not cluttered.

* SET ALERTS YOUR WAY
Choose exactly what triggers a notification - goals, touchdowns, red cards, VAR reviews, lineup announcements, and more - down to the specific game event.

* LIGHTNING-FAST GAME ALERTS
Stay updated with instant game alerts the moment something happens. Warning! Our live notifications may be faster than your game stream.

* LIVE MATCH TRACKER
Watch the match unfold like you're right there - see who's attacking, corners, fouls, and live stats update in real time on our visual Live Match Tracker, even when you can't watch the game itself.

* PROBABLE & CONFIRMED LINEUPS
See probable lineups ahead of kickoff, then get the confirmed starting XI, substitutes, and formations as soon as they're announced - know who's playing before the match begins.

* IN-DEPTH MATCH STATS
Go beyond the score with Heatmaps, xG (expected goals), and Head-to-Head history. Track top stats like shots, possession, and big chances created, plus detailed breakdowns of passes, defense, duels, and discipline (fouls and cards).

* PRE-GAME STATS
Get a competitive edge with comprehensive pre-game stats, including each team's last-game results (goals, xG, shots, and more), head-to-head records, and recent form to help you prepare for every game.

* TEAM NEWS & STATS
No matter which team you support, 365Scores delivers live scores, sports news, roster updates, real-time stats, standings, transfer updates, and social media buzz.

* HIGHLIGHTS FOR TOP LEAGUES
Catch up on highlights and key game moments for major leagues and tournaments, right after the final whistle.

* FOLLOW BIGGEST LEAGUES AND COMPETITIONS WITH 365SCORES
Track the MLS, English Premier League, LaLiga, Champions League, NBA, NFL, MLB, Wimbledon, and 2,000+ competitions across 10 sports, including football, basketball, and tennis - all in one live scores app.

• Soccer – Premier League, UEFA Champions League, LaLiga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, MLS

• Football – NFL, NCAA

• Basketball – NBA, EuroLeague

• Baseball – MLB

• Ice Hockey – NHL

• Tennis – ATP Tour, WTA Tour, Grand Slams (Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon, US Open)

• Handball, Rugby, Volleyball, and more - 2,000+ competitions across 9 sports in total.

* LIVE SOCCER RESULTS
Get all the latest soccer news and updates, right at your fingertips! Follow your favorite teams - from global giants like Real Madrid, Manchester City, and Liverpool to top MLS clubs like Inter Miami and LAFC.

* NBA & NHL COVERAGE
Track your favorite basketball and hockey teams - from the Lakers, Celtics, and Warriors to the Rangers, Bruins, and Maple Leafs - with live scores, standings, and real-time stats all season long.

* EXCLUSIVE iOS FEATURES
Home Screen Widget – view your personalized My Scores list, live and upcoming, right on your home screen.

* LIVE ACTIVITIES ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
See real-time scores, shots on goal, xG, and possession for both teams directly on your lock screen - even when your phone is locked.

Download 365Scores now and never miss a moment.

it.d:
Introducing "Shapy" - Your Ultimate Fitness App!

Wherever you are - at the gym, office, home, or enjoying the great outdoors - "Shapy" acts as your personal trainer, available anytime and anywhere. It goes beyond providing workout plans by creating and customizing meal plans tailored to your needs, guiding you towards weight loss, fat burning, or maintaining a healthy lifestyle. The app caters to your unique preferences and dietary habits, offering premium features designed specifically for you. With hundreds of recipes and regular additions, you'll never run out of options.

Join the thousands of satisfied customers who have rated "Shapy" 5 stars and left enthusiastic reviews on the App Store.

Key Features of "Shapy":

Diverse Workout Programs: Choose from a wide variety of exercises and workout plans that vary in length and intensity. No special equipment is required; all you need is dedication and resolve. Our research and science-based routines help you build endurance and flexibility.

Personalized Workouts: "Shapy" offers workouts tailored to your schedule, fitness level, and goals. Whether you want to target abs, arms, chest, back, buttocks, or legs, our workouts cover all muscle groups.

Comprehensive Meal Plans: Enhance the benefits of regular workouts with well-balanced and sensible meal plans based on your dietary habits and needs. We'll accompany you every step of the way to a healthier, fitter you.

Instructive Videos: Our videos demonstrate each exercise step-by-step, ensuring you maintain proper form and technique. We provide valuable tips to help you execute each exercise correctly.

Reminders and Motivation: "Shapy" sends you reminders and motivating messages to keep you on track with your training and healthy diet.

Integration with HealthKit: Seamlessly import body measurement data such as gender, age, weight, and height using the integration with Apple Health. You can easily fill out your information and synchronize it with "Shapy." The synchronization with Apple Health can be disabled in the app's settings.

Shapy Premium Subscription. Choose the subscription duration that suits your needs for unlimited access to all levels of fitness plans, extra workout routines, and premium features. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

Start your fitness journey today with "Shapy," your ultimate companion for achieving your fitness goals and maintaining a healthy lifestyle. Take action now and begin your incredible journey with "Shapy"! Download the app today and experience amazing results for yourself!

it.d:
Rashaqa is an app for health and wellness

Rashaqa is an all-in-one health and fitness app that offers several advantages to its users. Among its features, the Calories Scanner stands out as a powerful tool for managing your diet and achieving your health goals. Here’s what you need to know:
Calorie Tracking:
Rashaqa provides you with a calorie tracker program for all your meals. Whether you’re following a specific diet plan, practicing intermittent fasting, or simply aiming for weight loss, this feature has you covered.
By accurately calculating the calories for each meal you consume, Rashaqa helps you stay on track with your dietary goals.
It also includes easy and quick healthy recipes suitable for various diets.
Healthy Diet Plans:
Specify your goal—whether it’s weight gain, weight loss, or muscle building—and Rashaqa will choose an appropriate meal plan for your health condition.
These meal plans have been thoughtfully developed by nutritionists who specialize in creating healthy diets tailored to individual needs.
With over 400 meal plans, you can customize your food choices and track your intake effectively.
Home Workouts:
Rashaqa offers a comprehensive home workout service. You’ll have your virtual fitness coach guiding you through fat-burning exercises.
Whether you’re aiming for weight loss or overall fitness, these home workouts are designed to help you achieve your goals.
Make the most of your fitness time with Rashaqa’s exercise plans. 
Steps Counter (Pedometer):
Rashaqa walks with you step by step, tracking and recording your steps and statistics.
Whether you’re walking or running, every step counts toward your overall activity level.
Water Alarm:
Staying hydrated is crucial during workouts. Rashaqa reminds you to drink water regularly to replenish lost fluids.
The app determines the appropriate water intake based on your weight and daily needs.
Additional Exercises:
Rashaqa provides various exercise options, including:
Treadmill: Calculate your steps using the step counter during treadmill workouts.
Stationary Bike: Burn calories and lose weight with fat-burning exercises at home.
Running in Place: A simple yet effective home exercise for weight loss.
In summary, Rashaqa combines calorie tracking, diet planning, home workouts, and step counting—all in one convenient app. Transform your health today with Rashaqa!

---

* Privacy Policy: https://rashaqa.net/privacy.html
* Terms of Use: https://rashaqa.net/TermsandConditions.html

it.name: Floraya: Emotional Support
it.d:
Floraya aims to help people move through life’s difficult moments faster and easier. You’ll receive tenderness, human warmth, advice, and moral support every day.

To achieve this, a team of experienced psychotherapists created the Floraya app's core program. This program combines approaches from cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), existential therapy, acceptance and commitment therapy, and client-centered therapy, all blended with gentle and empathetic acceptance. The app's voice acts as a unique blend of friend, muse, therapist, and loyal admirer, offering the most significant words everyone wishes to hear about themselves. It is a source of recognition for one's abilities, qualities, tenderness, and care, serving as a key to good mood and emotional well-being.

FLORAYA FEATURES

* Emotional support – the therapy provides warm, understanding, and supportive interactions.
* Acceptance and unconditional recognition – the therapy focuses on accepting the client as they are, free of judgment.
* Warmth and care – a sense of safety and comfort is created during the interaction.
* Help in tough moments – the therapy helps clients cope with life's current challenges without pressure or intense changes.
* Psychological guidance – ongoing support on the path to personal growth and overcoming stress.
* Enhancing mental well-being – the therapy aims to improve well-being and maintain a stable mental state.
* Support in decision-making – helping clients find their own solutions and understand their needs.
* Reducing anxiety and stress – gentle techniques and support help lower anxiety levels.
* Empathy, tenderness, and warmth – the emphasis is on a caring, understanding approach.

Floraya also takes care of your health by offering guided meditation programs designed to tackle current issues. These meditations help you cope with stress, fear, anxiety, loneliness, increase your self-confidence, and much more.

For relaxation, Floraya transports you to a personal virtual world with customizable soundscapes. Explore hundreds of natural and imagined places to find calm, relax before bed, focus, or enjoy the peace of nature.

Mental Health Supportive Therapy creates a space where listeners feel accepted and supported, which contributes to strengthening their mental health and improving their quality of life.

Disclaimer: This app is not a substitute for professional mental health care. Always consult a licensed mental health professional.

– Payments are charged to your Apple ID once your purchase is confirmed.
– The subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
– You can manage and cancel subscriptions in their account settings on the App Store.

it.name: Gratitude: Self-Care Journal
it.d:
The Gratitude app is a carefully-designed self-care tool to help you focus on your mental health.

With a gratitude journal, affirmations, vision board, and daily motivation content, Gratitude provides you with all the tools and reminders you need to gain motivation and develop a healthy self-love routine in your life. 
 
To live a happy and fulfilling life, it is important for us to have good mental health and a strong sense of self-love.

And, as the app is completely private, you can always be assured that your precious journal entries, affirmations, and vision board are for your eyes only.

Here are the tools that you will find in the Gratitude app:

1. GRATITUDE JOURNAL

A gratitude journal or diary opens up your eyes to reflect on all the little blessings in your life.

In daily life, we can lose sight of what we are fortunate to have and by keeping a journal you can slowly and steadily shift your perspective to focus on what is good in your life.

The Gratitude app will send you reminders with prompts to help you build the habit of journaling.

You can also add photos to your journal entries and can record journals in your voice, build a gratitude journal streak, and access hundreds of journal prompts. 

2. POSITIVE AFFIRMATIONS

If you’ve heard about manifestation or the law of attraction, you’ve probably heard about affirmations.

Positive daily affirmations change our self-talk to focus on more loving and kind thoughts towards ourselves.

They give us the motivation we need to keep moving forward and believe in ourselves.

The Gratitude app has hundreds of affirmations that you can listen to or read, as per your need.

You can also write your own affirmations, add music, and record your voice to them.

Positive affirmations are a dearly loved tool and with this affirmations app, it is very easy for you to practice them.

3. CREATE VISION BOARDS

Another super popular manifestation tool is a vision board, also called a dream board. The vision board serves as a collage of your dreams and goals in the form of photos, quotes, and affirmations.

In the Gratitude app, we’ll help you make a great vision board using sections, goal ideas, and create a video of all your goals together with music. You can also make multiple vision boards!

4. DAILY ZEN

We understand the need for motivation and inspiration as you build a healthy routine with these self-help tools, which is why Daily Zen is an important part of the app.

Here, you will find gratitude quotes, motivation quotes, thought switch ideas, thank you cards, affirmations, blog articles, and real-life stories of people who changed their mindset with gratitude.

5. MINDFUL MINUTES

We define the Mindful minutes as the time that you spend in the Gratitude app. You can view the mindful minutes under 'All Health Data' section in the Health app provided by Apple. Currently, the app does not read any data from the health app. We don't write any data in the health app without your consent. You can turn on the mindful minutes from the profile & settings in the Gratitude app.

it.name: Rootd: Panic Attacks & Anxiety
it.d:
** Editor's Choice ** — Apple
** App of the Day ** — Apple
** Approved for privacy, security, clinical assurance, and safety ** —  DHAF & ORCHA

Rootd is anxiety and panic attack relief in your pocket. Award-winning, scientifically validated, female led and seen in Women's Health, Time Magazine, Healthline and more. With millions of users worldwide, Rootd is the go-to app for anxiety & panic attacks for more and more people each day.

“I’ve suffered from panic attacks for almost 10 years. I’ve done CBT, medication, meditation, but nothing helped me in the moment when that panic attack hit, until I downloaded Rootd. Rootd makes it feel like someone is with me, even when I’m alone. I owe my continued stability to this simple genius app. It's a MUST for all who are facing the same type of war.” RainyNally

Understand, and overcome anxiety & panic attacks with Rootd’s therapist-approved panic button, guided deep breathing, anxiety journal, soothing visualizations, stats page, emergency contact, and lessons. 

We set out to build Rootd after suffering from panic attacks and anxiety for several years. The only help we could find was either too expensive, ineffective, or poorly designed. Our mission is to help others find accessible relief from their panic and anxiety, and to end the stigma against those affected. 

Finally, an app for conquering panic attacks and anxiety that blends a guided process for both immediate and long term relief, with clean and engaging design.  

Rootd’s core features and content include:

THE ROOTR, PANIC ATTACK SOS BUTTON
A panic button to bring a swift end to panic attacks based on the latest techniques in Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT).

LESSONS
Find some peace of mind by learning about where anxiety comes from, how our bodies and minds experience panic attacks, and why this all might be happening to you.

BREATHE
The perfect tool to practice deep breathing daily and find calm during times of stress.

JOURNAL
Track and identify moods, habits, and subconscious triggers of anxiety and panic attacks.

VISUALIZE
Guided body scans, visualizations, ASMR, and nature sounds to get rooted when feeling anxious.

SLEEP
White noise, ASMR, sleep stories, relaxing sounds, and music for you to gain calm and sleep deeply.

EMERGENCY CONTACT
For when you need to hear a friendly voice, you can immediately call a friend, family member, or nearby help center directly from the app. 

PERSONAL STATS
Take pride in your healing progress and gain appreciation for how far you’ve come.

To continue your journey, you can upgrade to unlock Full Access to Rootd, including:

MORE LESSONS
Learn changes you can make and exercises you can perform to guide you through the remainder of the journey to lifelong relief and to living panic attack free.

Rootd saves your Breathe, Visualize, and Sleep sessions to your Apple Health app.

Subscription Pricing and Terms

Get full access to all Rootd's content and features by purchasing a monthly or yearly auto-renewing Full Access subscription. Or get lifetime full access for a one-time payment. Pricing may vary by country.

Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your Rootd subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal turned off any time from your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.

“I appreciate the simple, factual, and yet caring approach of Rootd that makes it an inviting, interesting, and easy to use tool. I endorse this for individuals looking for support and tools for managing anxiety and panic attacks.”
Wendy Marion-Orienti - Licensed PRH counsellor

it.name: Dtd Sounds：Mood White Noise
it.d:
As (mostly) students or working people, we understand how difficult it can be to sit at a desk and focus. Especially when you have to set music and timers on three different devices or websites while being bombarded with advertisements, maybe you need another productivity tool to help you stay focused.

We created Dtd Sounds to help you solve this problem and finally have a personal, companionable, quiet digital space to work, study or relax. Our goal is to make working, studying, and relaxing less stressful by getting out of the room and staying focused.

Open Dtd Sounds and there's a lazy, drowsy kitten on your desktop, snoring, and it's drizzling outside your window (if it's raining in your city).
Of course, you can open the window and look around if you want, take a deep breath, and come back.

Core features:

⊙ Real-time weather system, so you can check the weather in real time from your room
⊙ 5 commonly used situational sound mixes, add combinations freely
⊙ More than 70 groups of pre-made sound combinations, free switching


Dtd Sounds - Helps you get the best out of multiple situations:

⊙ Focus - Boost your concentration and manage your work and study time effectively with the precision timer function. Our timer function can be used as a tomato clock to ensure you take breaks at the right time to stay productive.
⊙ Relaxation - puts you in a state of calm and joyful relaxation, creating a serene environment for meditation and positive thinking. Activate Dtd Sounds and enjoy white noise for instant calming and inner balance.
⊙ Learning - Eliminate external distractions and engage in your studies. Dtd Sounds allows you to immerse yourself in your studies.
⊙ Work - Dtd Sounds is your work assistant, accompanying you to work better and clicking the window to step outside for a different view.
⊙ Sleep - Dtd Sounds is your sleep assistant, helping to make sleep easier. Nature sounds (rain, forest sounds, etc.) can help you fall into a deep sleep quickly; if you are a parent and need to lull your baby to sleep, you can also play the sounds of Dtd Sounds.


Advanced Features:

Dtd Sounds Premium Features are available on a monthly / annual subscription basis, or as a one-time purchase. These premium features include full mixing of sound scenes, full audio tracks, number of audio mixes and all future updates. If you decide to upgrade, your iTunes account will be charged upon confirmation of purchase.

it.name: Heartify: Heart Health Monitor

Heartify® has one simple mission: improve heart health worldwide. We aim to have everything you need to live longer and happier! 

Easily take your heart rate by placing your finger on the camera. Measure your heart rate daily to track your history with our advanced HRV technology. This heart health app will educate and inform you on how to keep your heart strong and risk factors minimal. Take the guess work out of your health and get started today!

Heartify® offers additional options to assist you in improving your health by keeping it fun and letting you know how far you’ve progressed! 

√ Daily activity overview: check your daily health measurements in one place
√ HRV (Heart Rate Variability): track a variety of valuable metrics Stress, Energy, Recovery, and much more
√ Courses & Heart Insights: upgrade your knowledge with exclusive courses taught by our leading experts
√ Connect with the Heartify® Community to share and learn from others
√ History: Track your heart health progress with detailed history reports of your critical heart statistics

Follow these easy tips for best results when using the heart rate monitor:
√ Always hold your phone steady
√ Remain calm and breath at a regular rate
√ Cover the entire back camera with your finger. You do not need to press hard for it to begin measuring. A light touch is all that is needed to begin the reading. 

Heartify® uses HealthKit to adjust health metrics, such as heart rate variability measurements, to your parameters.

Share the app with your friends to start making a difference in their lives as well.

“We believe that mindfulness is more than a form of stress relief — it can be a tool for personal growth, deeper understanding, vibrancy. More than a way to disconnect — it can be a way to feel a part of something bigger. More than simply silence — it can be immersive, beautiful, moving.”

–Raed Khawaja, Open Co-founder & CEO

Regulate your nervous system with Open. Bridge science and spirituality to cleanse your body and mind. Learn breathwork, meditation, and movement techniques designed by experts in neurobiology. Practice on the app and in-person at our flagship studio in Los Angeles. 

CLASSES

BREATHE: Since the dawn of civilization, humans have developed techniques for manipulating our breath to induce desired states of consciousness. Now peer-reviewed studies in neuroscience and psychology confirm that breathwork is a powerful toolkit for regulating your nervous system, optimizing your health and well-being, and catalyzing personal transformation. Breathwork is an umbrella term for myriad practices, both ancient and modern. While many techniques are deeply rooted in spiritual traditions like Yoga, Qi Gong, and Buddhism, contemporary applications integrate ancient wisdom with modern science.This synthesis of ancient and modern has given rise to transformational breathwork, designed to induce profound experiences of catharsis, insight, and breakthrough. Experience a mental reset with just a few minutes of conscious breathing.


MEDITATE: Train your awareness and contemplate wisdom – with techniques that span generations, cultures, and traditions – with our daily meditations and monthly programs. Learn how to enhance your focus, reduce your stress and anxiety, and regulate your emotions with simple mindfulness techniques you can incorporate into your daily life. 


MOVE: Our methodology is designed through the intelligence of fitness – blending endurance, strength, mobility, and recovery – with the wisdom of mindfulness. A ritual for resilience, strengthening the body and mind.

ANYTIME, ANYWHERE: Practice on your time with our endless library, with fresh classes added daily. From simple 5-minute breathwork techniques, to 60-minute strength and conditioning classes, build your practice to fit your schedule and meet your goals. Whether you’re starting your journey or seeking a new challenge, there are classes for every level and mood.

PROGRESS TRACKING: Create a daily habit that sticks with progress tracking, push reminders, streaks, and badges. A consistent breathwork and meditation practice has proven to reduce cortisol levels and regulate the nervous system–decreasing stress, supporting emotional well-being, and enhancing mental clarity. These techniques can also improve physical health by increasing heart rate variability, promoting cardiovascular health, and boosting immune function.

CONNECT WITH US

Questions? Email us: support@o-p-e-n.com. Follow along on Instagram: @op_e___n.

NOTES

Data: Open reads and writes data to the Apple Health App to help you track your Mindful minutes. No data is being sent outside of your device. This is optional.

Your subscription to Open will automatically renew, unless you disable auto-renew at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can turn off auto-renew or manage your subscription from your Apple account settings. Payment will be charged to your Apple account. You can read more about our terms of service here: https://o-p-e-n.com/terms and our privacy policy here: https://o-p-e-n.com/privacy.

it.d:
Join over 1,000,000 users achieving their keto and low-carb goals with the ultimate keto diet app!

This keto diet tracker is like having your own personal keto and low-carb nutritionist in the palm of your hand. Whether you are strictly following a keto diet or just cutting back on carbs, losing weight has never been so simple! Keto.app is designed to be the fastest, easiest-to-use macro tracker on the market, helping you hit your keto and fasting goals without the hassle.

Try our keto diet app for free to get your custom meal plan! Upgrading to PRO is only required if you want to log 5+ foods per day—and we offer both flexible subscriptions, including free trial, and a one-time lifetime purchase for those who hate monthly fees.

MEAL PLANS & PERSONALIZATION
• Curated Meal Plans: Take the guesswork out of your diet. Select and follow perfectly tailored meal plans designed for your specific calorie goals and net carb goals. While all options are fundamentally optimized for a keto diet, our extensive selection accommodates various lifestyles—including vegetarian, vegan, bodybuilding, low carb and no carb, among many others.
• AI Day Analysis: Get smart, personalized feedback on your daily logs! Send your day's data to our AI to find out exactly how you are doing (e.g., "You are right on track today, but most of your carbs came from dairy. Try to focus on adding more healthy fats tomorrow").
• Personalized Plan: Enter your body type, goals, and activity level to generate a custom daily macro plan that fits your exact diet style.
• Targeted Advice: View recommended foods to prioritize, and see which foods to avoid to stay on track.

EFFORTLESS TRACKING & RECIPES
• Voice Search: Log your meals instantly using just your voice!
• Massive Food Database: Search our global database for foods, beverages, restaurant items, and pre-packaged products.
• Barcode & Label Scanner: Simply scan a barcode, or use your camera to scan a nutrition label and automatically fill in the macro fields.
• Net Carbs & Fiber Tracking: We automatically subtract sugar alcohols and dietary fiber for your true net carb count. You can even view dedicated charts for your daily fiber consumption—a feature most other trackers miss!
• Keto & Low-Carb Recipes: Access a large library of delicious keto diet and low-carb recipes, featuring ideas for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks, as well as satisfying soups, salads, and desserts, or create and save your own.
• Smart Adjustments: Only ate half your meal? Easily adjust the portion size of logged recipes for accurate macro tracking.
• Fasting Tracker: Track your fasting windows, including popular 16:8 and 18:6 intermittent fasting schedules. 
• Water Tracker: Log your daily water intake to stay hydrated.

PROGRESS & MODERN FEATURES
• Home and Lock Screen Widgets: Check your daily macros and progress at a glance right from your home screen.
• Dark Mode Support: Beautifully designed to support Dark Mode for late-night logging and easier reading.
• Apple Health Integration: Fully integrated with Apple Health. Seamlessly track your burned calories and daily steps, export your daily nutrition macros, and sync your water intake.
• Visual Progress: View beautiful, easy-to-read graphs of your weight loss, calorie and carb intake, fiber, and hydration.


GLOBAL SUPPORT
Our food databases support the USA, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa, and more!

Pricing & Terms:
Keto.app is always free to download and use. If you choose to upgrade to PRO, we offer monthly and annual subscriptions, as well as a subscription-free lifetime plan—pay once and unlock all features forever!

it.name: INTVL
it.d:
INTVL: The World Is the Game.

INTVL turns every walk, run or bike ride into a game played on the real world globe. The idea is simple. When you run or ride in a loop, the ground inside that loop becomes your territory. The bigger, smarter and more tactical your routes, the more of the map you hold.

Claim your territory

Every loop you complete claims real space. Other players are out there doing the same thing, so the map is always moving. You can take a new route to take new ground, or go back over an area to defend what's already yours.

Play it your way

Some people want to be the best in the world, so they chase the global leaderboard. Others care more about home turf and work to become the territory leader of their own suburb or city. Both are worth playing for, and you can switch focus whenever you want.

Hold ground, win real prizes

Every bit of the map you hold earns you entries into our competitions, where the prizes are real. The more territory you hold at the end of the competition, the better your odds.

Run and ride with clubs

it.name: Wakeout! Fitness Games
it.d:
Fitness games for your living room, your kitchen and your desk. Wakeout makes moving something you look forward to, with AR games where your body is the controller, a new one-minute challenge every day, and 3,000+ moves to stretch, shake and dance through.

PLAY WITH YOUR WHOLE BODY
Step in front of your camera and play AR games where your body is the controller. Rounds take about a minute, and you don't need any equipment.

MOVE NOW, ONE MINUTE AT A TIME
Tap Move Now and get a one-minute routine picked for the time of day, from a desk stretch to a living-room dance break.

A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY
Take on Today's Move Challenge, build your streak and see how long you can keep it going.

MOVEMENT FOR EVERY ROOM
3,000+ moves for every mood and every space: stretching at your desk, shaking it out in the kitchen with a skillet, dancing in the living room, even tossing a cushion around. From gentle chair routines to "Dad Move" dance breaks, for any age and any fitness level.

YOUR APPLE WATCH, AS A REMOTE
The Apple Watch app is a companion for your iPhone. Start and control your Wakeouts from your wrist, and keep your Wiggle Timer running across both devices.

WATTS, STREAKS AND TROPHIES
Every move earns Wakeout Watts, so all your movement counts. Set goals, build streaks and collect trophies along the way.

SMART REMINDERS
Wakeout nudges you to move at good moments. Use the Wiggle Timer, tune your schedule, or take the day off when life gets busy.

MAKE IT YOURS
Themes change how Wakeout looks, from Night Owl to Sakura, so your moving space feels like yours.

CHANGING LIVES
Thousands have already found their own way to move with Wakeout. Here's what they're saying:

"Even a 30-second reason to stand up and move has proven to loosen my hips, help with back pain, and improve my mood!" - Jennifer L., 51

"It helps with my chronic pain condition, keeps me from getting as stiff, and lowers my pain level quite a bit. It's easy to do for someone with a chronic illness because you can choose the amount of time." - Amanda G., 44

"I feel stronger, have improved mobility, and experience less muscle aches. It's refreshing to get up and move regularly, and I feel more awake and alert, able to focus better after moving with Wakeout." - Robert M., 62

Download Wakeout and rediscover the joy of moving. Your body and your mood will thank you.

---


TRY WAKEOUT FOR FREE:
Download Wakeout and enjoy a 7-day free trial.

NOT INTENDED FOR TREATMENT:
Consult your doctor or therapist before performing exercises if unsure of your ability. Wakeout isn't intended to treat illnesses.

AUTHENTICATION AND SUBSCRIPTION
Requires Apple 2FA authentication for sign-up and an active subscription. One subscription covers all your devices. Free trials transition to a paid subscription unless canceled. Manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store settings.

HEALTH APP CONNECTION RECOMMENDED:
Wakeout works best when granted permission to read and write to your Apple Health App. Adjust permissions in settings at any time.

TERMS & PRIVACY:
We ensure minimal data collection with secure encryption and storage.

Review our terms and privacy: https://wakeout.app/terms

it.name: Napper: Baby Sleep Tracker
it.d:
Napper is the game-changing, award-winning app that uses data, science, and a little bit of algorithmic magic to predict your baby’s naps and bedtime - with almost uncanny accuracy.

Originally built by a dad on parental leave (still with us btw!) for him and his not-so-sleepy baby girl, Napper has now grown to help more than 100,000 families sleep better. So whatever issue you might be facing - short naps, frequent night-wakings, never-ending bedtime routines - there’s a good chance we can help you too.

→ Napper’s main features include…

• A personalized sleep schedule for your baby based on their natural sleep rhythms and research on infant sleep. The schedule adjusts as your baby's sleep needs change to promote healthy sleep habits and provide them with the restful sleep they need to grow and develop.

• User-friendly, straight-forward baby tracker to help you keep track of nursings, formula feedings, diaper changes and much more. You can also share your baby (and subscription) with as many caregivers as needed so everyone is on the same page.

• A large variety of sleep sounds, such as white noise, lullabies, and sounds of nature, that can be played in the background during naptime and bedtime. The sounds are carefully chosen to be gentle and calming, helping to create a peaceful and relaxing environment for your baby to sleep in.

• A comprehensive, science-based article series designed to help you establish healthy sleep habits for your baby. The course covers a wide range of topics, including the basic biological components of sleep, how to create a sleep-friendly environment and strategies for settling and soothing a fussy baby.

•  Trends & statistics presented in easy-to-read charts that give you useful insights, such as the average amount of time your baby spends asleep, the number of night wakings, and the duration of feedings. Easily spot and identify patterns and trends in your baby's sleep, which allows you to make adjustments to their sleep routine as needed.

—

All in all, we’d really like to think that Napper is the most complete baby sleep app out there. But don't just take our word for it though - here’s what other parents have to say about it:

"Great app, helped me work out when nap times should be and helped set a bedtime routine! Definitely recommend."

"This is one of the apps which every mom or another caregiver should download straight away. Thanks to Napper I could develop a deeper understanding of my 4-months old sleep patterns. And now he falls asleep fast and without cries. Thank you!"

"I love Napper! I've used 4 other sleep tracking apps (paid for) and Napper has to be my favorite! I love the aesthetic of the layout and how accurate it is."

"This app is amazing!! Very accurate for my son and has been for months. Great features to select number of naps and set bed time if trying to create a routine too."

"My baby is 11 months and I use it all day every day. Keeps us on schedule"

"This app is really great, it's like a baby manual that comes with your child! I really love it."

"Really useful, I'm sleep deprived and can't remember exactly what time everything happens! The predictive sleep feature is great. Developers very responsive to feedback"

"I LOVE Napper! I have used lots of baby trackers over my 4 kids and this one is hands down my favorite."

"The app is pretty great but the customer service is even better! I thought I was locked out of my account and they contacted me and got me back in within minutes! This app has revolutionized how we care for our newborn."

"This is the app that got us through the 4 months sleep regression! And I love that multiple caretakers can add track baby's sleep. Such a great help!"

So don't let sleepless nights and exhausted days be the norm - try Napper (yes, today!!) and give your baby the gift of restful, peaceful sleep!

—

Choose from topics in productivity, happiness, gratitude, stress & anxiety, relationships, therapy, self-discovery, and much more. Stoic also has templates to help you with a variety of situations like preparing for a therapy session, CBT-based thought dumps, dream & nightmare journal, etc.

Journaling is a therapeutic tool for clearing the mind, expressing thoughts, setting goals, practicing gratitude, emotional wellbeing, and promoting self-reflection.

We’re constantly adding more mental health tools to help you overcome more obstacles and situations. You can also join our supportive community on Discord and leave your suggestions in our feedback board.

it.name: Stretching at Home, Mobility
it.d:
Wanna reduce muscle tension and relieve pain?

Wanna enhance flexibility and range of motion?

Stretching is essential to your daily life, even if you're not planning to exercise. ACSM suggest people stretch at least 2-3 times each week for a healthy life. Scientifically proven that regular stretching helps reduce muscle stiffness, release pain, improve flexibility and relieve stress. 

Why stretch?

Avoid injury
Increasing flexibility and range of motion in your joints is important for workout and running. Stretching before exercise is highly recommended because it can reduce muscle and joint tension, prevent cramps and avoid the risk of any injuries. It also helps fast recovery and reduces muscle soreness after exercise.

Relieve pain
Stretching is widely used in back pain treatment. Research shows stretching improves the blood circulation of muscles and joints, which can help healing and releasing pain. It's a natural but essential way to treat pain and decrease fatigue and stress.

Increase flexibility

it.name: The Way: Meditation & Zen
it.d:
THE WAY is a new kind of meditation app: a single path, led by an authorized Zen master, that guides you on a deep meditation training program. Study alongside Zen master Henry Shukman as you uncover the deep peace, love, insight and awakening that meditation can bring.

The simple path to deeper meditation.

With THE WAY, you will:

*** Never feel overwhelmed by choice. The Way guides you step-by-step along a single, linear path through all the key areas of a deep and fulfilling meditation practice. You never have to worry about which meditation to choose.

*** Experience real transformation and deep wellbeing. Progress along a proven pathway of meditation that helps you to awaken to the true nature of your mind, your self, and your relationship to the world. Explore Zen koans, non-dual awareness and other awakening techniques. 

*** Benefit from an authorized Zen Master as your guide. Study with a beloved teacher with over 35 years of meditation practice. Learn Henry Shukman’s innovative fusion of modern mindfulness, Jhana practice and Sanbo Zen teaching. 

HENRY SHUKMAN teaches mindfulness and awakening practices to a wide range of students from all traditions and walks of life. Henry is an authorized Zen Master in the Sanbo Zen lineage, and is the Spiritual Director of Mountain Cloud Zen Center in Santa Fe, New Mexico. His struggles and traumatic experiences as a youth, combined with a spontaneous awakening experience at 19, paved the way for Henry to develop a well-rounded approach to meditation. 

On the journey of THE WAY, you can learn to:

*** Calm the nervous system, reduce stress on a daily basis and release trauma over time
*** Uncover previously unknown support and gratitude in our lives
*** Access beautiful states of flow and absorption during meditation
*** Get tastes and glimpses of awakening - insights into your own true nature, and discovering what non-duality really means, and the deep freedom and joy it can give.

THE WAY works through a series of daily guided meditations and talks along a single path of practice. Through these guided meditations you will explore with Zen Master Henry Shukman: teaching from ancient Buddhist traditions, finding peace and unconditional wellbeing in the heart of our lives, learning how to sit with and process negative emotions, healing from past traumas, uncovering deep joy in the bare fact of being alive, discovering a deep and connected presence, understanding insights into non-duality and awakening to the true nature of reality. All grounded in modern mindfulness and ancient Zen wisdom.

SUBSCRIPTION AND SCHOLARSHIPS


THE WAY is free to download and try out the pathway.


You can manage your subscription from your Apple account settings. Payment will be charged to your Apple account.


If you can’t afford the cost of the subscription, please let us know and we will arrange a free subscription to THE WAY for you through our scholarship program.
