it.name: Tooboo - Hiking Trail Guides
it.d:
Tooboo is an app designed for outdoor activities (hiking, cycling, trail running). Use it for route navigation on Apple Watch or iPhone.
Simply import GPX tracks from AllTrails、Strava or elsewhere to stay on course during your outdoor adventures.

** Battery Optimization **
Apple Watch Ultra battery usage: ~8% per hour, or 5% in Low Power Mode. Enable Low Power Mode for longer hikes.

** Key Features **

# Professional Mapping Experience
- High-precision contour lines & 3D terrain maps with comprehensive topographic details
- Offline map support (watch + phone) for confident exploration without network coverage

# Smart Navigation System**  
- Automatic off-track alerts with turn notifications via haptic feedback + voice guidance
- Intelligent backtrack feature for safe return along your original route

# Flexible Route Management
- Manual planning for personalized routes
- One-tap import of GPX/KML/KMZ/FIT track files (with photo attachments support)
- Multi-day trip merging for complete long-distance hiking records

# Peak Lens
Point Peak Lens at the mountains ahead to identify peak names and elevations.

# Workout Data Analytics**
- Intuitive slope visualization: Red for ascents | Blue for descents
- Real-time data monitoring: distance, heart rate, pace, elevation, remaining mileage
- Auto-sync with Apple Fitness to complete your daily activity goals

# Thoughtful Design Philosophy
- Seamless switching between map and data views
- Interface optimized specifically for outdoor activities
- Making every hike a safe and exciting adventure

** Privacy **
Ad-free forever. All workout data saves to Apple Health only. Automatically sync via iCloud.
GPS location used for navigation only, never uploaded to external servers.
Photos from the activity history or route are stored in your private iCloud and will not be uploaded to external servers. Automatically sync via iCloud.

Integrated with Apple Health for workout data sync.

Fish smarter with Fishbrain! Find new fishing spots, get detailed local info, and connect with a community of more than 20 million anglers. Fishbrain provides you with the maps and tools you need to improve your fishing skills.

Fishbrain is the fastest and easiest way to find places to fish. Explore thousands of fishing waters and see exactly where fish are being caught with the Fishbrain map. Whether you’re fishing for bass, trout, catfish, redfish, or any other species, Fishbrain can help you set the hook.

GET THE LATEST LOCAL INFO
Be the first to know about fishing trends in your area. Get pictures and updates from local anglers. See which baits & lures are catching the most fish. Check weather conditions, tide charts, air pressure, moon phases, and advanced BiteTime forecasts. Search updated local fishing regulations in 30+ US states.

TRACK YOUR FISHING ADVENTURES
Keep track of your fishing trips to unlock personalized insights and tips. Log catches to remember the baits and weather patterns that led to success. Record all your favorite fishing moments, and share your catches with the community to celebrate with your fellow anglers.

KEEP YOUR SPOTS SECRET
You control how much location info you share! Fishbrain’s built-in privacy settings ensure you can keep info about your favorite fishing spots private.

CONNECT WITH LIKE-MINDED ANGLERS
Fishing is better with friends, old and new. Fishbrain brings together passionate anglers from around the globe. Connect with other fishing enthusiasts, exchange tips & tricks, join fishing groups, learn new fishing techniques and so much more.

FISHBRAIN APP FEATURES 
 • Fishing maps with advanced map layers & filters

Whether you’re a beginner just learning how to fish, or an experienced angler chasing your next PB, Fishbrain will help you along your journey as an angler! Download Fishbrain today and start knowing the water like never before.

it.name: Yawn: Alarms & Morning Routine
it.d:
Tomorrow starts tonight.

What would you do with an extra hour?

Read a few pages. Write your book. Stretch. Or just take your time.

Yawn helps you put scrolling to bed, wake with a plan and make room for the things you love.

Protect tonight
Choose distracting apps and websites, then set bedtime protection, schedules or time limits. Protect a morning window too, so your plans have some space.

Wake with purpose
Set a simple alarm, or choose a photo mission that asks you to get up and photograph a saved item. Keep your next alarm close with a Home Screen widget.

Make time for you
Choose a personal goal or create your own, set a time and start your goal timer. Read, write, move or make something. Mark the mornings you made time, and add app protection when you want fewer distractions.

Find your wind-down
Explore sleep stories, music and sounds. Build a mix, save favourites and use an audio timer.

A soundtrack for your time
Choose morning lofi, soft piano or a gentle focus hum for reading, writing and making. Pick a track, press Play and set an audio timer.

See your progress
Follow your morning check-ins and streaks. Optionally connect Apple Health to explore recorded sleep and sleep stages, when they are available in the records you share.

Membership and requirements
Yawn works without a Yawn account. Basic alarms without a wake-up mission are available without membership. Photo missions, app protection, morning goals, the audio libraries and other Premium tools require Yawn Premium. Subscription options and renewal terms are shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled in your App Store settings.

Apple Health is optional. App protection requires Screen Time permission. Alarm sound and silencing follow iOS controls. Requires iOS 26 or iPadOS 26 or later.

Save & repeat the items you loved or simply save the unfinished workout to come back to later! The Favorites section allows you to manage and access your favorite lessons and workouts whenever you like.

- Boxing improves health: it normalizes metabolism, hormone levels, strengthens bones, and even increases libido.

it.name: Century: Health & Fitness

Your Intelligent Health Coach

Century helps you understand your body and live healthier every day. It takes data from your wearables and translates it into simple, meaningful insights that show how your sleep, movement, and recovery shape your overall health.

How It Works
Century syncs with Apple Health and any connected device to analyze your core metrics, including:

Your Daily Health Challenge motivates you to reach your optimal score by balancing sleep, activity, and recovery—making progress easy to see and feel.
Sleep Quality — Tracks depth, consistency, and recovery value
Body Battery — Real-time energy reflection throughout your day
Recovery Score — Daily measure of how well you’ve recovered from strain
Heart Rate Variability (HRV) — Reflects stress resilience and recovery
Resting Heart Rate (RHR) — Key indicator of cardiovascular fitness
VO₂ Max — Measures endurance and aerobic efficiency

Why Century

Most apps tell you what’s “good” or “bad.” Century shows what’s yours.
It helps you build better habits with personalized insights and evidence-based feedback.
Personalized Recommendations based on your actual biometrics
Clear Visuals showing how your choices affect your daily health
Motivation Through Progress as your scores improve
Meaningful Comparisons against your own trends, not arbitrary targets

AI use and AI providers
The app is entirely usable without any AI features. 
The Century Coach is the only features that uses AI, and is opt-in. Coach is powered by Apple Intelligence, and is using Apple Private Cloud Compute. 
We also have an optional fallback for older devices, and in case you run into your limits. That's using OpenAI as the AI provider. 
If you want to use Coach, but never want to use the fallback, that's also an option. 

Who It’s For
Century is built for anyone who wants to:
Feel and perform better, every day
Take a data-driven approach to health
Make sense of their wearable data
Stay balanced between activity and recovery

it.name: Fishing Points: Map & Forecast
it.d:
Download all-in-one fishing app already connecting more than 12 million anglers worldwide. Fishing Points is fishing forecasts and maps app, made for beginner-, seasoned-, and pro anglers to discover new fishing spots, understand best fishing times and catch more fish. Suitable for both salt and freshwater anglers on open seas, lakes or rivers.

Explore our detailed fishing forecasts to discover the best fishing times for your location. Understand how fish brain works by analyzing fishing tides, moon phases, marine forecasts, solunar and weather forecasts. We show current conditions and forecasts for temperature, rain probability, rain intensity, wind speed, gusts, wind directions and air pressure all in one app. 

To know where to fish, explore four different fishing map types, save and discover fishing spots, favorite locations, trotlines, and trolling paths. Access detailed satellite fishing maps, worldwide nautical charts, or use offline mode with marine nautical maps for boating (NOAA). View seagrass, oyster beds, mangrove layers, and now detailed lake maps with depth and contour charts - perfect for spotting drop-offs, channels, and structure (available in select states: Florida, Minnesota, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Dakota, and Washington). Revisit your trips with a private catch logbook, check bag limits and fishing rules, and learn what works to maximize your next trip!

FEEDING TIMES FORECAST
- Hourly feeding times with strong major and minor time intervals
- Daily fish activity
- Best fishing times calendar for bass and other popular species
- Customizable smart notifications on days with feeding times

FIND YOUR LOCATIONS
- Save fishing spots, locations, hotspots and waypoints
- Record trolling paths and trotlines
- Save your favorite locations with more than 40 icons and 10 colors
- Find saved locations with GPS
- The only fishing app with worldwide access to nautical maps 
- Offline mode with nautical charts provided by NOAA
- Get information and quickly locate more than 50.000 boat ramps worldwide
- Seagrass, oyster beds, mangroves map layers
- Compass
- Measure distances

FISHING WEATHER
- Accurate current fishing weather conditions with hourly forecast for humidity, precipitation probability, UV index
- Wind forecast including wind speed, gusts and direction
- Current fishing barometer with hourly air pressure forecast
- Severe live weather alerts
- Rain radar

RIVER DATA
- Current water levels & flows for 35k+ river stations

TIDES FOR FISHING
- Hourly tides for fishing charts with information on the next high and low tides 
- Tide prediction charts with detailed tidal current
- Tides overview forecasts with daily highest and lowest tides

MARINE FORECAST
- Hourly waves forecast (waves, swell, wind waves)
- Sea temperature (SST)
- Sea and ocean currents data

SOLUNAR DATA
- Sunrise and sunset times
- Sun positions
- Moonrise and moonset times
- Moon positions
- Moon phases

SYNC DATA
- Access your saved data across all your computer and mobile devices.
- Use Webapp to plan and analyze fishing trips on your computer. Try Webapp on https://web.fishingpoints.app

FISH RULES AND FISH SPECIES
- Information on fish species including bass, trout, snapper, snook, drum, grouper, catfish etc.
- Fish rules and regulations on bag limits and open seasons for selected US States (Florida, Texas, Georgia, North Carolina and Louisiana)

CATCH LOG
- Create a fishing log and save the details of every catch (photos, weight, length)
- Weather, solunar and tide information are added automatically to your catches

SHARE
- Import kmz or gpx files from GPS devices or other apps
- Share your locations with friends
- Share catch photos with your fellow anglers

In case of questions, comments or suggestions, please send us a note to support@fishingpoints.app. Happy fishing!

Privacy policy: https://fishingpoints.app/privacy 
Terms of Use: https://fishingpoints.app/terms

it.name: Streaks
it.d:
STREAKS. The to-do list that helps you form good habits.
Apple Design Award winner.

Track up to 24 tasks you want to complete each day. Your goal is to build a streak of consecutive days.

* Tasks sync across all of your devices using iCloud
* Share your tasks with other Streaks users so they can encourage you and keep your accountable
* Streaks automatically knows when you complete tasks linked to the Health app, such as water tracking and caffeine tracking.
* Streaks reminds you automatically when you need to complete a task
* Record daily notes for your tasks
* You can also create negative tasks to break bad habits
* Create timed tasks to track mindfulness, brushing your teeth, or anything

“I was smoking 15 cigarettes each day. Streaks helped me to quit smoking by reducing and then eliminating my daily use.” - Ben, Adelaide.

Streaks is a highly customizable habit tracker, including:

* Widgets for your phone's home screen
* 78 different color themes
* Over 600 task icons to choose from
* Choose how often a task needs to be completed or repeated

“I've now reduced my coffee intake by 70% with Streaks, something I struggled with for 5 years. It's a life changing app to me.” - Otávio, Chicago.

* Includes one of the highest-praised Apple Watch apps, including Health app integration, complications, and rich notifications.
* Support for Siri Shortcuts, iPad and iCloud
* Today Widget allows you to quickly view and complete your tasks
* View your current and best streak, and a whole range of other statistics

Questions, suggestions or other feedback? Please email support@streaks.app, or tweet us @TheStreaksApp.

If you like Streaks, please leave us a review! Your reviews enable us to keep improving and updating the app.

ABOUT APPLE WATCH:

Streaks supports all Apple complication types. Note that the screenshots show Infograph faces, which are available only on Apple Watch Series 4 and newer.

ABOUT HEALTH DATA:

On supported devices, Streaks reads data from the Health app with your permission to determine completion of your tasks. All data is accessed in full accordance with the iOS app review rules set by Apple. Please read our privacy policy at https://streaks.app/privacy.html for more information on our use of data.

Automatic step and distance data is only available automatically when using an iPhone 5S or newer, or using an accessory that writes to the Health app such as Apple Watch. If you have any questions, please contact support@streaks.app.

--

Rest timer, plate calculator, supersets, drop sets, warmup templates, form videos, and mid-set exercise swaps that keep your numbers. PRs flag in-session. Weekly Sunday reports and year-end Wrapped. Dr. Eric Helms, Alex Bromley, Cody Lefever (GZCL), Geoffrey Verity Schofield, Alberto Nuñez, Bryce Lewis, Greg Nuckols, Jonnie Candito, Bald Omni-Man, Natural Hypertrophy, Basement Bodybuilding, Brandon Campbell (PHUL), Dr. Swole, Matt Vena, Menno Henselmans, Justina Ercole, Tiffany Ma, Rebecca Rouse, and 50+ more. Competitive athletes and researchers, not random influencers.

WHO IT'S FOR

Beginners who want a plan and a gym logger. Intermediate lifters done with spreadsheets. Anyone who wants an AI coach plus a real tracker. Men and women. Full gym, garage gym, or dumbbells at home. 2–6 days per week.

ABOUT

Boostcamp started by putting Reddit’s best programs into a workout tracker that works. 1.3M+ lifters now log training, follow 11,000+ programs, and build custom plans with an AI coach. Free to start. No ads.

Questions? support@boostcamp.app

WHO-validated quit smoking app with 4.5M+ users. Start your smoke-free life today!

Ready to quit smoking for good? Kwit combines proven science with gamification to make quitting easier and engaging. As the first WHO-validated smoking cessation app, Kwit helps you break free from nicotine addiction using evidence-based cognitive behavioral therapy techniques that work.

Track your progress in real-time
Watch your quit smoking journey unfold with personalized statistics showing smoke-free days, money saved, cigarettes avoided, and health improvements. Every milestone becomes powerful motivation to stay tobacco-free. See exactly how your body heals as you progress through your transformation.

Science-backed craving management
Beat cravings with CBT-based tools including guided breathing exercises, mini-games, and instant motivation cards. Turn withdrawal moments into opportunities for growth with techniques developed by addiction specialists. When nicotine cravings hit, you'll have proven strategies to overcome them naturally.

Join the quit smoking community
Connect with supportive groups where fellow quitters share victories, challenges, and daily encouragement. Exchange tips with people who understand your journey. You're never alone in your mission to become smoke-free. Get real-time support from thousands of successful ex-smokers worldwide.

Expert-designed educational content
Access our comprehensive library of evidence-based articles, expert tips, and proven strategies from leading addiction specialists. Learn the science behind tobacco addiction and master techniques for lasting smoking cessation success. Understand withdrawal symptoms, identify triggers, and develop healthy coping mechanisms.

Nicotine replacement tracker and vaping support
Gradually reduce your dependence on patches, gum, vaping devices, and e-cigarettes with personalized guidance. Monitor your nicotine replacement therapy progress and take control of your consumption step-by-step until you're completely free from nicotine addiction.

9-day preparation program
Follow our scientifically-designed quit plan based on Prochaska's Transtheoretical Model and cognitive behavioral therapy principles. Prepare mentally and physically for your quit date with structured daily guidance that sets you up for long-term success.

Key features that make quitting easier:
• Real-time quit tracking with detailed statistics
• Evidence-based craving management tools and techniques
• Supportive community groups and chat features
• Progress rewards, achievements, and milestone celebrations
• Comprehensive educational content library
• Nicotine replacement therapy monitoring
• Guided breathing exercises and mindfulness practices
• Money saved calculator and spending tracker
• Health improvement timeline with medical insights
• Personalized motivation cards and daily inspiration
• Relapse prevention strategies and recovery support

Premium features for serious quitters:
Upgrade to access advanced analytics, extended content library, priority community support, one-on-one expert consultations, and personalized coaching plans tailored to your specific smoking habits and triggers.

Why choose Kwit over other quit smoking apps? We're the only WHO-validated smoking cessation app, combining rigorous scientific research with engaging gamification. Our approach is based on proven cognitive behavioral therapy methods, not just tracking. We focus on changing your relationship with smoking through education, community support, and evidence-based interventions.

Join 4.5+ million people worldwide who chose freedom from tobacco addiction. Download the WHO-recommended quit smoking app trusted by healthcare professionals and start your smoke-free life today. Your journey to better health, increased energy, and financial freedom begins now.

Contact us at hello@kwit.app for support.

Kwit complements your quit smoking journey but does not replace medical advice.

it.name: MacroFactor - Macro Tracker
it.d:
MacroFactor combines innovative coaching algorithms with proven nutrition and behavioral science to help you reach your diet goals and achieve empowering, sustainable results.

MacroFactor uses a dynamic algorithm to adapt to changes in your metabolism and personalize your macro plan to keep you on track.

Download to start your 7-day trial of this premium, ad-free macro tracker app. 

DIET SMARTER

Using a best-in-class expenditure estimate, MacroFactor’s nutrition coach algorithm adapts to changes in your metabolism so you never plateau. 

• The unique energy expenditure calculation detects changes in your metabolism
• Smart algorithms personalize your calorie and macro intake targets, just like a nutrition coach would
• Weekly check-ins keep you on track toward your goals

The result? You better understand your body’s needs and can successfully reach and sustain your goals without stress.

THE BEST MACRO TRACKER TOOLS

• The fastest macro tracker on the market with tools like barcode scan and custom foods
• Verified food database, so you can trust the accuracy of the foods you log 
• Custom macro programs and weekly check-ins based on your goals and preferences
• Detailed breakdowns of micronutrients, macros, and more
• Period tracker, habit tracker, unique data insights and visualization, integrations, dark mode, and more

AN EMPOWERING, SUSTAINABLE APPROACH

MacroFactor’s robust nutrition coach algorithm will make appropriate adjustments to your calorie and macro targets based on what you log, regardless of how close you came to hitting your targets from the previous week. The algorithms don’t function any worse if you deviate from your macro targets. 
 
This means that unlike other nutrition coach apps, you don’t have to eat like a robot or perfectly adhere to your macro targets in order to get your weekly coaching check-in and an appropriate calorie adjustment.
 
You’ll never see warnings, red numbers, or shaming when you go over your calorie or macro targets, unlike in other macro tracker apps.
 
Instead, MacroFactor’s macro tracker and nutrition coach aim to empower you with the guidance and tools you need to reach your goals without stress or rigidity. 

A CLOSER LOOK AT FEATURES & BENEFITS

Nutrition coach
• Get a science-backed macro plan designed for your goals and preferences
• Set a goal to lose, maintain, or gain weight
• Smart nutrition coach AI makes weekly changes to your macro plan to keep you on track
 
Macro tracker
• Large verified food database, so you can trust that calorie and macro information is accurate
• Barcode scanner
• Food tracker for both macros and micronutrients
• Features like copy/paste, custom foods, and smart history make food tracking quick and easy
• Timeline-style food log doesn’t lock you in to a certain number of meals
• Metric and imperial options
• Custom foods and recipes

Health insights tracker
• Best-in-class expenditure estimate
• Unique Weight Trend insight that cuts through the noise of daily fluctuations
• Habit tracker
• Period tracker

NOTICES

Contains information from Open Food Facts, which is made available
here under the Open Database License (ODbL).

Open Food Facts:
https://openfoodfacts.org/

ODbL:
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/

SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS

MacroFactor is a premium app that offers three auto-renewing subscription options:
$11.99 / month
$47.99 / half year
$71.99 / year (equal to $5.99 a month)

MacroFactor has a free trial, but does not offer a free subscription tier.

These prices are for US customers. Pricing in other countries may vary. Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase.

Your subscription to MacroFactor will automatically renew, unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can cancel or manage your subscription from your Apple account settings.

One Year makes journaling feel light, visual, and easy to keep up with.

"This is the first time I've actually stuck with journaling every day."


Why One Year

• Truly remember each day of your year
• Write as much or as little as you want
• No pressure, no streaks

Journal your way

• Write: a few words or a whole page
• Talk: record a voice note and your day is saved
• Snap: take photos with digicam, film and black & white looks
• Doodle: draw your own flower, then hear it play

Find any memory, just ask

Your garden

Share your day

• Full garden view or simple progress dots

Your privacy comes first

• Stored on your device and encrypted in the cloud
• No feeds

Use One Year for free

Get One Year Full Access

it.name: RepCount - Gym Workout Tracker
it.d:
RepCount is a workout tracker for strength training. It's free, with no ads and no limit on workouts, routines or exercises. Premium adds charts, personal records, supersets, drop sets and export.

Every workout starts with the weights and reps from last time, so you always know what to beat. Use it for whatever you train: a 5x5 or upper/lower program, a bodybuilding split, calisthenics, or a home gym with a pair of dumbbells.

IN THE GYM
• Log more than weights and reps: bodyweight exercises (assisted or weighted), timed holds, farmer's walks, and cardio with time, distance and calories
• Warm-up sets, and notes on any set, exercise or workout
• A rest timer that can start when you check off a set, with the countdown on your lock screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Start a workout or routine with Siri or Shortcuts
• Share a finished workout as an image

ROUTINES AND EXERCISES
• Build your own routines, save any workout as a routine, or repeat a past workout
• Add your own exercises. Built-in exercises show a demo and the muscles they work

YOUR DATA
• Sign in with Apple, Google or email, and your workouts are backed up and synced between iPhone and Android
• Works offline, even in a basement gym
• Saves workouts, active calories and body weight to Apple Health

PREMIUM
• Your estimated one-rep max from every set, charted over time, so you can see your strength go up without testing a true max
• Charts of heaviest weight, volume, sets and reps per exercise, plus workout frequency, duration and body weight
• Personal records for every rep range, all-time and for each year
• Exercise history and charts right from the workout screen
• Supersets and drop sets
• Export your workouts to Excel (CSV)

QUESTIONS
Can I see my progress without Premium? Yes. Every workout you've logged stays free to look back through, month by month, and each set starts from last time's numbers. Premium adds the charts, personal records and exercise history inside a workout.
Is it good for beginners? Yes. Start with one of the built-in routines and build your own when you're ready.

RepCount has been downloaded more than 2 million times on iPhone and Android. It's been on the App Store since 2013, with several hundred updates so far, and it keeps getting better. Questions or ideas? Email feedback@repcountapp.com. We read and answer every message.

SUBSCRIPTION
RepCount Premium is an auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account. It renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. If a free trial is offered, any unused part of it ends when you subscribe.

Yuka is a 100% independent project : product reviews and recommendations of healthier alternatives are done in an objective way. No brand or manufacturer can influence them in one way or another. Furthermore, there is no in-app advertising. You can access detailed information on our business model on our website (www.yuka.io).

◆ 6 MILLION REFERENCED PRODUCTS ◆

Yuka established a database that contains 4 million food products and 2 million cosmetic products.

Each food product is evaluated according to 3 objective criteria: nutritional quality, presence of additives and organic aspect of the product.

The method to analyse cosmetic products is based on the analysis of all the ingredients of the product. Each ingredient is assigned a risk level according to the latest scientific data.

Bodly turns the data your iPhone and Apple Watch already collect into clear daily scores, so you can see how your body is doing. Meals, weight and progress photos live in the same place.

DAILY SCORES
Energy: how much you have left through the day, and what drained or recharged it.
Strain: how hard your day and your workouts were on your body.
Recovery: how ready you are for today, based on last night.
Stress: how your body handled the day, hour by hour.
Sleep: how long and how well you slept, with sleep stages.

HEALTH MONITOR
Resting heart rate, heart rate variability (HRV), respiratory rate, blood oxygen, temperature and sleep, each compared with your own normal range, so you notice when something is off.

BIOLOGICAL AGE AND TRAINING LOAD
See how your habits add up over time: an estimate of your biological age with the factors behind it, and whether your recent training load is balanced.

NUTRITION
Take a photo of a meal to estimate its calories and nutrition. Save the meals you eat often, set nutrition goals and track water.

BODY AND PROGRESS
Log weight and body measurements, take progress photos and compare them side by side. Bodly calculates BMI, body fat, lean mass and BMR from your numbers.

ONE TIMELINE
Workouts, meals, weight, measurements, photos and sleep appear together in a daily timeline. Choose the metrics you want on your dashboard, set goals and get recaps of how you did.

WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH
Bodly reads your data from Apple Health with your permission. An Apple Watch is recommended for the daily scores.

Some features require a Bodly Pro subscription.

Bodly is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice.

it.name: Carbon - Macro Coach & Tracker
it.d:
Carbon Diet Coach is your nutrition solution for results that LAST. Whether your goal is to lose fat, build muscle, improve your metabolism, or simply maintain your weight, Carbon Diet Coach removes the guesswork.

Carbon Diet Coach is a science-based nutrition app designed by renowned nutrition coaches Dr. Layne Norton (Ph.D. Nutritional Sciences) and Registered Dietitian Keith Kraker (BS Dietetics).

It does everything a normal nutrition coach would but at a fraction of the cost. Simply select your goal, answer a few short questions, and it does the rest! You will get a customized nutrition plan based on YOUR goals and metabolism.

What's more, Carbon will adjust the plan as you progress to optimize your results. If you hit a plateau or stall, Carbon will make adjustments to keep you progressing towards your goal, just like any good coach would. Our coaching system uses the latest techniques in nutrition science to make sure you get the best results possible.

All you need to do is follow these simple steps:

∙ Log your food using the built-in food tracker
∙ Log your body weight
∙ Check-in each week

Do that and Carbon does the rest!

Carbon Diet Coach can do things other nutrition coaching apps can’t do. For example, your nutrition plan can be tailored to your diet preference:

∙ Balanced
∙ Low Carb
∙ Low Fat
∙ Ketogenic
∙ Plant-Based

Each setting is completely customizable so that you receive a plan that is sustainable for YOU!

Another feature that makes Carbon unique is the diet planner. Want high and low-calorie days rather than eating the same foods every day? Use the diet planner to set up your week and stay on track. Overate on one day and not sure what to do with your nutrition plan for the rest of the week? Adjust the diet planner to account for what you overate and Carbon does the rest!

Other coaching features include:

∙ Adjustable check-in days
∙ Check-in explanations so you're never left wondering why the app did or didn’t make a change
∙ Check-in history so you can look back and see why the app made various adjustments
∙ Charts showing your weight, body fat, lean body mass, calorie intake, protein intake, carbohydrate intake, fat intake, and metabolic rate
∙ Early check-in feature for those who can’t always check in on their specified day
∙ Goal tracker so you can see the progress you’ve made and how close you are to your goal
∙ Recommendations after you reach a goal so you can plan for what's next and KEEP your results
∙ Integrates with Apple Health to automatically read Body Weight and Body Fat values


Already know what you are doing with nutrition and don’t need Carbon to coach you? No problem, you can enter your nutrition targets and simply use the food tracker. Beyond the amazing coaching features of this app is a food tracker that's excellent in its own right. Its features include:

∙ A huge food database
∙ Barcode scanner
∙ Quick add macros

Master anatomy faster and more effectively with our interactive 3D Atlas, Voice AI Tutor, Daily Review, flashcards, study notes, and expert-made videos. Perfect for medical students, athletes, artists, and anyone who wants to truly understand the human body.

Bright, clear illustrations designed for quick memorization. Reinforce learning with engaging quizzes. Flashcards cover all major systems, great for daily practice or exam prep.

3D Quizzes
Test yourself directly on the 3D model by finding and identifying structures — a powerful way to reinforce your memory that no other atlas offers.

Videos

Fitness & Motion
See how muscles work in motion. Learn proper technique execution, improve biomechanics, and avoid mistakes with detailed 3D animations.

it.name: FitWoody Health Sleep Coach
it.d:
FitWoody turns your Apple Watch into a recovery coach. Every morning: HRV, sleep score, training load, VO2 max and a readiness score that tells you when to push or rest.

► YOUR WOODY FOR A HEALTHIER LIFESTYLE
FitWoody goes beyond activity tracking. It listens to your body and adapts your daily goals based on your recovery, energy, and sleep. Woody, your companion, reflects your wellbeing and keeps you motivated through every step of your journey, turning health tracking into something warm, personal, and alive.

► METABOLIC AND HEALTH INSIGHTS
Every night, while you sleep, your Apple Watch quietly measures key health signals like HRV, resting heart rate, VO₂ max, blood oxygen, breathing rate, and body temperature. FitWoody translates those metrics into a simple readiness score that helps you decide whether to push or rest. You’ll wake up with clear insights about your recovery, energy, and how your lifestyle impacts your wellbeing.

► ADAPTIVE DAILY GOALS
Your daily movement goal automatically adjusts based on your body’s state. If you’ve had poor sleep or a stressful day, your targets lower so you can recover guilt-free. If you’re feeling great, FitWoody gently challenges you to go further. It’s a dynamic system that helps you stay consistent without burnout.

► SLEEP ANALYSIS
FitWoody doesn’t just count hours in bed, it helps you understand the quality of your rest. See your time in deep, core, and REM sleep, your recovery trends, and how they influence your energy levels, performance, and mood. Each morning, you’ll know what your body needs next.

► TRAINING ANALYSIS
Every workout is placed in context. FitWoody helps you see how your training affects endurance, cardiovascular load, and overall progress. Whether you’re running, cycling, or doing yoga, the app explains what each session contributed, and when your body needs a break.

► GOALS
We all start with good intentions: “I’ll get fitter,” “I’ll feel better.” FitWoody helps you turn those ideas into actionable, long-term goals. You can create goals around distance, time, frequency, or total elevation, and FitWoody will guide you along the way with reminders, encouragement, and progress updates.

► FITPASSPORT
FitPassport is your long-term view of health, a digital health card that transforms your Apple Watch data into a clear visual narrative. It shows your evolution across cardiovascular, exercise, sleep, and metabolic health, so you can see where you stand and how you’ve improved over time. Not just numbers, meaning.

► APPLE WATCH APP
FitWoody now lives on your wrist. Check your readiness, movement, sleep, and recent workouts directly from your Apple Watch. Built natively for watchOS 11, it’s fast, fluid, and designed to keep you connected to your health in seconds.

► AI-POWERED EXPLANATIONS
With Apple Foundation Models, FitWoody explains your data in plain language: why your HRV dropped, what your sleep says about recovery, and how your body is adapting. Clear insights, always in context.

► PRIVACY FIRST
Your body stays yours. FitWoody processes data locally with Apple Intelligence when available, or anonymizes it before analysis. No ads. No tracking. Ever.

► FITWOODY PLUS
While most of FitWoody’s core features are free, advanced analytics and long-term insights are part of FitWoody Plus. it.name: Box Breathing - Float
it.d:
Unlock the power of breathwork and improve your physical and mental well-being with Float - the ultimate breathing app that makes it easy to breathe. Customize your experience with a breathing test and choose from exercise categories for calm, sleep, focus, quick relief, and energize. Used by top coaches and athletes, Float combines an audio guide, haptic feedback, and sound cues for a truly immersive breathing experience. 

Breathing is an essential practice for both your physical and mental well-being and Float is the ultimate breathing app that guides you through personalized breathing exercises to help you increase your performance throughout the day and reduce stress & anxiety. With Float, you can take a CO2 tolerance test, which gives us a reliable idea about your breathing in the last weeks and months. This test allows us to customize the breathwork to your very individual demands, ensuring you get the most out of each session. Whether you're an athlete or an office worker, practicing breathwork can be a powerful way to boost your health, and performance, control your nervous system and manage anxiety. Practicing breathwork is scientifically proven to increase your physical and mental performance.

The benefits of learning to breathe with Float are endless, including relief from stress and anxiety, emotional healing, increased CO2 tolerance, improved immunity, and easier sleep. You'll also develop or increase self-awareness, enrich your creativity, improve focus and clarity, and boost your confidence and self-esteem. Breathwork with Float can also help you process emotions, heal emotional pain and trauma, and increase your CO2 tolerance. Additionally, it can help boost your immunity, fall asleep easily, enrich creativity, and improve focus, gain clarity and reduce brain fog.
Float's breathwork exercises are curated by some of the top breathing coaches and are used by psychologists, physiotherapists, Olympic athletes, Navy SEALs, freedivers, yogis, and neuroscientists. We continue to work on expanding the breathwork exercises library to cover the most frequent stressful events occurring during the day. 

Breathing exercises are categorized into CALM, SLEEP, FOCUS, QUICK RELIEF, and ENERGIZE. The list of breathing exercises available in Float includes:

– 4-7-8: Drift into sleep
– Acumen: Get clarity, get focused
– Alert: Get ready for action
– Balance: Reconcile left & right brain
– Box Breathing: Be right here, right now
– Coherent: Stabilize your mood
– Doping: Pre-workout routine
– Ninja: Get calm like a ninja
– Recovery: Cool down after a workout
– Resonance: Sharpen your mind
– Slumber: Sleep soundly
– Sunrise: Rise & shine
– Sunset: End the day in serenity
– Unblock: Set your nose free
– Wind Down: Take a moment to deeply relax
– NSDR: Non-Sleep Deep Rest


Please be aware that sessions can cause and are not limited to:
– Tingling
– Dizziness
– Trembling, shaking, or other physical sensations
– Emotional experiences
– Experience energy moving through your body

Got a question? Send us an email at team@keepfloating.com

DISCLAIMER:
This content in the Float app is not medical advice or a treatment plan and is intended for general education and demonstration purposes only. The content should not be used to self-diagnose or self-treat any health, medical, or physical condition. Don’t use this content to avoid going to your own healthcare professional or to replace the advice they give you. Consult with your healthcare professional before doing anything contained in this content.

it.name: stoic. journal & mental health
it.d:
stoic is your mental health companion – it helps you understand your emotions and provides insights on how to be happier, more productive, and overcome obstacles.

At its heart, stoic helps you prepare for your day in the morning and reflect on your day in the evening. In the process, we also guide you to journal with thought-provoking prompts, build better habits, track your moods, and more.

** ‘Featured App of the Day’ - Apple **

* Join over 4 million stoics bettering their lives *

“I have never used a journal app that has impacted my life so much. It's my best friend.” –  Michael

MORNING PREPARATION & EVENING REFLECTION:

• Start the perfect day with our personalized daily planner. Prepare your notes and to-do list so nothing can surprise you during the day.
• Track your mood throughout the day and do bite-sized mental health exercises if you need them.
• Reflect on your actions with our habit tracker in the evening to grow as a human and get better every day.

GUIDED JOURNALS:

Whether you're a journaling pro or new to the practice, stoic offers a welcoming space with guided journals, suggestions, and prompts to inspire reflection and cultivate the habit. If writing is not your cup of tea, you can also journal with voice notes and pictures/videos of your day.

Choose from topics in productivity, happiness, gratitude, stress & anxiety, relationships, therapy, self-discovery, and much more. Stoic also has templates to help you with a variety of situations like preparing for a therapy session, CBT-based thought dumps, dream & nightmare journal, etc.

Journaling is a therapeutic tool for clearing the mind, expressing thoughts, setting goals, practicing gratitude, emotional wellbeing, and promoting self-reflection.


MENTAL HEALTH TOOLS:

stoic provides you with the tools you need to feel better, reduce stress & anxiety, manage ADHD, be mindful and more.

• Meditation – unguided or guided sessions to help you meditate with background sounds and timed chimes.
• Breathing – science-backed exercises to help you relax, focus, feel calm, sleep better and more.
• Stoic Shield - block distracting apps and reduce screen time.
• Sleep Better - journal your dreams, nightmares, and overcome insomnia with lessons by Huberman and Sleep Foundation.
• Quotes & Affirmations – read up on stoic philosophy and better your mood.
• Therapy Notes – prepare for your therapy sessions, track your progress, and reflect on them.
• Daily Prompts - thought-provoking prompts to help you journal better.

AND SO MUCH MORE:

• Privacy – protect your journal with a passcode, TouchID, or FaceID.
• Streaks & Badges – stay motivated on your journey with our habit tracker.
• Journey – reflect on your history, search based on prompts, see how your responses changed over time and see your growth.
• Trends – visualize metrics that matter to you including mood, emotions, sleep, health, writing, and more.
• Export – share your journal diary with your therapist.
• iCloud Sync – seamlessly sync your journal across your iPhone, Mac, iPad and Apple Watch and safely backup stoic on your personal iCloud storage.
• Siri Shortcuts – start a journal by simply asking Siri.
• Health App Integration – track your mindful minutes, sleep and more in Trends.

We’re constantly adding more mental health tools to help you overcome more obstacles and situations. You can also join our supportive community on Discord and leave your suggestions in our feedback board.

STOIC PREMIUM:

• Enjoy unlimited access to premium features on a subscription basis.
• Your payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
• You can easily manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in Apple's settings.
• Read our Terms & Conditions at https://getstoic.com/terms-and-conditions

If you choose not to purchase stoic Premium, you can still journal with stoic for free.

White Noise for Staying On Task

For adults with ADHD, distractions can make staying on task a more significant challenge than usual.

If you have trouble shutting out the world when you need to study, write, paint, spark creativity, sleep, or get down to business at work, this free service is perfect for your needs.

Often someone who has ADHD can think better and stay on task longer if there is some white noise in her surroundings—maybe softly playing music, a fan in the corner, or the hum from an overhead air vent. So far, researchers have found benefits for those with inattention but not impulsivity, but the benefits of white noise don’t continue when it is no longer present. In the real world, people cannot control the sounds that surround them throughout the day. Although researchers are exploring whether white noise may provide complementary support for some people with inattentive ADHD, the evidence is inconclusive.

Research on white noise for inattentive ADHD

Most research on white noise has focused on children still in elementary or middle school; however, the results seem to be applicable also to teens and adults. For adults working from home at this time, having white noise available could be beneficial when it comes to staying on task.

it.name: Medication List
it.d:
PROBLEM SOLVED: Take the stress out of managing your health regimen. Forget trying to remember if you took your morning pills or trying to track complex prescription intervals on a paper calendar. Whether you are managing chronic conditions, daily prescriptions, birth control, or a detailed vitamin and supplement routine, Medication List ensures you stay perfectly on track.
With a clean, distraction-free interface, highly customizable scheduling, and glanceable home screen widgets, managing your health has never been easier or more reliable.

KEY FEATURES YOU’LL LOVE:
• HOME SCREEN MEDICATION WIDGETS: Keep your health front and center. Use our sleek iOS Home Screen widgets to view "Today's Meds" at a glance and track your upcoming doses without even opening the app.

Differentiate your morning vitamins from your critical evening prescriptions by sound alone, ensuring you instantly recognize which dose is due without even looking at your screen.
• ADVANCED & FLEXIBLE SCHEDULING: No schedule is too complex. Choose from highly customizable dosing intervals perfectly tailored to your doctor's orders: 
	• Daily or specific days of the week
	• Custom intervals (e.g., Every 2 days, Every 10 days) 
	• Multi-month cycles (Every 2, 3, or 6 months) 
	• "As Needed" (PRN) for pain relief or episodic supplements
• SMART REMINDERS & URGENT NOTIFICATIONS: Receive timely, reliable push notifications to take your doses. Customize your experience by selecting unique alert sounds, setting up helpful snooze options, or enabling "Urgent Notifications" for critical prescriptions that can't be missed.

it.name: Oniri - Your Dream Journal
it.d:
“Helps you track your dreams, analyze them and even teaches you how to lucid dream.” ~Forbes

The #1 dream app that helped track millions of dreams.

Oniri (previously Capture) is the most complete app for dream journaling, dream interpretation, and lucid dreaming.

◆ DREAM JOURNAL
The most complete dream journal app to track everything about your dreams.

□ Write down or record and transcribe your dreams
□ Track emotions, people, places, context, and much more
□ Generate images with AI or draw your dreams

◆ DREAM INTERPRETATION
Understand the meaning of your dreams with personalized dream interpretation, based on science.

□ Get a personalized interpretation of your dream with AI, based on science
□ The AI asks you questions to deepen the understanding of your dream
□ Access nightmare analysis, trends, and correlations modules to discover patterns in your dreams

◆ LUCID DREAMS
Start having lucid dreams now with all the most popular techniques for lucid dreaming.

□ Reality check reminders and widgets
□ Night cues and alarms to hear in your dreams
□ WILD, MILD, SSILD: guided tracks to perform all the popular lucid dreaming techniques
□ Soundtracks and binaural beats to guide your sleep
□ Track dream goals and dream signs

◆ AND MORE
Everything else you expect from a dream journal.

□ Password protection to protect your journal
□ Export your dreams to PDF, TXT, CSV or even video
□ Calendar view
□ Advanced statistics
□ Filter & search

◆ DREAM SYMBOLS AND DREAM DICTIONARY
What does your dream mean? Look up hundreds of general dream interpretations, like a dream dictionary, and follow the dream symbols, people, and places that come back in your dreams night after night.

◆ NIGHTMARES AND RECURRING DREAMS
Bad dreams and recurring dreams usually have something to say. The nightmare analysis shows how often they come back, what you feel during them, and who shows up in them, so you can see the pattern instead of just living it.

◆ WHY KEEP A DREAM DIARY?
The more dreams you record, the more dreams you remember. A dream diary also makes dream interpretation and lucid dreaming much easier, because you start to recognize your own dream signs, dream symbols, and patterns.

◆ WELCOME TO YOUR DREAMS

Whether you want to remember more of your dreams, understand what they mean, or have your first lucid dream, Oniri has what you need. Hundreds of guides and stories along the way will help you learn more about yourself.

Oniri was first released in 2015 under the name Capture, and has been developed with dreamers around the world ever since. Same app, same team, new name.

Enjoy the app and sweet dreams!

it.d:
ParrotPal: Wellness Made Simple

Life is busy, and staying healthy can feel overwhelming. ParrotPal is here to help you build sustainable habits that fit your lifestyle—with minimal effort.
Our app makes it easy to track your food, stay active, and make balanced choices—all without overthinking. Focus on small, daily actions and feel good about taking steps toward a healthier you.

What Makes ParrotPal Different?
Effortless Food Logging
 Logging meals has never been easier. Simply type, speak, or scan your food, and we’ll take care of the rest. No complicated steps or endless scrolling—just quick and easy tracking that fits into your day.

Track What Matters
 Forget about juggling a million numbers. With ParrotPal, you’ll focus on just three key habits: mindful eating, staying active, and making balanced choices. A little consistency goes a long way.

Stay Flexible
 Whether you’re dining out, sharing a home-cooked meal, or on the go, ParrotPal makes it simple to keep track. Use voice or text input to quickly estimate your food intake and move on with your day.

Personalized Adjustments
 Your habits evolve over time, and so do your needs. ParrotPal helps guide you by suggesting gentle updates to your food and activity goals based on your progress and lifestyle.
Recipe Inspiration at Your Fingertips

 Need meal ideas? ParrotPal offers access to thousands of easy-to-make recipes that fit a variety of tastes and preferences.
Seamless Step Tracking
 Sync with Apple Healthkit to effortlessly monitor your daily movement and celebrate the little wins.

A Healthier You, One Day at a Time
ParrotPal is designed to simplify wellness—not to complicate it. We help you focus on practical, sustainable habits that build over time. It’s not about perfection or quick fixes; it’s about making small changes that fit your unique life.

What You’ll Get with ParrotPal
Easy voice or text-based meal logging
Barcode scanning for quick food tracking
A verified food database for accuracy and convenience
A library of 16,000+ recipes to inspire healthy eating
Weekly insights to help guide your journey
Step tracking with Apple Healthkit integration
A 7-day free trial with practical tips and daily podcasts
Start Your Journey Today

Download ParrotPal and enjoy a 7-day free trial with access to all features. Try daily tips, mini tasks, and podcasts to help you build habits that last.
Subscription options after the trial include weekly, monthly, and yearly plans. Subscriptions automatically renew, but you can cancel anytime in your app store settings.
The subscription will auto-renew. You can cancel this at any time by going to “subscriptions” in the app store. 

Important Disclaimer
ParrotPal is designed to support general wellness and habit-building. The app’s content is not intended as medical advice. Always consult with a qualified healthcare professional before making medical decisions or relying on information provided by ParrotPal.

it.name: PeakWatch: AI Health Coach
it.d:
PeakWatch turns your health data into clear, personalized guidance.

By connecting sleep, stress, recovery, activity, training, and nutrition, PeakWatch helps you understand what is affecting your body today and which small actions may help you feel better over time. 

Whether you want to improve your sleep, manage stress, exercise more consistently, eat with greater awareness, or simply understand your Apple Watch data, PeakWatch gives you the context your numbers are missing.

◎ Key Features

==AI is now available in PeakWatch==
Have questions about your recovery, sleep quality, exertion levels, or recent performance? Just ask. Your data now comes with explanations, insights, and context.

UNDERSTAND YOUR BODY TODAY
PeakWatch analyzes signals including HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, breathing, stress, activity, and recent workouts to help you understand:
- How well you are recovering
- What may be affecting your energy
- Whether today is better suited to activity or recovery
- How your current state compares with your normal pattern

TRACK ENERGY AND STRESS
Body Energy combines sleep, recovery, activity, and stress to show how your energy changes throughout the day.
Stress tracking helps you notice when physiological stress rises and how it may relate to sleep, movement, and daily habits.

SLEEP WITH MORE CONTEXT
Explore sleep duration, consistency, interruptions, restorative sleep, sleep debt, HRV, heart rate, respiratory rate, blood oxygen, and sleep stages.
See how sleep may be affecting your energy, recovery, and stress the next day.

MOVE AT THE RIGHT LEVEL
PeakWatch suggests an appropriate activity range based on recovery, recent training, and cardiovascular load.
You can also access detailed workout analysis, heart rate zones, effort scores, training impact, heart rate recovery, and long-term training balance.
Choose from more than 100 workouts across strength, HIIT, hybrid, and HYROX, or create your own custom sessions.

EAT WITH GREATER AWARENESS
Log meals with a photo and use AI-assisted analysis to estimate calories and nutrients.
Track energy balance, protein, carbohydrates, fat, and nutrition trends over time.

SEE LONG-TERM PROGRESS
Follow trends across sleep, stress, recovery, activity, cardiovascular fitness, nutrition, and training.
Understand what is improving, what may be holding you back, and which habits appear to be helping.

NOTICE WHAT AFFECTS YOU
Add events such as alcohol, illness, travel, late meals, soreness, or stressful days, then see how they may relate to changes in sleep and recovery.

APPLE WATCH
View your current health status directly from your wrist with multiple watch face options and complications.

# Contact Us
Email: hi@peakwatch.co
Instagram: @getPeakWatch
We’d love to hear your thoughts! Your feedback fuels our improvements.

# Subscription and Terms
PeakWatch is available for free with the option to upgrade to PeakWatch PRO with an auto-renewing subscription. You may switch off auto-renew in your Apple ID Account Settings.

Purchases of PRO subscriptions will be charged using your Apple ID upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew on a monthly or yearly frequency unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. If canceled, subscriptions remain valid until the end of the current period, and any unused portions are not valid for a refund.

PeakWatch reads data from HealthKit. All health data is stored and processed locally on your device.

# Subscription and Terms
PeakWatch is free to use, with the option to upgrade to PeakWatch PRO for advanced features. Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Service: https://peakwatch.co/en/service/terms-of-use.html
Privacy Policy: https://peakwatch.co/en/service/privacy-policy.html

# Disclaimer
PeakWatch provides general information and is not a substitute for medical advice or treatment. Consult a healthcare professional for medical concerns.

it.name: Amble: Step Counter & Race
it.d:
Walking is boring alone. Amble turns your daily steps into a race with the people you actually know.

Start an Amble with friends, family or workmates. Everyone's steps land on one live leaderboard, the day closes at midnight, and someone wins. Tomorrow you go again.

RACE THE PEOPLE YOU KNOW
Create a group - an Amble - and invite anyone with a link or a QR code. Steps sync from Apple Health all day, so the board moves while you move. No manual logging, ever.

HEAD TO HEAD STEP RACES
Challenge one person to a step race over a day or a week. Pick the target, pick the opponent, and watch it play out live. Winner takes the bragging rights.

STREAKS THAT ACTUALLY MEAN SOMETHING
Hit your daily goal and your streak grows. Miss it and it's gone - which is exactly why it works. Set the goal yourself, from a gentle 5,000 to a serious 20,000.

THE STEP WALLET
Every step past your goal is banked. Fall short on a bad day and your wallet quietly covers the difference, and your streak survives. Because one late meeting shouldn't undo three weeks.

A GROUP CHAT THAT KNOWS THE SCORE
Every Amble has its own chat - photos, reactions, replies. Poke someone who's slacking. Send a step race straight into the conversation.

YOUR WORKOUTS, NOT JUST YOUR STEPS
Record a walk, run, ride or hike and Amble maps the route and charts your heart rate. Or import everything you have already recorded on your Apple Watch and elsewhere - your feed starts full, not empty.

WHAT THE NUMBERS ARE
Your step counts come from Apple Health and the iPhone's motion coprocessor, and we never touch them. Not to flatter a leaderboard, not to save a streak. The number you see is the number you walked.

AMBLE PRO
- Unlimited Ambles and step races
- The Step Wallet, to protect the streak you have built
- Full workout history import
- Everything, with a 7 day free trial

Amble is free to use. Amble Pro is an optional auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly, charged to your Apple ID. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends, and you can cancel any time in your App Store settings.

Avrora is the best sleep tracking app for those who would like to fall asleep easily and wake up energized with the help of special breathing techniques, mindfulness sessions, calming sounds–including white noise, nature sounds and sleep music– and refreshing alarm melodies.

The Avrora sleep helper app is based on the only extremely effective drug-free option for overcoming sleeping problems. Unlike sleeping pills, our sleep monitor it helps to eliminate the underlying causes of sleeping problems and develop better sleep habits.

HOW AVRORA WORKS

Falling asleep:
Deep calm breathing combined with relaxing sleep music and sleep sounds leads to the predominance of the processes of inhibition in the central nervous system. It allows Avrora to regulate pressure and heartbeat, focus attention on breathing, thereby distracting from unwanted thoughts and promoting better sleep. Deep and controlled breathing is evolutionarily associated with a feeling of rest and relaxation. In addition, soothing sleep sounds provide an opportunity to relax and get a positive emotion, effectively reducing the likelihood of excitation before sleep.

Sleep recording:
Our sleep tracker app is also a snore recorder and sleep recorder which helps you track snoring and other sleep habits, including sleep apnea.

Sleep retention:
Breathing techniques results in more reliable replacement of wakefulness rhythms (alpha and beta waves) with low-amplitude sleep waves (theta and delta waves), thus making sleep much more durable. Meditation sessions promote deep relaxation and mindfulness, bring the body to a deep and lasting sleep. Bedtime meditation qualitatively improves the most fragile REM phase, which allows you to complete a full sleep cycle and feel yourself full of energy in the morning.

Waking Up Refreshed
After a good deep sleep your body is restored and is ready to function in full. Our Smart alarm analyzes your sleep patterns and wakes you up gently from the lightest phase in your sleep cycle. Pleasant alarm melodies allow you to wake up gently, gradually and with no stress. It is very important for mental wellness to live the first minutes of your day with positive emotions and thoughts.

Sleep Sounds
Our sleep app offers a variety of nature sounds, sleep music, white noise, brown noise and pink noise options to choose from to ensure you can wind down from your stressful day, relieve anxiety and relax.

WHY DO YOU NEED AVRORA?
Ask yourself the following questions:
- Do you face difficulty getting to sleep or staying asleep?
- Do you feel tired in the morning right after you wake up?
- Do you have difficulty concentrating during the day?
- Are you struggling to stay organized?
- Do you feel so tired that all you can think about is sleep?

If you answered yes to any of these questions, then you can definitely benefit from using the Avrora app for sleep and wellness. Download Avrora and enjoy your perfect sleep experience.

Start with a Burst: a ready-made morning, afternoon or evening built around activities that stand up to scrutiny. All the details are worked out. You just pick one and get into it.

Then hold on to the activities you want to keep doing to meet the goals you care about. Get feedback after every session and understand your wins with research-based feedback. Just keep turning up. Good weeks, bad weeks, it doesn’t matter. Your personalised check-in will help you work out the smart changes to make.

START WITH A BURST

Everywhere you look, someone's got a routine and they're sure it's the one. Doing something good for yourself shouldn't mean knowing how to put a routine together, or following some intense protocol that’s never going to work for you.

- A Burst turns the kind of routine you'd normally screenshot and forget about into something you schedule and do. Nothing in it is random. The activities, order, timing and the guides you’ll need are all worked out for you.
- Try a few and you start getting a feel for what suits you: what clicked, what helped you feel better, what you would do again.
- It’s a routine to try while you’re working out what suits you. Bearmore helps you keep going, whether that means another Burst, a plan you can keep turning up for, or a single activity you want to revisit.

Do one and you have more than a session logged. You have a morning, afternoon or evening worth bragging about. Do a few and you have the start of knowing what’s going to work for you.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Try Bursts. They’re free and every detail is worked out.
2. Use guides for 46 activities, from 3 minutes to 3 hours.
3. Work out which activities you want to keep doing.
4. Decide what matters. Your goals in your words.
5. Turn your activities, goals and time into a game plan.
6. Understand your wins with research-based feedback.
7. Just keep turning up. Good weeks, bad weeks, it doesn’t matter. We’ll help you know what to do next to keep moving in the right direction.

BUILT FOR YOUR LIFE

Even with the best intentions, life can get in the way. When work blows out, family stuff happens, and you’re tired, you don’t have to put it all on hold. Instead, flex for the situation and do what’s possible. That’s the smart move.

* Choose short purpose-built guides for your activities when time is tight
* Ditch the guides and do it yourself when you know what you’re doing
* Swap to something less demanding on the harder days, then step it back up when you’ve got more in the tank
* Dial the pace back for a full fortnight if life is hitting you from every angle

WHAT YOU'LL EXPERIENCE

- Bursts you can do in a morning, afternoon or evening, solo or with someone
- Evidence-backed activities, linked to tangible benefits
- Clear, plain-language guidance, so you know what to do and why
- Feedback shaped by your session data, not generic advice
- Early wins and numbers you can make decisions with

• Identify and challenge negative thought patterns
• Track mood fluctuations and recognize triggers
• Practice gratitude to boost optimism and resilience
• Process complex emotions through expressive writing
• Build sustainable mental wellness habits

**PROVEN BENEFITS**

Research shows that regular journaling can:

• Reduce stress and anxiety by up to 40%

• Support better sleep quality
• Strengthen psychological resilience

it.name: Eye Care 20 20 20
it.d:
Give your eyes the break they're begging for just for a little cost.

Staring at screens all day leaves your eyes dry, tired, red, and strained. Eyecare 20 20 20 fixes that with one gentle reminder every 20 minutes — and now it can run on its own, so you never have to remember to start it.

It's built on the doctor-recommended 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds. That tiny habit relaxes your eye muscles, reduces digital eye strain, and helps prevent the dryness and redness that come from long screen time.

Set it once, then forget it.

Tell Eyecare your working hours — for example, weekdays from 8 to 4 — and the app starts and stops your reminders automatically on those days. No tapping, no thinking about it. Your eye breaks just happen while you work.

Prefer a nudge instead? Set a fixed daily reminder and the app will tell you when it's time to start, so the habit sticks even on your busiest days.

Three ways to use it — pick what fits you:
* Manual — Tap Start when you begin, tap Stop when you're done.
* Auto-schedule — Choose your days and hours (like weekdays 8–4) and reminders run automatically.
* Daily start reminder — Get a nudge at a fixed time to begin your session.

Dead simple. Zero learning curve.

No accounts. No complicated settings. Whether you run it by hand or let it run itself, Eyecare quietly works in the background while you do.
Why you'll love it

Automatic eye break reminders every 20 minutes
Auto-run on your chosen days and hours — set it and forget it
Daily reminder to start your session on time
Based on the proven 20-20-20 eye care rule
One-tap start and stop
Lightweight and runs quietly in the background
Perfect for anyone who works, studies, games, or scrolls on screens

If you spend hours in front of a computer, phone, or tablet, your eyes are working overtime. Eyecare 20 20 20 gives them the regular rest they need to stay comfortable, clear, and healthy.
Download now and start taking care of your eyes today.

it.name: Intermittent Fasting Tracker ⁺
it.d:
Unlock the power of intermittent fasting to reach your goal weight and get healthy. No diet and no yo-yo effect. Improve your metabolic health  and feel full of energy.

What is intermittent fasting?
Intermittent fasting is one of the most popular health and fitness trends. Instead of a diet, it's an eating pattern that cycles between periods of fasting and eating. It doesn't specify which foods you should eat or avoid, but when you should eat.
Today, we eat 3–4 (or more) meals per day, and never feel hungry. This requires our organs to work hard all the time, and never take a break from digesting. Our eating habits may result in obesity and health problems, such as diabetes.
When fasting, your body will detoxify, burn fat and regenerate. After a few weeks, you'll feel healthier and more active. 

Gradual fasting plans, suitable for all! 
Create your own fasting plan 13-11, 15-9, 16-10, 16-8, 18-6, 20-4, 23-1, 24, 36, 48, Custom
5+2 Weekly Plan : During the week, eat normally for 5 days, and choose another 2 days for a little control.Women take 500Kcal and men take 600Kcal on fasting days. You can choose to take it all at once, but a better choice is to divide 600Kcal into two meals, 250Kcal for breakfast and 350Kcal for dinner. The food should preferably be some food with high protein content but low glycemic index (GI). It is not recommended to completely eliminate carbohydrates. When eating, chew slowly and savor well. The fasting days need to be separated, such as Monday and Thursday. This light fasting plan is healthy, effective and easy to implement, allowing you to lose weight easily while enjoying the other benefits of fasting. It can be performed long-term, gradually turning it into a healthy lifestyle.
16-8 is the most popular fasting plan for weight loss. With 16 hours fasting period, your body will gradually get used to fasting. 
 
Body Status Tracker : 
Blood Sugar Rises 
Blood Sugar Falls 
Glycogen Reserve Drops 
Ketosis State

- Track your weight changes 
- BMI(kg/m²) 
- Water tracker 
- Drink water reminder

▶UNDERSTAND YOUR DAILY READINESS◀
[KEY HEALTH METRICS]
Start your day with a summary of key vitals and sleep, helping you detect changes before you feel them. Receive workout suggestions that respond to your readiness. Set home screen widgets to bring this info closer to you.

Your progress with weekly, monthly and yearly charts, including a weekly, monthly and yearly recap.

[LIVE ACTIVITY & WIDGETS]

[ACCESSIBLE TO ALL]
Full support for accessibility preferences including bold text, dynamic type, reduced transparency, increased contrast, motion adjustments, and voiceover.

LOG IT, THEN GET BACK TO YOUR DAY

• A chart of your logged readings

SEE YOUR OWN PATTERNS

• Time-of-day averages (Pro)

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE

FREE AND PRO

Glucora Pro adds more manual readings, 30- and 90-day summaries, time-of-day and meal averages, PDF reports and more reminders. Pro is available as a weekly or yearly auto-renewable subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Any free trial is shown before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. it.name: Inflow - Manage Your ADHD
it.d:
A science-based ADHD app for focus, productivity, and daily life. Manage your ADHD in just 5 minutes a day!

Inflow is designed by people with ADHD, for people with ADHD. We are not a glorified timer or calendar. Inflow is a science-based program designed to help you manage focus, procrastination, and follow-through in a way that works with your brain, not against it. Developed with clinical psychologists and featured in peer-reviewed research.

DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU? 

Do you struggle with focus, organization, or procrastination? Does "task paralysis" stop you from starting simple chores? Have you abandoned planners and trackers in the past? ADHD doesn’t have to hold you back. Inflow can help.

WHY INFLOW? 

Inflow is based on Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) principles. We don't just give you a tool; we teach you the "why" behind your brain and how to cope when motivation is low.
Thriving starts with understanding your unique neurodivergence. Meet your goals, kick the distraction habit, and create a daily structure adapted to you.

SCIENCE-BASED MODULES FOR ADHD SUPPORT (CBT-INSPIRED)

Spend less time planning and more time doing. We help you improve skills in:

- Focus and concentration
- Attention and Hyperactivity
- Goal Setting and Consistency
- Time management and routines
- Emotional regulation and self-criticism
- Reducing distraction & Phone addiction
- Impulsivity & Anxiety related to ADHD
- Mindfulness & Nutrition
- Managing RSD (Rejection Sensitive Dysphoria)

MEET QUINN, YOUR AI ADHD COMPANION 
Stuck in a scroll hole? Overwhelmed by a messy kitchen? Chat with Quinn to think things through and get unstuck!

- Instant Task Breakdown: Ask Quinn to break big projects into manageable steps.
- Judgment-Free Support: Get personalized strategies or just vent without shame.
- 24/7 Availability: Guidance whenever you need it, day or night.

LIVE BODY DOUBLING & COMMUNITY
You don't have to do this alone.

- Coworking sessions: Join live or on-demand focus rooms. Body doubling is the #1 way to crush procrastination for ADHDers. 

- Supportive Community: Share wins and struggles in a stigma-free space.

TOOLS FOR EVERYDAY LIFE

Inflow helps you build routines one day at a time. Whether studying, organizing your home, or making space for self-care, our tools help you focus on what matters most.

WHO IS INFLOW FOR? 

Whether you’re newly diagnosed, late-diagnosed, or still figuring things out, ADHD doesn’t have to dictate your day. Inflow meets you wherever you are on your journey. You do not need a formal diagnosis to use our tools.

- Think you might have ADHD? If you relate to things like distraction, time blindness, or task paralysis but don’t have a formal diagnosis, Inflow can help you understand your brain and start building better habits. No doctor’s note required.

- Newly Diagnosed? Diagnosis explains the ”what”, but Inflow teaches the “how”. We bridge the gap between clinical diagnosis and daily life by teaching you the practical CBT skills and coping mechanisms that complement medication and clinical care.

- Living with ADHD? Even pros hit burnout. Consistency is hard! Inflow provides the external structure and community accountability ("Body Doubling") you need to stay on track and reset when life gets overwhelming.

- Struggling with Executive Function? Focus and regulation issues aren't exclusive to ADHD. Whether navigating Autism (ASD), OCD, Depression, or general burnout, our tools help you overcome paralysis regardless of your specific label.

Disclaimer: Inflow is a support tool and educational program; it is not a medical device and does not replace professional medical advice or treatment.

Questions or feedback? Shoot us an email! hello@getinflow.io

it.name: KnowDrugs Drug Checking
it.d:
KnowDrugs is the easiest way to lookup drug testing results, pill warnings and drug alerts and provides you with drug info about more than 200 drugs, along with advice on harm reduction and safer use. Taking drugs always involves risks - however, if you do decide to take drugs, KnowDrugs can help you to take appropriate measures to reduce potential harms.

DRUG INFORMATION & EDUCATION

Check the profiles of more than 200 drugs for educational purposes: Stimulants like MDMA and Amphetamine, depressants such as Alcohol and Benzodiazepines or psychedelics like 2C-B, LSD and DMT.

KnowDrugs provides you with drug education harm reduction advice, focusing on MDMA / Molly / Ecstasy and other psychoactive substances. Knowing about the wanted and unwanted effects of drugs, their duration, interactions and risks helps you to make more informed decisions, reduce risks and reflect upon your drug habits and consumption behaviour.

DRUG CHECKING, PILL WARNINGS & DRUG ALERTS

Search for drug name, substance or location, to find drug alerts from nearby and learn about their ingredients and dosage strength to avoid overdose and particularly dangerous cuts (e.g. PMA).

Drug checking or pill testing is a way to reduce the harm from drug consumption by allowing users to find out the content and purity of substances that they intend to consume. This empowers users to make safer choices: to avoid more dangerous substances and combination and to use smaller quantities.

If you don't have access to professional drug testing services, looking up recent drug testing results can still help you make a more informed decision about your consumption.

HARM REDUCTION & RESPONSIBLE DRUG USE

Harm reduction aims to minimize the harms associated with recreational substance use. The harm reduction approach follows from the idea that substance use is a high-risk activity that innately entails the possibility of injury, addiction, and death. Therefore, the best strategy one can employ (outside of avoiding use entirely) is to take appropriate measures to mitigate its potential harms.

KnowDrugs highlights the harm-potential of more than 200 substances and demonstrates strategies on how to reduce the harms associated with the consumption of drugs.

KNOWDRUGS CAN ALSO HELP YOU  TO:

- learn how to spot and react in case of an emergency, take care of someone experiencing a bad trip at a party or festival
- find a free and confidential counselling service which accepts you and your personal choices, and helps you develop the right strategies and competencies if you want to change something about your consumption behaviour.

Note: Always check in with your doctor in addition to using the app and before making any medical decisions. This app is not a replacement for professional medical and/or psychological help.
