it.name: Water Tracker & Reminder: Nami
it.d:
Drinking enough water sounds simple, but it is easy to forget when life gets busy. Coffee, tea, juice, and alcohol hydrate you differently than water, so a water-only log misses the rest of your day.

Nami is a water tracker and hydration reminder designed to make drinking better feel simple and rewarding. Log what you drink, follow a personalized daily goal, build healthy habits, and grow a garden along the way.

WHY NAMI IS DIFFERENT

- More than a water counter: Track hydration, caffeine, and alcohol across the drinks you consume.
- A garden that grows with you: Build streaks, reach goals, earn awards, and unlock plants.
- Personalized goals: Get a suggested daily target based on your body, activity, and weather.
- Units that work for you: Track in milliliters or fluid ounces.
- Private by design: Your hydration history stays on your device and, when enabled, in your private iCloud account.
- Apple ecosystem: Sync with Apple Health and log drinks using widgets, Siri, Shortcuts, and Control Center.

TRACK WHAT YOU DRINK

Log water, coffee, tea, milk, juice, electrolyte drinks, soda, mocktails, alcohol, and more.

Nami accounts for the hydration contribution of each drink instead of treating everything like plain water. It also tracks caffeine and alcohol where relevant, helping you understand what you consume throughout the day.

Choose from the drink library, keep your favorites close, adjust serving sizes, or create custom drinks with their own hydration, caffeine, and alcohol values.

SET A GOAL THAT FITS YOU

Start with a recommended daily hydration goal based on your body weight, activity level, and weather, or set your own target at any time.

Follow your progress throughout the day with a clear visual water tracker and see how much remains before you reach your goal.

BUILD A HEALTHY DRINKING HABIT

Set hydration reminders around your schedule:

- Choose when reminders begin and end.
- Set the interval that works for you.
- Pick from a collection of playful sounds.

GROW YOUR GARDEN

Every healthy habit deserves a reward.

Reach hydration goals, maintain streaks, try different drinks, and keep logging to earn awards and unlock new plants. Watch your personal garden grow as your hydration habit becomes stronger.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS OVER TIME

Review your hydration history through a visual calendar and detailed daily timelines.

Track:

- Current hydration streak.
- Days you reached your goal.
- Total days logged.
- Lifetime effective hydration.
- Drinks, caffeine, and alcohol recorded each day.
- Awards earned and plants unlocked.

Share your daily progress, garden, and achievements with friends.

PRIVATE AND SECURE

Your hydration history is personal. Nami stores it on your device and, if you enable iCloud sync, in your private iCloud account. Apple Health integration is optional and controlled by you.

NAMI PRO

Nami includes daily hydration tracking, reminders, awards, the garden, and Apple integrations for free.

Nami Pro unlocks the complete drinks library, custom drinks, full history, additional reminder sounds, and watermark-free sharing. Monthly, yearly, lifetime, and Family Sharing options are available.

- Terms: https://github.com/preetmishra/apps/blob/main/nami/terms.md
- Support: https://github.com/preetmishra/apps/blob/main/nami/support.md

Nami is a self-management tool and does not replace professional medical advice. Always consult a healthcare provider for advice specific to you.

Noise Machine is the best noise maker app! The beautiful design of this white noise maker app is a joy to use each night.

Noise Machine features four “colors” of noise - each with different properties:

• Brown Noise (also known as Red Noise) has a rich, deeper character with strong low frequencies and roars like a river or an ocean. Brown noise is beneficial for sleep, and even more effective when played through a powerful speaker to bring out its deep tones. Our brown noise is mathematically accurate, representing the true nature of brown noise.

• Green Noise has an ambient and natural feel that gives the feeling of being in a forest or river valley. Green noise is energizing like a long walk in the woods.

• Pink Noise has a more balanced texture that highlights the middle frequencies evenly, like a calming rain storm. Our pink noise is mathematically balanced.

• White Noise is pure and flat with an equal balance of low, medium, and high-frequency sound. White noise may sound like a waterfall cascading down a rocky cliff. Our white noise is mathematically accurate, representing true white noise.

Noise Machine now works with Siri. Say “Hey Siri, play Noise Machine” to pick right up where you left off with your favorite noise. You can also say:

“Hey Siri, play brown noise on Noise Machine.”

Are you often distracted by irritating sounds when trying to sleep at night, like city noise, loud traffic, the fan ticking, the neighbor’s music, or a partner snoring? Put on your sleep noise using this app, and you will soon find that distractions are no longer bothering you. You will also notice that this noise has a calming effect that helps you relax and drift off to sleep naturally. Once you have connected with the benefits of these sleep sounds, it may profoundly change the way you sleep.

These noises are also very effective in focusing the mind on office work, study, or thought in distracting environments. By replacing the base volume of the background noise in the environment around you with random white noise, pink noise, or brown noise, the distracting sounds are drowned out, leaving you a soothing virtual silence. The noise-canceling sounds replace the background noise. The calming effect of the noise helps focus the mind on the task at hand, facilitating clarity and productivity.

The audio from this app works great when played directly from your iPhone or iPad speaker and can also connect to headphones, AirPods, a Bluetooth speaker, HomePod, or other audio device for a louder and deeper bath of calming noise. Why buy a portable noise maker or sound machine when you can use the devices you already own!

Noise Machine features a sleep timer to automatically turn off noise at night after a set time. Some people like to fall asleep by relaxing with noise, but find that they prefer the noise to fade out during sleep. Set a sleep timer to your desired time, and the noise will fade out very slowly.

People use Noise Machine to:
• fall asleep faster
• block out distracting sounds
• provide a source of background noise
• increase focus and concentration
• help with work and study
• relax and reduce stress
• increase privacy in the home or office
• quiet your mind
• alleviate tinnitus
• calm infants, toddlers, children, and babies
• drown out a snoring partner

it.name: Sleevi - Mobile Sleep Lab
it.d:
Sleevi turns the signals your Apple Watch already records overnight into three plain answers every morning: how well you recovered, how you slept, and what you can ask of the day ahead.

THREE RINGS, ONE GLANCE
Recovery (0–100), Sleep (0–100) and Readiness (0–10) sit side by side at the top of Today. Each is one tap away from its full breakdown.

BUILT ON THE NEWEST SIGNALS
HRV (RMSSD on watchOS 27, SDNN before), resting and overnight heart rate, respiratory rate, sleeping wrist temperature, blood oxygen, breathing disturbances and Apple's sleep apnea notifications, sleep stages, workouts and VO₂ max — read straight from Apple Health.

SIGNAL, NOT NOISE
Every score is measured against your own baseline, never against population averages. And the score only moves for deviations that matter — beyond your personal noise band and a physiological minimum. A cooler wrist never counts against you.

APPLE INTELLIGENCE, ON DEVICE
Your morning insight is written by Apple's on-device Foundation Model from last night's facts: two or three calm sentences and one concrete suggestion for the day. Nothing leaves your iPhone. Without the model, a rule-based insight steps in — and says so.

GOOD MORNING
The morning summary waits until your Watch has synced every signal, so the number you see at 7:03 is the number that stays. Illness early warning, low-recovery and short-sleep alerts, and a Sunday report follow the same rule: one per night, never nagging.

BEDTIME, PLANNED
Sleevi works out tonight's bedtime from how much sleep you need and when you have to be up — your usual wake time or, if you like, tomorrow's first calendar event. Three gentle steps: wind down, one more step, bed. And in the evening it listens to your heart rate and HRV; once they settle near your night levels, it tells you your body is ready.

ILLNESS, A DAY EARLY
When several overnight signals drift the wrong way at once — a warmer wrist, a higher resting pulse, faster breathing, suppressed HRV — Sleevi tells you before you feel it. A pattern, not a diagnosis: it never names a condition and always points you to a clinician if you feel unwell.

SLEEP, TRENDS, HABITS
Stages, quality breakdown, sleep debt and naps. Every metric over 30 days to a year against your personal range. Tag last night — alcohol, late meal, sick — and run experiments with real before/after statistics.

A REPORT FOR YOUR DOCTOR
One tap creates a printable PDF of the last 30 days: averages against your personal range, trend charts, and a night-by-night table with every flag.

EVERYWHERE
Home and Lock Screen widgets, a native Apple Watch app with complications and Smart Stack relevance, and an iPad layout built as a dashboard. Six languages.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no server, no analytics. Health and Calendar data stay on your device.

Sleevi is for information only and not a medical device. It cannot diagnose illness, sleep apnea or any condition. If you feel unwell, talk to a doctor.

Requires an Apple Watch with sleep tracking. Apple Intelligence features require a supported iPhone with Apple Intelligence enabled.

it.name: Muscle & Motion: Strength
it.d:
Build strength with guided workout plans, gym routines, and in-depth biomechanics. Muscle & Motion brings training to life with 3D visuals that show how your body moves.

The Strength Training app is powered by a team of physiotherapists, movement experts, and professional animators. We turn your device into a visual strength-training lab and show you exactly which muscle structures are working, so you can understand the anatomy and  biomechanics of the exercise, and train smarter while reducing injury risk.

Made for personal trainers, strength coaches, therapists, students, and dedicated lifters, this app connects what you feel in the gym with what’s really happening in the body.

Designed for visual learners
If you learn best by seeing, this app is made for you.

Why trainers, coaches & students love it


- Makes complex anatomy easy to understand through clear 3D animations

- Shows exactly which muscles and joints are involved in each exercise

- Reveals common mistakes so you can coach better form

- Explains concepts far better than static images or textbooks

Backed by thousands of 5-star ratings and trusted by movement professionals worldwide.

Instead of static diagrams, you get animated 3D views of real lifts: muscles slide, shorten and lengthen as the movement happens, making it much easier to remember which structures are doing what, and why it matters

Key features:

• Interactive 3D Anatomy Model
Rotate, zoom, and explore every muscle, joint, and bone for a deeper understanding of human movement.

• Access to 3D Exercise Anatomy Library (1,200+ exercises, updated weekly)
Comprehensive library of science-based exercise videos, each with full anatomical analysis and common mistakes to avoid. See prime movers, synergists, stabilizers and antagonists highlighted with clear color-coding, and learn how to target or de-emphasize specific muscles by changing stance, range, or grip.

• Educational Videos 
Discover a range of videos designed to make learning anatomy easy and engaging. From core fundamentals to advanced mechanics.

• Workout Plans
Create & assign customized workouts


What our users say

“An absolute must for understanding movement and the anatomy behind it! It’s like watching under the skin.”

“I’ve finally found an app that helps me prevent injuries by showing exactly what not to do!”


“This app makes complex anatomy simple and has helped me become a more effective trainer for my clients.”

Who is this app for?
Strength Training by M&M is built for anyone who wants to train and teach with confidence: 

- Personal trainers & strength coaches
- Physical therapists, chiropractors & rehab professionals
- Pilates, yoga & movement teachers
- Bodybuilders, powerlifters & fitness enthusiasts
- Kinesiology, physiotherapy & sports-science students
- University and college instructors who teach exercise anatomy/biomechanics

Use it to prepare sessions, design programs, teach classes, or deepen your own understanding of lifting mechanics.

Free access & subscriptions
You can download the app and start learning with a free tier that unlocks a portion of the content so you can explore the 3D model and try sample exercises.

To access the full library of exercises, 3D anatomy content, and all workout-building tools, you can upgrade with an in-app subscription:
Subscriptions give you full access to all videos, exercises, workouts, and the 3D model for the duration of your plan.

Subscriptions auto-renew unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in your Apple ID account settings.

You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions on your device.

For full details, please see:
Privacy Policy: https://www.muscleandmotion.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.muscleandmotion.com/terms-of-use/

Support
Have a question, feature request or need help with your subscription?
Our team is happy to help at info@muscleandmotion.com.

it.name: Sunrise - Intermittent Fasting
it.d:
Sunrise Fasting is an intermittent fasting tracker designed to help you build healthy habits, stay motivated, and track your fasting progress over time.

Whether you're new to intermittent fasting or already have an established routine, Sunrise Fasting makes it easy to track fasts, monitor weight goals, view history and stats, and stay consistent with a fasting schedule that works for you.

~~ FEATURES ~~

[+] Track your fasts with live progress updates and fasting timer countdowns to your goal.

[+] View fasting history, weight goal progress, badges, milestones, and detailed stats throughout your journey.

[+] Learn helpful fasting tips, advice, and information through curated articles and videos.

[+] Apple Watch app, Home Screen widgets, and Lock Screen widgets are supported.

~~ TYPES OF FASTS ~~

[+] 16-Hour (16:8) Intermittent Fast: one of the most popular fasting schedules.

[+] Sunrise Fast: fast from sunrise until sundown. Commonly practiced during religious observances such as Ramadan.

[+] Sunset Fast: fast from sundown through sunrise. Also used in some religious customs.

[+] 18:6, 20:4, 1 day (24 hours), and 1.5 day (36 hours) fasts.

[+] Custom fasts of any duration, up to 168 hours.

~~~~

Sunrise Fasting integrates with Apple Health to sync your weight data.

~~~~

Sunrise Fasting+ is an optional subscription. Sunrise Fasting+ unlocks premium features like trends and insights, scheduled fasts, and fast presets. It also removes in-app advertisements. Your subscription will automatically renew if not canceled.

Sunrise Fasting is intended to be a tool for tracking intermittent fasting and is not a medical or healthcare service. The content within Sunrise Fasting is for informational purposes only. You should consult a medical professional before starting intermittent fasting or any other weight loss program, especially if you are pregnant or have a medical condition.

it.name: The Outsiders Fitness Tracker
it.d:
For people who like to spend time outside. Outside of their comfort zone.

The Outsiders comes with hand-picked metrics to help you improve performance in an informed way. Made for self-coached athletes driven by data and planning.

This is not another "do more" fitness app. The Outsiders balances intensity with recovery. If you train with intent, want clear feedback, and see training as your main side project - this may be the tool for you.

*Created by the team behind Apple Watch App of the Year & Apple Design Award Winner*

For cyclists, runners, swimmers, and performance-driven athletes who know what they need.

▶ TODAY – KNOW YOUR READINESS
Start each day with a Training Readiness score based on the ratio of acute to chronic training load, combined with body metrics and sleep quality. This tracks the balance between recent training effort and what your body can handle, accounting for short-term trends.

This helps you:
• Select the right effort & intensity for the day
• Build steadily toward goals
• Avoid injury and overtraining

All factors affecting your Readiness appear in interactive charts (Sleep, Training Load Ratio - TLR, Training Form, Body Metrics).

Body metric history shows how training impacts recovery and adaptation. View data across 7 days, 4 weeks, or 6 months. Each view shows avg, max, and min values.

View sleep quality, duration, stages, and consistency over 14 days. Longer periods are coming.

▶ PROGRESS – TRACK YOUR PERFORMANCE
See how your training load is stacking up during the training cycles.
• Balance hard training periods and recovery weeks
• Training Goals: Set short- and long-term targets and track progress over time
• Training Focus: choose the right type of guidance according to your goals - Polarized, Pyramid, Threshold
• Track your Endurance Fitness (CTL), Cardio Fitness (VO₂ max), and cycling FTP with clear trends.

Coming later:
• Running FT Pace
• Cycling Power Curve

▶ WORKOUTS – COMPLETE INSIGHT
All your HealthKit workout history in one place.
Garmin Connect supported. New workouts import automatically.

Weekly, monthly, and yearly trends with detailed charts, including training load, duration, energy, distance, elevation, and number of sessions.

Detailed in-workout analysis with:
• Key stats
• Zones (aerobic & anaerobic, traditional 5 HR zones, and cycling power zones)
• Breakdown (intervals, segments, and distance splits)
• Charts
• Advanced metrics: Efficiency Factor, Aerobic Decoupling, Relative Intensity, and Variability Index.

▶ APPLE WATCH APP
Key stats always a glance away: Training Readiness, TLR, Sleeping Heart Rate, HRV, Wrist Temperature, Respiratory Rate, Blood Oxygen, and recent Sleep.

Watch app complications:
• Training Readiness
• Training Load Ratio

▶ WIDGETS
Check Training Readiness, Body Metrics, Training Load Ratio, and Endurance Fitness on your home screen. 

▶ LOCALISATION
Available in 10 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese (Simpl. & Trad.), Japanese, Korean.

▶ PRIVACY
The app only reads HealthKit data on your device and never stores it elsewhere.

▶ DISCLAIMER
The Outsiders uses your HealthKit data and works best with >90 days of training history. If you’re new to Apple Watch or workout logging, it will need time to learn your patterns. Limited data means limited insight.

Crafted with attention to detail, by real, air-breathing humans.

Terms of Service: https://gentlerstories.com/theoutsiders/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://gentlerstories.com/theoutsiders/privacypolicy

it.name: Dream Catcher: Snore Tracker
it.d:
Dream Catcher turns your iPhone into a nightstand snore tracker. Tap Start, put the phone down, and sleep. Overnight it listens and detects snoring right on the device. In the morning you get a report of your night: total snore time, how much of the night it covered, a timeline of when it happened, an intensity breakdown, and short clips of the loudest episodes so you can hear it for yourself.

Everything stays on your phone. No account, no cloud, no network calls at all. Only brief clips of detected snoring are saved — never whole-night audio — and those clips are excluded from your backups and deleted automatically after 90 days. You can erase everything at any time from Settings.

What you get
• Overnight detection that runs while the phone is locked
• A morning report: snore time, percentage of the night, episode count
• A timeline showing when snoring happened, and how loud relative to your room
• Playback of the loudest episodes
• History with a calendar and week/month trends
• Low, Medium, and High sensitivity settings

Honest about what it can't do. A microphone hears the whole room, so Dream Catcher can't tell who — or what — is snoring; a partner, a pet, or a fan can end up in your report. Loudness is shown relative to your own room's quiet level, not in calibrated decibels.

Dream Catcher is not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, or monitor any medical condition, including sleep apnea. If you are concerned about your sleep or breathing, talk to a physician.

Break Free from Dieting Cycles: 
Our app simplifies healthy living, making weight loss easy and sustainable. Learn to live healthily with the guidance of our AI coach Olivia. FitWise is here to help you break free from traditional dieting cycles. 

Personalized Calorie Counter: 
Manage your nutrition easily with our personalized calorie counter. You can manually input your meals or let Olivia, our AI coach, calculate calories automatically for effortless tracking. Snap a photo, search for food, or chat with Olivia to log what you eat and find your way to a healthier you.

Instant Insights with Food Tracking:

Snap food photos for a quick dive into macronutrient values or manually log your meals with precision and ease. Unlike other apps, FitWise goes beyond basic tracking – chat with Olivia, your personalized AI Coach, about what you ate. Share your meals, discuss nutritional choices, and receive real-time guidance to make informed decisions about your diet. 

AI Coach for Your Weight Loss Journey: 
Meet Olivia, your personalized AI coach designed with various personalities to match your preferences. Olivia streamlines the process of tracking your progress, making weight loss feel effortless. Feel motivated and guided by the expertise of our personalized AI coach, Olivia, who motivates and educates you in a style that suits you best.

Discover a Culinary Adventure:
Embark on a culinary adventure with FitWise as you explore a variety of healthy recipes tailored to your taste buds. From quick and easy dishes to wholesome homemade delights, our app is your go-to source for creating delicious meals that nourish your body.

Healthy Knowledge for Long-Term Well-being:

it.name: Hevy - Workout Tracker Gym Log
it.d:
The workout tracker featured by Apple and trusted by 15M+ lifters. Rated 4.9 on the App Store. 112M+ workouts logged in 2025 alone.

Log every set, follow any program or split, and track your lifts and volume. Learn how to do any exercise with high-quality videos and step-by-step instructions. Free, with no ads.

Train alongside millions of lifters, follow friends and family, compare your stats, and share your progress in their feed.

No program? No problem. Whether you're new and overwhelmed or a gym veteran, browse Hevy's large, free library for a full split or individual workouts.

And now, Hevy Trainer gives you the coaching you need, available with Hevy Pro. It builds a program tailored to your experience, goal, available equipment, and preferences. Trainer tracks your progress and consistency, and guides you through each workout with tips and progressive overload. (Even if you only have dumbbells and a workout mat.)

WHY HEVY?
• Log weights, reps, duration, and RPE in seconds without breaking the flow of your sets.
• See last session's weights and reps for every exercise, right where you need them. No guessing, no scrolling back through history.
• Log supersets, drop sets, warm-ups, and failure sets alongside your regular sets.
• Stay on track with automatic rest timers between sets.
• Monitor your strength progression and PRs with graphs for every exercise.
• Add progress photos, body weight, and measurements to see how your training is paying off.
• Follow friends and athletes from around the world, see their workouts in your feed, and compare your lifts.
• Stay consistent with monthly, yearly, and multi-year calendars and streak tracking.
• Work out offline. Your data syncs across all your devices.
• Automatically sync your workouts to Strava for hybrid training.

APPLE WATCH
• Log sets, start rest timers, and finish your workout without touching your phone.
• Monitor your heart rate during your workout.
• Add Hevy complications to your watch face.
• Workouts save automatically when your watch reconnects to your phone.

Hevy uses HealthKit and CareKit to export your workouts to the Health app. You can turn this on in Settings.

WHAT OTHERS ARE SAYING
"Hevy blends workout tracking with social motivation, making it a top pick if you thrive on accountability and community support." Men's Journal
"By far my favorite workout tracking app." The Morning Show Podcast
"I've experimented with enough strength training apps that I know which ones are out there, and I definitely have a favorite: It's Hevy." Beth Skwarecki, senior health editor, Lifehacker

Whether you work out at home or at the gym, want to build muscle or lose fat, train twice a week or every day, Hevy is the last workout tracker you'll ever need. Give it a try.

HEVY PRO
• Hevy Trainer: a program and ongoing guidance based on your experience, goal, available equipment, and preferences.
• Unlimited routines and custom exercises.
• Your complete training history.

If you choose to purchase Hevy Pro, payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off automatic renewal at any time in your Apple account settings. You have the right to withdraw from your initial subscription within 14 days of starting it. If you don't purchase Hevy Pro, you can keep using Hevy for free.

it.name: Nutrition tracker- Lilbite
it.d:
Calorie counting is as easy as 1-2-3.
Get the most out of your diet with this easy-to-use app that allows you to keep track of your daily calories, nutrients, and meals.

Our calorie counter and water tracker app that gives you access to all your nutrition data, so you can make healthier lifestyle choices.
Cut fat, build muscle, maximize health. Lose weight and get fit with this super-easy app that tracks your food. Simple, fast, powerful!

Calorie counters and macro trackers both work to help you lose weight, but macro trackers are more effective. A macro tracker is a next generation food tracker that focuses on macros, not only calories. The Food & Macro Tracker By lilbite is a free app that makes tracking your food easy, and helps you reach your fitness goals.

The Food & Macro Tracker App by lilbite has been designed to help anyone understand what a calorie is, much less a gram of carbohydrate. For those who are health-novices, the idea of using a macro tracker can be overwhelming. Many barely understand what a calorie is, much less a gram of carbohydrate. With the Food & Macro Tracker App, that has changed.

 The underlying reason any diet works is because of energy balance. Food faddism comes and goes, but calorie trackers have been around since the beginning of time, because they are the reason any diet can or does work. Calories consumed and calories expended determine an energy surplus leading to weight gain and fat gain, or an energy deficit leading to weight loss and fat loss. This is why calorie counters are so popular. They help people reach their fitness goals.

 Macronutrients are the nutrients that create any calories from the foods we eat. Without macros, no calories will be made. Macros serve different purposes in the body. For example, protein builds and repairs muscle tissue, and fat helps store energy. A balance of macros ensures optimal weight loss and health improvements.

Great Lilbite features :- 

Use the Daily Calorie Calculator to find out how many calories you need per day to reach your target weight.

INTEGRATION WITH THE HEALTH APP

it.name: Nightfall: Sleep & Sounds
it.d:
Let sound slow your evening down.

Nightfall brings white noise, environmental sleep sounds and meditation to Apple TV. Choose rain, waves, a stream, fireplace or colored noise, with real filmed nature visuals. No account, no ads. Every feature and media download is free.

SOUND AND PICTURE, TOGETHER
Choose from 15 sounds: white, pink and brown noise and real nature recordings. Eleven sounds work offline immediately; four more lossless recordings are optional free downloads. Selecting a sound starts audio with a picture by default. Recordings and footage are separate assets you can pair yourself.

Controls appear when playback starts and hide after 10 seconds. Select brings them back; directional buttons also reveal them when the picture is on. A discreet sound title remains when controls hide. Play/Pause controls sound and picture together. Back first hides controls, then returns to the app. Stop sound or Exit ends the session.

PICTURE OFF, AUDIO CONTINUES
Turn the picture off during playback to keep your sound and timer with a black picture. No clock, text or focus outline is shown. Select reveals controls and lets you restore the picture. Nightfall cannot switch off your TV backlight or control another player.

GUIDED BREATHING
Follow a growing and settling circle in a 5, 10 or 20 minute practice. Choose a rhythm of 4 seconds in and 6 out, or 4 in and 4 out, alongside a soundscape. Pause and resume whenever you choose; pausing also pauses the practice timer and audio.

Optional system voice cues say when to breathe in and out, even with the picture off. Availability depends on voices provided by your device. These are brief rhythm cues, not a recorded meditation course. No microphone access or voice recording. Self-led 10/20 minute stream sessions, 30 minute rain and 60 minute brown-noise presets are also included.

YOUR MIX, YOUR BEDTIME ROUTINE
Blend up to three layers with relative levels. Save the mix, background, brightness and timers as a personal routine. Ordinary sleep timers offer 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 60, 90 or 120 minutes and run in real time, fading our audio over the final 30 seconds. An independent picture timer hides the image while sound continues.

DOWNLOAD WHAT YOU WANT
Fourteen real filmed backgrounds include ten built-in assets and four optional 4K downloads. Listening needs no extra video download. Optional items show specifications, size, creator and license, with progress, cancel, retry and remove controls. Downloads work offline; tvOS may clear caches and downloading again is free.

• 13 interface languages, including an automatic option
• Remote-friendly controls and locally saved preferences and routines
• Website, privacy, terms and media credits linked in Settings
• Four optional support purchases; no paid features or subscription
• No idle auto-play, standalone screensaver, photo slideshow or floating clock

For everyday relaxation, bedtime listening and breathing practice. No medical diagnosis, treatment, sleep tracking or guaranteed sleep outcome. Use a comfortable volume and breathing pace. Internet is required for initial optional downloads.

it.name: Ramble: Walking App, Pedometer
it.d:
Ramble is the simple, affordable way to make walking a part of your daily routine. Lose weight, sleep better, reduce stress, improve mobility, lower anxiety, improve digestion, and refocus your creativity and attention.

Invest in your health & longevity by counting your steps and tracking your walks to reach you daily step goal. Key features include a step counter & pedometer, a walk tracker with GPS & mapping, and stats, analytics, and streaks to keep you on track. Add Ramble to your daily routine and join millions of people committed to improving their lives by walking more.

WALKING IS IMPORTANT
The benefits of walking include:
⊕ Improve health & longevity
⊕ Lose weight
⊕ Improve sleep
⊕ Improve mobility & balance
⊕ Reduce stress & anxiety
⊕ Improve circulation
⊕ Improve joint & bone health
⊕ Reduce pain & inflammation
⊕ Improve digestion
⊕ Regulate blood sugar
⊕ Improve focus & memory
⊕ Improve creativity & mood

BACKED BY SCIENCE
Since 1980, over 8,000+ studies and articles have been published on the benefits of walking. In addition to being a comprehensive, low-impact exercise, numerous studies highlight its health benefits including improved cardiovascular and lung health, enhanced mental clarity, weight loss, and greater bone and muscle strength. 

STEP COUNTER & PEDOMETER:
Our real-time step counter and pedometer keep you informed and up-to-date. We provide simple, minimalist UI/UX so you can easily monitor your step count throughout the day to make sure you reach your daily step goal.

WALK TRACKER:
Ramble's GPS and walk tracking features map out your routes as you walk, so you can visualize your walk while it's in progress. You can also access your walk history to view past stats, analytics, and more.

STREAKS, ANALYTICS & GOALS
Set your daily step count and view your progress on a weekly, monthly, and yearly basis. Ramble provides interactive charts, calendars, and dashboards, showcasing your step counts, streaks, and walk history.

EXPLORE & DISCOVER
Walking is a great way to discover new places and explore your neighborhood. Walking is not only a path to enhanced health, but it's also the most intimate way to explore your surroundings. Traverse city streets, wander through natural landscapes, and uncover hidden gems, all while reaping the numerous health benefits that walking consistently brings.

EASY-TO-USE
Ramble uses Apple's Motion and Health frameworks to count your steps, which are specifically optimized for low power consumption. This allows Ramble to access motion and health data with high efficiency, ensuring that the app does not drain your battery.

REMINDERS
Keep your walk and step goals in check with customized reminders, helping you to prioritize your health on a consistent schedule.

APPLE HEALTH
Ramble integrates with the Health app, giving users the option to sync their health information and activity with Apple Health.

FEEDBACK & SUPPORT
If you have any questions, feedback, or suggestions, feel free to contact us at support@joinramble.com!

LEGAL

Privacy Policy: https://www.joinramble.com/privacy

it.d:
Sleepzy is a smart alarm clock that tracks your sleep patterns, wakes you up during the lightest sleep phase in a way that feels natural to get up, analyzes your sleep quality, and notifies you if you have a sleep debt. It's an essential app for everyone, whether you're a morning person or a night owl.

IMPROVE YOUR AWAKENING:
- Wake up rested at the optimal time - don't feel groggy anymore!
- Sync with Apple Music to use your favorite tunes as an alarm - set your mood for the day

TRACK & ANALYZE YOUR SLEEP:
- Set your Sleep Goal and track Sleep Debt - stay motivated to get enough hours of sleep
- Track your sleep patterns - focus on sleeping not only long enough but well enough
- Know your Sleep Quality - make adjustments to your daily habits to get your quality % up
- Get helpful weekly stats

UNWIND YOUR MIND BEFORE SLEEP:
- Fall asleep to relaxing sounds & classical melodies
- Listen to Dream Radio: doze off to AI-generated music and hypnotic visuals

GET HELPFUL INSIGHTS:
- Receive daily personal sleep advice and explore worldwide sleep statistics with "Insights"
- Get Weather Forecast at your location in the morning to plan the day easily

KEEP YOUR SLEEP DATA SYNCED & SECURED:
- Sync your data with the Apple Health app 
- Backup your sleep data and restore it whenever you need it

Sleepzy + Apple Watch = More Fun
Monitor your sleep with Apple Watch - the clear and easy-to-use interface will help you overview what was going on while you're asleep

Go Premium to:
- Dive deep into insights with advanced stats and track your progress over time 
- Find out whether you snore
- Listen to a wider variety of relaxing sounds & classical music
- Use special breathing technics to calm your mind
- Unlock all sleep insights
- Get rid of ads

Please note that movement and noise from pets or a partner may impact results.

Start waking up stress-free at the best moment possible. Revolutionize your mornings!

it.name: SnoreGym : Reduce Your Snoring
it.d:
Reduce your snoring with SnoreGym, the workout app for quiet sleep from the creators of SnoreLab.

With this exercise app for snorers, get your snoring under control by working out your “snoring muscles”. You can also directly sync with the No.1 snoring tracking app - SnoreLab - to track your progress.

One of the main causes of snoring is weak muscles in the mouth area. SnoreGym is an exercise app which helps to tone your upper airway muscles to reduce snoring.

SnoreGym will guide you through a set of clinically-proven exercises for your tongue, soft palate, cheeks and jaw.

Features include:
- Exercises to reduce snoring
- Easy-to-follow animations
- Clear and detailed instructions
- Evidence-based workouts
- Progress tracking
- Sync to SnoreLab

Scientists have tested a set of mouth exercises which tone muscles in the tongue, soft palate, throat, cheeks and jaw. This research has shown that mouth exercises can reduce snoring, decrease the severity of sleep apnea, reduce disturbance of bed partners and produce better sleep and quality of life.

It is important to do these exercises regularly to reduce your snoring. We recommend at least 10 minutes a day for 8+ weeks.

Exercise now for quieter sleep!

it.name: Stress Ball - Anxiety Relief
it.d:
It's not a great feeling to be anxious. And when you are, it's tough to meditate without having the stressful thoughts slip back in. Fortunately, with Stress Ball, you can interact with your phone and clear your mind with exercises, fidgets and videos within the app. There are five different tabs you can use to calm down: Breathe, Fidget, ChillTok, Color & Reflect

In the Breathe tab, there are breathing exercises to help you take deep breaths and calm down. You can customize your experience with relaxing sounds and backgrounds. The phone also vibrates and provides various animations to distract your thoughts.

In the Fidget tab, there are virtual fidgets and toys you can play with to distract your mind and let out all of your anxious energy on the app. The fidgets also provide vibration and audio feedback to help you feel more relaxed.

In the Feel tab, you can tap on ASMR sounds and feel the vibrations of the sounds!! These vibrations are super calming to the body and mind. Give it a try!!

In the Color tab, you can complete vibrating color by numbers. Coloring can help soothe your mind and distract you away from your stress. It also is great for fidgeting when feeling anxious or restless.

In the Reflect tab, you can journal and reflect about your feelings and emotions. You can also talk through your feelings with StressBot, an AI chat companion. You can also swipe through a lot of different types of quotes, such as Positive, Affirmations, Self-Love and Stress Relief. You also can record a smile everyday to lift your mood!

In all these tabs you can play super calming soundscapes while interacting with the exercises and videos. Simply press the music icon in the top right corner and select from many different soothing music and noises.

Have a great time using Stress Ball and we hope you find which options work the best for relieving your anxiety!

STRESS BALL PRO

Stress Ball offers an optional, auto-renewing monthly subscription for $4.99/month, or an annual subscription for $29.99. The payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.

Your subscription to Stress Ball will automatically renew unless you disable auto-renew at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can turn off auto-renew or manage your subscription from your iTunes Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a Stress Ball Pro subscription.

it.name: Good Things gratitude journal
it.d:
Three Good Things is a gratitude-focused daily journal designed to cultivate a habit of gratitude in your life. It invites you to notice and write down the small moments you appreciate each day.

Engage with a gratitude-centric daily journal that prioritizes your mental and emotional wellness by providing a platform for you to express and celebrate the positive aspects of your life.

Commit to a daily gratitude practice with this easy-to-use journal, allowing you to form a sustainable habit of recognizing and cherishing the good in your life.

Share your daily gratitude experiences with others, fostering an environment of appreciation and positivity.

Write in the evening in a night mode that stays easy on the eyes in a dark room.

Embrace the power of daily gratitude and let this transformative journal practice become an integral part of your self-care routine. By consistently engaging with your gratitude journal, you'll create a space for positivity, growth, and happiness in your life.

Thank you for choosing to embark on this journey of gratitude and self-discovery. Inspired by the Three Good Things exercise studied in positive psychology, this journal gives you a simple space to reflect on what you notice each day.

Download this free gratitude journal app now and start your daily journaling habit!

it.name: Wild Journey - Nature Sounds
it.d:
**The soundscapes are among the best we’ve encountered** - TapSmart

Get more mindful naturally. Enjoy listening to guided meditations focused on topics like sleep, stress release and nature connection. Choose from and endlessly growing landscape library with rugged mountain ridges to rolling prairies and lush forests and relax listening to the high quality nature sounds and ambient music. Connect with nature anywhere you are.

LANDSCAPES 
The richly illustrated and animated landscapes will help you tune in to the natural world. Each landscape can be enjoyed listening to a guided meditation or an unguided timed session. Choose from a male or female narrator for the guided meditations to guide you on your journey.
The dynamic 3D soundscapes and music not only sooth your mind, they also vary slightly every time you visit a place, offering endless possibilities to explore.

EXPERIENCES 
Wild Journey features multiple day experiences to let you build a mindfulness habit easily. 
Enjoy nature sounds with guided meditations on topics from anxiety to gratefulness, to sleeping better and becoming more relaxed. 

SLEEPSCAPES
Each Sleepscape features specially designed nature sounds near the threshold of human hearing. There are 3 audio tracks you can mix to create the ideal scene to fall asleep to. 

MOMENTS 
Moments are one minute mini meditations to slow you down and help you connect with the present moment, helping you to bring calm and balance to your life in a natural way. 

FEATURE LIST 
- Diverse illustrated landscapes, from valleys and snowy peaks to beaches and deserts, with optional guided meditations. 
- Multiple day guided meditation sessions focussed on topics like sleeping better, calming anxiety or letting go of stress. 
- Experiences let you build a daily mindfulness habit easily.
- Customize your ideal dream world to fall asleep naturally with Sleepscapes.
- Mini meditations that help you connect with the present moment in under a minute. 
- Personalised feed with suggestions to explore.
- Variations in landscapes; landscapes are slightly different every time you visit them and offer endless possibilities to explore. 
- A choice between a male and female narrator in the basic meditations to guide you on your journey.
- An endlessly growing library with a diversity of landscapes and experiences/guided meditations to choose from.
- Use collections to explore different themes and landscapes.
- Possibility for unguided timed meditation sessions in all the landscapes. 
- Subtle animations like swaying trees in a summer breeze.
- Designed to look & sound beautiful on the iPhone and iPad.
- Apple health app integration to track your progress and mindful minutes. 
- Support for iOS14 Home Screen widgets.

SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS

To explore all the landscapes and to enjoy the regularly added experiences and meditations, we offer two auto-renewing subscriptions to the ever-growing library.

An auto-renewing monthly subscription at $6.99/month and an auto-renewing annual subscription at $44.99/year to provide you with unlimited access to all of Wild Journey while you maintain an active subscription. These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.

Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can go to your Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal.

Terms of Service: https://www.wildventures.nl/terms-of-service-wild-journey
Privacy policy: https://www.wildventures.nl/privacy-policy-wild-journey
